    1: using System;

    9: {
   10:     /// <summary>
   11:     /// Gate 2B certification for emission composition.
   12:     ///
   13:     /// This gate proves:
   14:     ///
   15:     /// consumer data
   16:     ///     -> base emission scalar
   17:     ///
   18:     /// topology
   19:     ///     -> membership selection
   20:     ///     -> topology scalar
   21:     ///
   22:     /// base scalar + topology scalar
   23:     ///     -> supplied composition policy
   24:     ///     -> resolved emission scalar
   25:     ///
   26:     /// The emitter does not own the mathematical semantics
   27:     /// of composition.
   28:     /// </summary>
   29:     public sealed class EmitterGate2BTests
   30:     {
   31:         [Fact]
   32:         public void Base_and_topology_scalars_are_composed_by_supplied_policy()
   33:         {
   34:             var component =
   35:                 new TestComponent(
   36:                     "gate2b.component");
   37: 
   38:             var emitter =
   39:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateEmitter(
   40:                     component,
   41:                     properties:
   42:                         new Dictionary<string, object?>
   43:                         {
   44:                             ["signal"] = 1.6
   45:                         });
   46: 
   47:             var alphaA =
   48:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
   49:                     component,
   50:                     "gate2b.alpha.a");
   51: 
   52:             var alphaB =
   53:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
   54:                     component,
   55:                     "gate2b.alpha.b");
   56: 
   57:             var beta =
   58:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
   59:                     component,
   60:                     "gate2b.beta");
   61: 
   62:             emitter.Neighbors.Add(
   63:                 alphaA,
   64:                 "alpha",
   65:                 1.0);
   66: 
   67:             emitter.Neighbors.Add(
   68:                 alphaB,
   69:                 "alpha",
   70:                 2.0);
   71: 
   72:             emitter.Neighbors.Add(
   73:                 beta,
   74:                 "beta",
   75:                 1.0);
   76: 
   77:             Assert.True(
   78:                 emitter.TryEmit(
   79:                     "signal",
   80:                     out var baseEmission));
   81: 
   82:             var topologyScalar =
   83:                 emitter.ResolveTestTopologyScalar(
   84:                     new MembershipNeighborFilter(
   85:                         "alpha"),
   86:                     new NeighborCount(),
   87:                     count => count);
   88: 
   89:             var resolved =
   90:                 emitter.ComposeTestEmission(
   91:                     baseEmission,
   92:                     topologyScalar,
   93:                     new TestAdditiveEmissionComposition());
   94: 
   95:             Assert.Equal(
   96:                 1.6,
   97:                 baseEmission,
   98:                 10);
   99: 
  100:             Assert.Equal(
  101:                 2.0,
  102:                 topologyScalar,
  103:                 10);
  104: 
  105:             Assert.Equal(
  106:                 3.6,
  107:                 resolved,
  108:                 10);
  109:         }

    1: using WildsEngine.Core.Neighbors.Operators;

    7: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Tests.Emission
    8: {
    9:     /// <summary>
   10:     /// Gate 3 certification for complete scalar emission
   11:     /// resolution.
   12:     ///
   13:     /// This gate proves the complete internal route:
   14:     ///
   15:     /// consumer value
   16:     ///     -> base scalar
   17:     ///     -> current topology
   18:     ///     -> topology selection
   19:     ///     -> topology scalar
   20:     ///     -> supplied composition
   21:     ///     -> resolved emission
   22:     ///
   23:     /// Propagation, receiver eligibility, and state operations
   24:     /// remain outside this gate.
   25:     /// </summary>
   26:     public sealed class EmitterGate3Tests
   27:     {
   28:         private readonly ITestOutputHelper _testOutputHelper;
   29: 
   30:         public EmitterGate3Tests(
   31:             ITestOutputHelper testOutputHelper)
   32:         {
   33:             _testOutputHelper =
   34:                 testOutputHelper;
   35:         }
   36: 
   37:         [Fact]
   38:         public void Complete_emission_route_resolves_in_one_operation()
   39:         {
   40:             InitializeEmissionReport();
   41: 
   42:             TestLog.Section(
   43:                 "EMITTER GATE 3 - COMPLETE EMISSION RESOLUTION");
   44: 
   45:             TestLog.Test(
   46:                 "Consumer value and current topology resolve into one emission.");
   47: 
   48:             var component =
   49:                 new TestComponent(
   50:                     "gate3.component");
   51: 
   52:             var emitter =
   53:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateEmitter(
   54:                     component,
   55:                     properties:
   56:                         new Dictionary<string, object?>
   57:                         {
   58:                             ["signal"] = 1.6
   59:                         });
   60: 
   61:             var alphaA =
   62:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
   63:                     component,
   64:                     "gate3.alpha.a");
   65: 
   66:             var alphaB =
   67:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
   68:                     component,
   69:                     "gate3.alpha.b");
   70: 
   71:             var beta =
   72:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
   73:                     component,
   74:                     "gate3.beta");
   75: 
   76:             TestLog.Task(
   77:                 "Building emitter topology.");
   78: 
   79:             Assert.True(
   80:                 emitter.Neighbors.Add(
   81:                     alphaA,
   82:                     "alpha",
   83:                     1.0));
   84: 
   85:             Assert.True(
   86:                 emitter.Neighbors.Add(
   87:                     alphaB,
   88:                     "alpha",
   89:                     2.0));
   90: 
   91:             Assert.True(
   92:                 emitter.Neighbors.Add(
   93:                     beta,
   94:                     "beta",
   95:                     1.0));
   96: 
   97:             TestLog.State(
   98:                 $"Neighbor relationships = {emitter.Neighbors.Count}");
   99: 
  100:             TestLog.Task(
  101:                 "Resolving base emission through alpha topology.");
  102: 
  103:             var alphaRelationships =
  104:                 emitter.ApplyNeighborOperator(
  105:                     new MembershipNeighborFilter(
  106:                         "alpha"));
  107: 
  108:             var topologyScalar =
  109:                 new NeighborCount().Apply(
  110:                     emitter,
  111:                     alphaRelationships);
  112: 
  113:             var resolved =
  114:                 emitter.TryResolveTestEmission(
  115:                     "signal",
  116:                     new MembershipNeighborFilter(
  117:                         "alpha"),
  118:                     new NeighborCount(),
  119:                     count => count,
  120:                     new TestAdditiveEmissionComposition(),
  121:                     out var value);
  122: 
  123:             TestLog.State(
  124:                 "Base emission = 1.6");
  125: 
  126:             TestLog.State(
  127:                 "Selected membership = alpha");
  128: 
  129:             TestLog.State(
  130:                 $"Topology scalar = {topologyScalar}");
  131: 
  132:             TestLog.State(
  133:                 $"Resolved emission = {value}");
  134: 
  135:             Assert.True(
  136:                 resolved);
  137: 
  138:             Assert.Equal(
  139:                 2,
  140:                 topologyScalar);
  141: 
  142:             Assert.Equal(
  143:                 3.6,
  144:                 value,
  145:                 10);
  146: 
  147:             TestLog.Pass(
  148:                 "Complete emission route resolved successfully.");
  149: 
  150:             PublishLatestReport();
  151: 
  152:             WriteFinished(
  153:                 "COMPLETE EMISSION RESOLUTION");
  154:         }
  155: 
  156:         [Fact]
  157:         public void Unrelated_memberships_do_not_contribute()
  158:         {
  159:             InitializeEmissionReport();
  160: 
  161:             TestLog.Section(
  162:                 "EMITTER GATE 3 - MEMBERSHIP ISOLATION");
  163: 
  164:             TestLog.Test(
  165:                 "Unrelated memberships do not contribute to the selected topology.");
  166: 
  167:             var component =
  168:                 new TestComponent(
  169:                     "gate3.component");
  170: 
  171:             var emitter =
  172:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateEmitter(
  173:                     component,
  174:                     properties:
  175:                         new Dictionary<string, object?>
  176:                         {
  177:                             ["signal"] = 10.0
  178:                         });
  179: 
  180:             var alpha =
  181:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
  182:                     component,
  183:                     "gate3.alpha");
  184: 
  185:             var betaA =
  186:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
  187:                     component,
  188:                     "gate3.beta.a");
  189: 
  190:             var betaB =
  191:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
  192:                     component,
  193:                     "gate3.beta.b");
  194: 
  195:             emitter.Neighbors.Add(
  196:                 alpha,
  197:                 "alpha",
  198:                 1.0);
  199: 
  200:             emitter.Neighbors.Add(
  201:                 betaA,
  202:                 "beta",
  203:                 1.0);
  204: 
  205:             emitter.Neighbors.Add(
  206:                 betaB,
  207:                 "beta",
  208:                 1.0);
  209: 
  210:             TestLog.State(
  211:                 $"Total relationships = {emitter.Neighbors.Count}");
  212: 
  213:             var resolved =
  214:                 emitter.TryResolveTestEmission(
  215:                     "signal",
  216:                     new MembershipNeighborFilter(
  217:                         "alpha"),
  218:                     new NeighborCount(),
  219:                     count => count,
  220:                     new TestAdditiveEmissionComposition(),
  221:                     out var value);
  222: 
  223:             TestLog.State(
  224:                 $"Resolved alpha emission = {value}");
  225: 
  226:             Assert.True(
  227:                 resolved);
  228: 
  229:             Assert.Equal(
  230:                 11.0,
  231:                 value,
  232:                 10);
  233: 
  234:             TestLog.Pass(
  235:                 "Unrelated beta memberships did not contribute.");
  236: 
  237:             WriteFinished(
  238:                 "MEMBERSHIP ISOLATION");
  239:         }

  241:         [Fact]
  242:         public void Membership_changes_immediately_change_resolved_emission()
  243:         {
  244:             InitializeEmissionReport();
  245: 
  246:             TestLog.Section(
  247:                 "EMITTER GATE 3 - DYNAMIC MEMBERSHIP");
  248: 
  249:             TestLog.Test(
  250:                 "Changing topology membership changes the next resolved emission.");
  251: 
  252:             var component =
  253:                 new TestComponent(
  254:                     "gate3.component");
  255: 
  256:             var emitter =
  257:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateEmitter(
  258:                     component,
  259:                     properties:
  260:                         new Dictionary<string, object?>
  261:                         {
  262:                             ["signal"] = 5.0
  263:                         });
  264: 
  265:             var objectA =
  266:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
  267:                     component,
  268:                     "gate3.object.a");
  269: 
  270:             var objectB =
  271:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
  272:                     component,
  273:                     "gate3.object.b");
  274: 
  275:             emitter.Neighbors.Add(
  276:                 objectA,
  277:                 "active",
  278:                 1.0);
  279: 
  280:             emitter.Neighbors.Add(
  281:                 objectB,
  282:                 "active",
  283:                 1.0);
  284: 
  285:             Assert.True(
  286:                 emitter.TryResolveTestEmission(
  287:                     "signal",
  288:                     new MembershipNeighborFilter(
  289:                         "active"),
  290:                     new NeighborCount(),
  291:                     count => count,
  292:                     new TestAdditiveEmissionComposition(),
  293:                     out var before));
  294: 
  295:             TestLog.State(
  296:                 $"Resolved active emission before topology change = {before}");
  297: 
  298:             TestLog.Task(
  299:                 "Moving one object from active to inactive membership.");
  300: 
  301:             Assert.True(
  302:                 emitter.Neighbors.Remove(
  303:                     objectB.Id,
  304:                     "active"));
  305: 
  306:             Assert.True(
  307:                 emitter.Neighbors.Add(
  308:                     objectB,
  309:                     "inactive",
  310:                     1.0));
  311: 
  312:             Assert.True(
  313:                 emitter.TryResolveTestEmission(
  314:                     "signal",
  315:                     new MembershipNeighborFilter(
  316:                         "active"),
  317:                     new NeighborCount(),
  318:                     count => count,
  319:                     new TestAdditiveEmissionComposition(),
  320:                     out var after));
  321: 
  322:             TestLog.State(
  323:                 $"Resolved active emission after topology change = {after}");
  324: 
  325:             Assert.Equal(
  326:                 7.0,
  327:                 before,
  328:                 10);
  329: 
  330:             Assert.Equal(
  331:                 6.0,
  332:                 after,
  333:                 10);
  334: 
  335:             TestLog.Pass(
  336:                 "Dynamic membership change immediately affected emission resolution.");
  337: 
  338:             WriteFinished(
  339:                 "DYNAMIC MEMBERSHIP");
  340:         }

  401:         [Fact]
  402:         public void Pipeline_can_define_topology_before_scalar_resolution()
  403:         {
  404:             InitializeEmissionReport();
  405: 
  406:             TestLog.Section(
  407:                 "EMITTER GATE 3 - TOPOLOGY PIPELINE");
  408: 
  409:             TestLog.Test(
  410:                 "Existing Neighbor pipeline stages define topology before scalar reduction.");
  411: 
  412:             var component =
  413:                 new TestComponent(
  414:                     "gate3.component");
  415: 
  416:             var emitter =
  417:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateEmitter(
  418:                     component,
  419:                     properties:
  420:                         new Dictionary<string, object?>
  421:                         {
  422:                             ["signal"] = 1.0
  423:                         });
  424: 
  425:             var near =
  426:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
  427:                     component,
  428:                     "gate3.near");
  429: 
  430:             var middle =
  431:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
  432:                     component,
  433:                     "gate3.middle");
  434: 
  435:             var far =
  436:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
  437:                     component,
  438:                     "gate3.far");
  439: 
  440:             var unrelated =
  441:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
  442:                     component,
  443:                     "gate3.unrelated");
  444: 
  445:             emitter.Neighbors.Add(
  446:                 near,
  447:                 "alpha",
  448:                 1.0);
  449: 
  450:             emitter.Neighbors.Add(
  451:                 middle,
  452:                 "alpha",
  453:                 2.0);
  454: 
  455:             emitter.Neighbors.Add(
  456:                 far,
  457:                 "alpha",
  458:                 10.0);
  459: 
  460:             emitter.Neighbors.Add(
  461:                 unrelated,
  462:                 "beta",
  463:                 1.0);
  464: 
  465:             var pipeline =
  466:                 new NeighborPipeline(
  467:                     new MembershipNeighborFilter(
  468:                         "alpha"),
  469:                     new NeighborWithinDistanceFilter(
  470:                         2.0));
  471: 
  472:             var selected =
  473:                 emitter.ApplyNeighborOperator(
  474:                     pipeline);
  475: 
  476:             TestLog.State(
  477:                 $"Source relationships = {emitter.Neighbors.Count}");
  478: 
  479:             TestLog.State(
  480:                 $"Pipeline relationships = {selected.Count}");
  481: 
  482:             Assert.True(
  483:                 emitter.TryResolveTestEmission(
  484:                     "signal",
  485:                     pipeline,
  486:                     new NeighborCount(),
  487:                     count => count,
  488:                     new TestAdditiveEmissionComposition(),
  489:                     out var value));
  490: 
  491:             TestLog.State(
  492:                 $"Resolved emission = {value}");
  493: 
  494:             Assert.Equal(
  495:                 2,
  496:                 selected.Count);
  497: 
  498:             Assert.Equal(
  499:                 3.0,
  500:                 value,
  501:                 10);
  502: 
  503:             TestLog.Pass(
  504:                 "Neighbor pipeline successfully defined emission topology.");
  505: 
  506:             WriteFinished(
  507:                 "TOPOLOGY PIPELINE");
  508:         }
  509: 
  510:         [Fact]
  511:         public void Complete_resolution_does_not_mutate_source_topology()
  512:         {
  513:             InitializeEmissionReport();
  514: 
  515:             TestLog.Section(
  516:                 "EMITTER GATE 3 - TOPOLOGY PRESERVATION");
  517: 
  518:             TestLog.Test(
  519:                 "Complete emission resolution preserves source Neighbor topology.");
  520: 
  521:             var component =
  522:                 new TestComponent(
  523:                     "gate3.component");
  524: 
  525:             var emitter =
  526:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateEmitter(
  527:                     component,
  528:                     properties:
  529:                         new Dictionary<string, object?>
  530:                         {
  531:                             ["signal"] = 2.0
  532:                         });
  533: 
  534:             var alpha =
  535:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
  536:                     component,
  537:                     "gate3.alpha");
  538: 
  539:             var beta =
  540:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
  541:                     component,
  542:                     "gate3.beta");
  543: 
  544:             emitter.Neighbors.Add(
  545:                 alpha,
  546:                 "alpha",
  547:                 1.0);
  548: 
  549:             emitter.Neighbors.Add(
  550:                 beta,
  551:                 "beta",
  552:                 2.0);
  553: 
  554:             var countBefore =
  555:                 emitter.Neighbors.Count;
  556: 
  557:             Assert.True(
  558:                 emitter.TryResolveTestEmission(
  559:                     "signal",
  560:                     new MembershipNeighborFilter(
  561:                         "alpha"),
  562:                     new NeighborCount(),
  563:                     count => count,
  564:                     new TestAdditiveEmissionComposition(),
  565:                     out var value));
  566: 
  567:             var countAfter =
  568:                 emitter.Neighbors.Count;
  569: 
  570:             TestLog.State(
  571:                 $"Relationships before resolution = {countBefore}");
  572: 
  573:             TestLog.State(
  574:                 $"Relationships after resolution = {countAfter}");
  575: 
  576:             TestLog.State(
  577:                 $"Resolved emission = {value}");
  578: 
  579:             Assert.Equal(
  580:                 3.0,
  581:                 value,
  582:                 10);
  583: 
  584:             Assert.Equal(
  585:                 2,
  586:                 countAfter);
  587: 
  588:             Assert.True(
  589:                 emitter.Neighbors.Contains(
  590:                     alpha.Id,
  591:                     "alpha"));
  592: 
  593:             Assert.True(
  594:                 emitter.Neighbors.Contains(
  595:                     beta.Id,
  596:                     "beta"));
  597: 
  598:             TestLog.Pass(
  599:                 "Complete resolution preserved source topology.");
  600: 
  601:             WriteFinished(
  602:                 "TOPOLOGY PRESERVATION");
  603:         }
  604: 
  605:         private static void InitializeEmissionReport()
  606:         {
  607:             TestLog.Initialize(
  608:                 $"emitter-certification-{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd-HHmmss}.log",
  609:                 "Emission");
  610:         }
  611: 
  612:         private static void PublishLatestReport()
  613:         {
  614:             TestLog.State(
  615:                 $"Emission certification report = {TestLog.Path}");
  616: 
  617:             TestLog.WriteLatest(
  618:                 "emitter-certification-latest.log");
  619:         }
  620: 
  621:         private void WriteFinished(
  622:             string certification)
  623:         {
  624:             _testOutputHelper.WriteLine("");
  625:             _testOutputHelper.WriteLine(
  626:                 "============================================");
  627: 
  628:             _testOutputHelper.WriteLine(
  629:                 $" EMITTER GATE 3 FINISHED - {certification}");
  630: 
  631:             _testOutputHelper.WriteLine(
  632:                 "============================================");
  633: 
  634:             _testOutputHelper.WriteLine(
  635:                 $" Report: {TestLog.Path}");
  636: 
  637:             _testOutputHelper.WriteLine("");
  638:         }
  639:     }
  640: }

    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;

   10: 
   11: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Tests.Emission
   12: {
   13:     /// <summary>
   14:     /// Gate 4 certification for immutable resolved-emission
   15:     /// carriers.
   16:     ///
   17:     /// This gate proves:
   18:     ///
   19:     /// certified Gate 3 resolution
   20:     ///     -> exact source emitter
   21:     ///     -> consumer-owned emission identity
   22:     ///     -> finite resolved scalar
   23:     ///     -> immutable resolved-emission carrier
   24:     ///
   25:     /// Propagation, eligibility, receiver selection, and
   26:     /// state operations remain outside this gate.
   27:     /// </summary>
   28:     public sealed class EmitterGate4Tests
   29:     {
   30:         private readonly ITestOutputHelper _testOutputHelper;
   31: 
   32:         public EmitterGate4Tests(
   33:             ITestOutputHelper testOutputHelper)
   34:         {
   35:             _testOutputHelper =
   36:                 testOutputHelper;
   37:         }
   38: 
   39:         [Fact]
   40:         public void Gate3_result_resolves_into_immutable_carrier()
   41:         {
   42:             InitializeEmissionReport();
   43: 
   44:             TestLog.Section(
   45:                 "EMITTER GATE 4 - RESOLVED EMISSION CARRIER");
   46: 
   47:             TestLog.Test(
   48:                 "Gate 3 output survives resolved-emission carrier construction.");
   49: 
   50:             var component =
   51:                 new TestComponent(
   52:                     "gate4.component");
   53: 
   54:             var emitter =
   55:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateEmitter(
   56:                     component,
   57:                     properties:
   58:                         new Dictionary<string, object?>
   59:                         {
   60:                             ["abyssal-lure-resonance"] = 1.6
   61:                         });
   62: 
   63:             var alphaA =
   64:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
   65:                     component,
   66:                     "gate4.alpha.a");
   67: 
   68:             var alphaB =
   69:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
   70:                     component,
   71:                     "gate4.alpha.b");
   72: 
   73:             var beta =
   74:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
   75:                     component,
   76:                     "gate4.beta");
   77: 
   78:             TestLog.Task(
   79:                 "Building topology for resolved emission.");
   80: 
   81:             Assert.True(
   82:                 emitter.Neighbors.Add(
   83:                     alphaA,
   84:                     "alpha",
   85:                     1.0));
   86: 
   87:             Assert.True(
   88:                 emitter.Neighbors.Add(
   89:                     alphaB,
   90:                     "alpha",
   91:                     2.0));
   92: 
   93:             Assert.True(
   94:                 emitter.Neighbors.Add(
   95:                     beta,
   96:                     "beta",
   97:                     1.0));
   98: 
   99:             var resolved =
  100:                 emitter.TryResolveTestEmissionResult(
  101:                     "abyssal-lure-resonance",
  102:                     new MembershipNeighborFilter(
  103:                         "alpha"),
  104:                     new NeighborCount(),
  105:                     count => count,
  106:                     new TestAdditiveEmissionComposition(),
  107:                     out var result);
  108: 
  109:             Assert.True(
  110:                 resolved);
  111: 
  112:             Assert.NotNull(
  113:                 result);
  114: 
  115:             TestLog.State(
  116:                 $"Source Id = {result!.Source.Id}");
  117: 
  118:             TestLog.State(
  119:                 $"Exact source reference = {ReferenceEquals(emitter, result.Source)}");
  120: 
  121:             TestLog.State(
  122:                 $"Emission name = {result.Name}");
  123: 
  124:             TestLog.State(
  125:                 $"Resolved value = {result.Value}");
  126: 
  127:             Assert.Same(
  128:                 emitter,
  129:                 result.Source);
  130: 
  131:             Assert.Equal(
  132:                 emitter.Id,
  133:                 result.Source.Id);
  134: 
  135:             Assert.Equal(
  136:                 "abyssal-lure-resonance",
  137:                 result.Name);
  138: 
  139:             Assert.Equal(
  140:                 3.6,
  141:                 result.Value,
  142:                 10);
  143: 
  144:             TestLog.Pass(
  145:                 "Resolved emission preserved exact source, vocabulary, and value.");
  146: 
  147:             PublishLatestReport();
  148: 
  149:             WriteFinished(
  150:                 "RESOLVED EMISSION CARRIER");
  151:         }
  152: 
  153:         [Fact]
  154:         public void Missing_consumer_emission_creates_no_carrier()
  155:         {

  469:         [Fact]
  470:         public void Carrier_does_not_change_when_source_topology_changes()
  471:         {
  472:             InitializeEmissionReport();
  473: 
  474:             TestLog.Section(
  475:                 "EMITTER GATE 4 - SNAPSHOT STABILITY");
  476: 
  477:             TestLog.Test(
  478:                 "Resolved emission remains stable after source topology changes.");
  479: 
  480:             var component =
  481:                 new TestComponent(
  482:                     "gate4.component");
  483: 
  484:             var emitter =
  485:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateEmitter(
  486:                     component,
  487:                     properties:
  488:                         new Dictionary<string, object?>
  489:                         {
  490:                             ["signal"] = 5.0
  491:                         });
  492: 
  493:             var first =
  494:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
  495:                     component,
  496:                     "gate4.first");
  497: 
  498:             var second =
  499:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
  500:                     component,
  501:                     "gate4.second");
  502: 
  503:             emitter.Neighbors.Add(
  504:                 first,
  505:                 "active",
  506:                 1.0);
  507: 
  508:             emitter.Neighbors.Add(
  509:                 second,
  510:                 "active",
  511:                 1.0);
  512: 
  513:             Assert.True(
  514:                 emitter.TryResolveTestEmissionResult(
  515:                     "signal",
  516:                     new MembershipNeighborFilter(
  517:                         "active"),
  518:                     new NeighborCount(),
  519:                     count => count,
  520:                     new TestAdditiveEmissionComposition(),
  521:                     out var result));
  522: 
  523:             Assert.NotNull(
  524:                 result);
  525: 
  526:             var originalValue =
  527:                 result!.Value;
  528: 
  529:             TestLog.State(
  530:                 $"Carrier value before topology change = {originalValue}");
  531: 
  532:             TestLog.Task(
  533:                 "Changing source topology after carrier construction.");
  534: 
  535:             Assert.True(
  536:                 emitter.Neighbors.Remove(
  537:                     second.Id,
  538:                     "active"));
  539: 
  540:             Assert.True(
  541:                 emitter.Neighbors.Add(
  542:                     second,
  543:                     "inactive",
  544:                     1.0));
  545: 
  546:             TestLog.State(
  547:                 $"Carrier value after topology change = {result.Value}");
  548: 
  549:             Assert.Equal(
  550:                 7.0,
  551:                 originalValue,
  552:                 10);
  553: 
  554:             Assert.Equal(
  555:                 originalValue,
  556:                 result.Value,
  557:                 10);
  558: 
  559:             Assert.Same(
  560:                 emitter,
  561:                 result.Source);
  562: 
  563:             Assert.Equal(
  564:                 "signal",
  565:                 result.Name);
  566: 
  567:             TestLog.Pass(
  568:                 "Resolved-emission carrier remained stable after topology changed.");
  569: 
  570:             WriteFinished(
  571:                 "SNAPSHOT STABILITY");
  572:         }
  573: 
  574:         private static void InitializeEmissionReport()
  575:         {
  576:             TestLog.Initialize(
  577:                 $"emitter-certification-{DateTime.Now:yyyyMMdd-HHmmss}.log",
  578:                 "Emission");
  579:         }
  580: 
  581:         private static void PublishLatestReport()
  582:         {
  583:             TestLog.State(
  584:                 $"Emission certification report = {TestLog.Path}");
  585: 
  586:             TestLog.WriteLatest(
  587:                 "emitter-certification-latest.log");
  588:         }
  589: 
  590:         private void WriteFinished(
  591:             string certification)
  592:         {
  593:             _testOutputHelper.WriteLine("");
  594:             _testOutputHelper.WriteLine(
  595:                 "============================================");
  596: 
  597:             _testOutputHelper.WriteLine(
  598:                 $" EMITTER GATE 4 FINISHED - {certification}");
  599: 
  600:             _testOutputHelper.WriteLine(
  601:                 "============================================");
  602: 
  603:             _testOutputHelper.WriteLine(
  604:                 $" Report: {TestLog.Path}");
  605: 
  606:             _testOutputHelper.WriteLine("");
  607:         }
  608:     }

    1: using System;

   12: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Tests.Emission
   13: {
   14:     /// <summary>
   15:     /// Gate 5 certification for first-class emission-vector
   16:     /// carriers.
   17:     ///
   18:     /// This gate proves continuity across:
   19:     ///
   20:     /// resolved emissions
   21:     ///     -> immutable resolved vector
   22:     ///     -> immutable normalized vector
   23:     ///     -> existing Neighbor propagation
   24:     ///     -> immutable propagated vector
   25:     ///
   26:     /// The complete route preserves exact:
   27:     ///
   28:     /// source emitter identity
   29:     /// vector identity
   30:     /// emission identity and ordering
   31:     /// consumer-owned property names
   32:     /// resolved magnitudes
   33:     /// normalized magnitudes
   34:     /// Neighbor relationship identity
   35:     /// frozen propagation distance
   36:     /// received magnitudes
   37:     ///
   38:     /// Consumer interpretation, eligibility, and receiver
   39:     /// mutation remain outside this gate.
   40:     /// </summary>
   41:     public sealed class EmitterGate5VectorCarrierTests
   42:     {
   43:         private readonly ITestOutputHelper _testOutputHelper;
   44: 
   45:         public EmitterGate5VectorCarrierTests(
   46:             ITestOutputHelper testOutputHelper)
   47:         {
   48:             _testOutputHelper =
   49:                 testOutputHelper;
   50:         }
   51: 
   52:         [Fact]
   53:         public void Vector_carriers_preserve_complete_gate5_provenance()
   54:         {
   55:             InitializeEmissionReport();
   56: 
   57:             TestLog.Section(
   58:                 "EMITTER GATE 5 - VECTOR CARRIER PROVENANCE");
   59: 
   60:             TestLog.Test(
   61:                 "Complete resolved, normalized, propagated, source, and relationship provenance survives the vector route.");
   62: 
   63:             var component =
   64:                 new TestComponent(
   65:                     "gate5.carrier.component");
   66: 
   67:             var emitter =
   68:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateEmitter(
   69:                     component);
   70: 
   71:             var receiver =
   72:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
   73:                     component,
   74:                     "gate5.carrier.receiver");
   75: 
   76:             Assert.True(
   77:                 emitter.Neighbors.Add(
   78:                     receiver,
   79:                     "conversation",
   80:                     2.0));
   81: 
   82:             Assert.True(
   83:                 emitter.Neighbors.TryGet(
   84:                     receiver.Id,
   85:                     "conversation",
   86:                     out var relationship));
   87: 
   88:             Assert.NotNull(
   89:                 relationship);
   90: 
   91:             var resolvedComponents =
   92:                 new IResolvedEmission[]
   93:                 {
   94:                     new ResolvedEmission(
   95:                         emitter,
   96:                         "panic",
   97:                         8.4),
   98: 
   99:                     new ResolvedEmission(
  100:                         emitter,
  101:                         "urgency",
  102:                         5.7),
  103: 
  104:                     new ResolvedEmission(
  105:                         emitter,
  106:                         "confusion",
  107:                         2.1),
  108: 
  109:                     new ResolvedEmission(
  110:                         emitter,
  111:                         "hesitation",
  112:                         1.3),
  113: 
  114:                     new ResolvedEmission(
  115:                         emitter,
  116:                         "trust",
  117:                         0.6)
  118:                 };
  119: 
  120:             var resolvedVector =
  121:                 new ResolvedEmissionVector(
  122:                     resolvedComponents);
  123: 
  124:             var propagation =
  125:                 new EmissionVectorPropagation(
  126:                     new ProportionalEmissionNormalization(),
  127:                     new ExponentialDistancePropagation(
  128:                         0.25));
  129: 
  130:             TestLog.Task(
  131:                 "Normalizing and propagating the resolved vector.");
  132: 
  133:             var propagatedVector =
  134:                 propagation.Propagate(
  135:                     resolvedVector,
  136:                     relationship!);
  137: 
  138:             var normalizedVector =
  139:                 propagatedVector.Source;
  140: 
  141:             var expectedAttenuation =
  142:                 Math.Exp(
  143:                     -0.25 *
  144:                     relationship.Distance);
  145: 
  146:             TestLog.State(
  147:                 $"Emitter Id = {emitter.Id}");
  148: 
  149:             TestLog.State(
  150:                 $"Resolved vector exact source = " +
  151:                 $"{ReferenceEquals(emitter, resolvedVector.Source)}");
  152: 
  153:             TestLog.State(
  154:                 $"Resolved vector dimensions = " +
  155:                 $"{resolvedVector.Dimension}");
  156: 
  157:             TestLog.State(
  158:                 $"Resolved vector total = " +
  159:                 $"{resolvedVector.ResolvedTotal:R}");
  160: 
  161:             TestLog.State(
  162:                 $"Normalized vector exact source = " +
  163:                 $"{ReferenceEquals(resolvedVector, normalizedVector.Source)}");
  164: 
  165:             TestLog.State(
  166:                 $"Normalized vector dimensions = " +
  167:                 $"{normalizedVector.Dimension}");
  168: 
  169:             TestLog.State(
  170:                 $"Normalized vector total = " +
  171:                 $"{normalizedVector.NormalizedTotal:R}");
  172: 
  173:             TestLog.State(
  174:                 $"Propagated vector exact source = " +
  175:                 $"{ReferenceEquals(normalizedVector, propagatedVector.Source)}");
  176: 
  177:             TestLog.State(
  178:                 $"Propagated vector dimensions = " +
  179:                 $"{propagatedVector.Dimension}");
  180: 
  181:             TestLog.State(
  182:                 $"Relationship membership = " +
  183:                 $"{propagatedVector.Relationship.Membership}");
  184: 
  185:             TestLog.State(
  186:                 $"Live relationship distance = " +
  187:                 $"{propagatedVector.Relationship.Distance:R}");
  188: 
  189:             TestLog.State(
  190:                 $"Frozen propagation distance = " +
  191:                 $"{propagatedVector.PropagationDistance:R}");
  192: 
  193:             TestLog.State(
  194:                 $"Expected attenuation = " +
  195:                 $"{expectedAttenuation:R}");
  196: 
  197:             TestLog.State(
  198:                 $"Received vector total = " +
  199:                 $"{propagatedVector.ReceivedTotal:R}");
  200: 
  201:             Assert.Same(
  202:                 emitter,
  203:                 resolvedVector.Source);
  204: 
  205:             Assert.Same(
  206:                 resolvedVector,
  207:                 normalizedVector.Source);
  208: 
  209:             Assert.Same(
  210:                 normalizedVector,
  211:                 propagatedVector.Source);
  212: 
  213:             Assert.Same(
  214:                 relationship,
  215:                 propagatedVector.Relationship);
  216: 
  217:             Assert.Equal(
  218:                 relationship.Distance,
  219:                 propagatedVector.PropagationDistance,
  220:                 12);
  221: 
  222:             Assert.Equal(
  223:                 resolvedVector.Dimension,
  224:                 normalizedVector.Dimension);
  225: 
  226:             Assert.Equal(
  227:                 resolvedVector.Dimension,
  228:                 propagatedVector.Dimension);
  229: 
  230:             Assert.Equal(
  231:                 18.1,
  232:                 resolvedVector.ResolvedTotal,
  233:                 12);
  234: 
  235:             Assert.Equal(
  236:                 1.0,
  237:                 normalizedVector.NormalizedTotal,
  238:                 12);
  239: 
  240:             Assert.Equal(
  241:                 expectedAttenuation,
  242:                 propagatedVector.ReceivedTotal,
  243:                 12);
  244: 
  245:             for (var index = 0;
  246:                  index < resolvedVector.Dimension;
  247:                  index++)
  248:             {
  249:                 var resolved =
  250:                     resolvedVector.Emissions[index];
  251: 
  252:                 var normalized =
  253:                     normalizedVector.Emissions[index];
  254: 
  255:                 var propagated =
  256:                     propagatedVector.Emissions[index];
  257: 
  258:                 var expectedNormalized =
  259:                     resolved.Value /
  260:                     resolvedVector.ResolvedTotal;
  261: 
  262:                 var expectedReceived =
  263:                     expectedNormalized *
  264:                     expectedAttenuation;
  265: 
  266:                 TestLog.State(
  267:                     $"{resolved.Name} | " +
  268:                     $"resolved = {resolved.Value:R} | " +
  269:                     $"normalized = {normalized.NormalizedValue:R} | " +
  270:                     $"received = {propagated.Value:R} | " +
  271:                     $"distance = {propagated.PropagationDistance:R}");
  272: 
  273:                 Assert.Same(
  274:                     resolved,
  275:                     normalized.Emission);
  276: 
  277:                 Assert.Same(
  278:                     resolved,
  279:                     propagated.Emission);
  280: 
  281:                 Assert.Same(
  282:                     relationship,
  283:                     propagated.Relationship);
  284: 
  285:                 Assert.Equal(
  286:                     propagatedVector.PropagationDistance,
  287:                     propagated.PropagationDistance,
  288:                     12);
  289: 
  290:                 Assert.Equal(
  291:                     resolved.Value,
  292:                     normalized.ResolvedValue,
  293:                     12);
  294: 
  295:                 Assert.Equal(
  296:                     resolved.Value,
  297:                     propagated.ResolvedValue,
  298:                     12);
  299: 
  300:                 Assert.True(
  301:                     propagated.NormalizedValue.HasValue);
  302: 
  303:                 Assert.Equal(
  304:                     expectedNormalized,
  305:                     normalized.NormalizedValue,
  306:                     12);
  307: 
  308:                 Assert.Equal(
  309:                     normalized.NormalizedValue,
  310:                     propagated.NormalizedValue!.Value,
  311:                     12);
  312: 
  313:                 Assert.Equal(
  314:                     expectedReceived,
  315:                     propagated.Value,
  316:                     12);
  317:             }
  318: 
  319:             TestLog.Pass(
  320:                 "Exact emitter, vector, component, relationship, and value provenance survived Gate 5.");
  321: 
  322:             TestLog.Pass(
  323:                 "Resolved, normalized, and received magnitudes remained independently observable.");
  324: 
  325:             TestLog.Pass(
  326:                 "Frozen propagation distance remained available beside the exact relationship.");
  327: 
  328:             PublishLatestReport();
  329:

  334:         [Fact]
  335:         public void Propagation_distance_remains_stable_after_relationship_changes()
  336:         {
  337:             InitializeEmissionReport();
  338: 
  339:             TestLog.Section(
  340:                 "EMITTER GATE 5 - DISTANCE SNAPSHOT");
  341: 
  342:             TestLog.Test(
  343:                 "Propagated results preserve the distance used during evaluation after live topology changes.");
  344: 
  345:             var component =
  346:                 new TestComponent(
  347:                     "gate5.distance.component");
  348: 
  349:             var emitter =
  350:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateEmitter(
  351:                     component);
  352: 
  353:             var receiver =
  354:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
  355:                     component,
  356:                     "gate5.distance.receiver");
  357: 
  358:             Assert.True(
  359:                 emitter.Neighbors.Add(
  360:                     receiver,
  361:                     "conversation",
  362:                     2.0));
  363: 
  364:             Assert.True(
  365:                 emitter.Neighbors.TryGet(
  366:                     receiver.Id,
  367:                     "conversation",
  368:                     out var relationship));
  369: 
  370:             Assert.NotNull(
  371:                 relationship);
  372: 
  373:             var resolvedVector =
  374:                 new ResolvedEmissionVector(
  375:                     new IResolvedEmission[]
  376:                     {
  377:                         new ResolvedEmission(
  378:                             emitter,
  379:                             "approval",
  380:                             0.8),
  381: 
  382:                         new ResolvedEmission(
  383:                             emitter,
  384:                             "hesitation",
  385:                             0.2)
  386:                     });
  387: 
  388:             var propagation =
  389:                 new EmissionVectorPropagation(
  390:                     new ProportionalEmissionNormalization(),
  391:                     new ExponentialDistancePropagation(
  392:                         0.5));
  393: 
  394:             var result =
  395:                 propagation.Propagate(
  396:                     resolvedVector,
  397:                     relationship!);
  398: 
  399:             var frozenDistance =
  400:                 result.PropagationDistance;
  401: 
  402:             var frozenValues =
  403:                 new double[
  404:                     result.Dimension];
  405: 
  406:             for (var index = 0;
  407:                  index < result.Dimension;
  408:                  index++)
  409:             {
  410:                 frozenValues[index] =
  411:                     result.Emissions[index].Value;
  412:             }
  413: 
  414:             TestLog.State(
  415:                 $"Propagation distance before topology change = " +
  416:                 $"{frozenDistance:R}");
  417: 
  418:             TestLog.Task(
  419:                 "Replacing the live relationship with a different distance.");
  420: 
  421:             Assert.True(
  422:                 emitter.Neighbors.Remove(
  423:                     receiver.Id,
  424:                     "conversation"));
  425: 
  426:             Assert.True(
  427:                 emitter.Neighbors.Add(
  428:                     receiver,
  429:                     "conversation",
  430:                     5.0));
  431: 
  432:             Assert.True(
  433:                 emitter.Neighbors.TryGet(
  434:                     receiver.Id,
  435:                     "conversation",
  436:                     out var replacement));
  437: 
  438:             Assert.NotNull(
  439:                 replacement);
  440: 
  441:             TestLog.State(
  442:                 $"Replacement relationship distance = " +
  443:                 $"{replacement!.Distance:R}");
  444: 
  445:             TestLog.State(
  446:                 $"Carrier propagation distance after topology change = " +
  447:                 $"{result.PropagationDistance:R}");
  448: 
  449:             Assert.Equal(
  450:                 2.0,
  451:                 frozenDistance,
  452:                 12);
  453: 
  454:             Assert.Equal(
  455:                 frozenDistance,
  456:                 result.PropagationDistance,
  457:                 12);
  458: 
  459:             Assert.NotSame(
  460:                 result.Relationship,
  461:                 replacement);
  462: 
  463:             for (var index = 0;
  464:                  index < result.Dimension;
  465:                  index++)
  466:             {
  467:                 Assert.Equal(
  468:                     frozenDistance,
  469:                     result.Emissions[index].PropagationDistance,
  470:                     12);
  471: 
  472:                 Assert.Equal(
  473:                     frozenValues[index],
  474:                     result.Emissions[index].Value,
  475:                     12);
  476:             }
  477: 
  478:             TestLog.Pass(
  479:                 "Historical propagation distance and received values survived live topology replacement.");
  480: 
  481:             WriteFinished(
  482:                 "DISTANCE SNAPSHOT");
  483:         }

  657:         [Fact]
  658:         public void Propagated_vector_preserves_arbitrary_n_dimensions()
  659:         {
  660:             InitializeEmissionReport();
  661: 
  662:             TestLog.Section(
  663:                 "EMITTER GATE 5 - ARBITRARY VECTOR DIMENSION");
  664: 
  665:             TestLog.Test(
  666:                 "First-class vector carriers preserve arbitrary N-dimensional named emissions.");
  667: 
  668:             var component =
  669:                 new TestComponent(
  670:                     "gate5.dimension.component");
  671: 
  672:             var emitter =
  673:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateEmitter(
  674:                     component);
  675: 
  676:             var receiver =
  677:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
  678:                     component,
  679:                     "gate5.dimension.receiver");
  680: 
  681:             Assert.True(
  682:                 emitter.Neighbors.Add(
  683:                     receiver,
  684:                     "conversation",
  685:                     1.0));
  686: 
  687:             Assert.True(
  688:                 emitter.Neighbors.TryGet(
  689:                     receiver.Id,
  690:                     "conversation",
  691:                     out var relationship));
  692: 
  693:             Assert.NotNull(
  694:                 relationship);
  695: 
  696:             const int dimension =
  697:                 17;
  698: 
  699:             var emissions =
  700:                 new IResolvedEmission[
  701:                     dimension];
  702: 
  703:             for (var index = 0;
  704:                  index < dimension;
  705:                  index++)
  706:             {
  707:                 emissions[index] =
  708:                     new ResolvedEmission(
  709:                         emitter,
  710:                         $"consumer-property-{index}",
  711:                         index + 1.0);
  712:             }
  713: 
  714:             var resolvedVector =
  715:                 new ResolvedEmissionVector(
  716:                     emissions);
  717: 
  718:             var propagation =
  719:                 new EmissionVectorPropagation(
  720:                     new ProportionalEmissionNormalization(),
  721:                     new ExponentialDistancePropagation(
  722:                         0.5));
  723: 
  724:             var result =
  725:                 propagation.Propagate(
  726:                     resolvedVector,
  727:                     relationship!);
  728: 
  729:             TestLog.State(
  730:                 $"Resolved dimensions = " +
  731:                 $"{resolvedVector.Dimension}");
  732: 
  733:             TestLog.State(
  734:                 $"Normalized dimensions = " +
  735:                 $"{result.Source.Dimension}");
  736: 
  737:             TestLog.State(
  738:                 $"Propagated dimensions = " +
  739:                 $"{result.Dimension}");
  740: 
  741:             Assert.Equal(
  742:                 dimension,
  743:                 resolvedVector.Dimension);
  744: 
  745:             Assert.Equal(
  746:                 dimension,
  747:                 result.Source.Dimension);
  748: 
  749:             Assert.Equal(
  750:                 dimension,
  751:                 result.Dimension);
  752: 
  753:             for (var index = 0;
  754:                  index < dimension;
  755:                  index++)
  756:             {
  757:                 var expectedName =
  758:                     $"consumer-property-{index}";
  759: 
  760:                 Assert.Equal(
  761:                     expectedName,
  762:                     resolvedVector.Emissions[index].Name);
  763: 
  764:                 Assert.Equal(
  765:                     expectedName,
  766:                     result.Source.Emissions[index].Emission.Name);
  767: 
  768:                 Assert.Equal(
  769:                     expectedName,
  770:                     result.Emissions[index].Emission.Name);
  771:             }
  772: 
  773:             TestLog.Pass(
  774:                 "Arbitrary N dimensions survived resolution, normalization, and propagation.");
  775: 
  776:             WriteFinished(
  777:                 "ARBITRARY VECTOR DIMENSION");
  778:         }

  805: 
  806:             _testOutputHelper.WriteLine(
  807:                 "============================================");
  808: 
  809:             _testOutputHelper.WriteLine(
  810:                 $" Report: {TestLog.Path}");
  811: 
  812:             _testOutputHelper.WriteLine("");
  813:         }

   12: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Tests.Emission
   13: {
   14:     /// <summary>
   15:     /// Gate 6 certification for propagated-emission
   16:     /// eligibility.
   17:     ///
   18:     /// This gate proves:
   19:     ///
   20:     /// scalar propagated emission
   21:     ///     -> received propagated Value
   22:     ///     -> existing Neighbor eligibility policy
   23:     ///     -> immutable eligibility result
   24:     ///
   25:     /// propagated emission vector
   26:     ///     -> every received component evaluated
   27:     ///     -> immutable eligibility vector
   28:     ///     -> eligible and ineligible channels retained
   29:     ///     -> any/all/count summaries derived honestly
   30:     ///
   31:     /// Eligibility must evaluate the received propagated
   32:     /// value. It must not substitute the resolved magnitude
   33:     /// or normalized magnitude.
   34:     ///
   35:     /// Exact Gate 5 source, vector, component, relationship,
   36:     /// distance, and magnitude provenance must remain intact.
   37:     ///
   38:     /// Consumer interpretation, receiver-state mutation,
   39:     /// cross-channel transformation, and QSL remain outside
   40:     /// this gate.
   41:     /// </summary>
   42:     public sealed class EmitterGate6EligibilityTests
   43:     {
   44:         private readonly ITestOutputHelper _testOutputHelper;
   45: 
   46:         public EmitterGate6EligibilityTests(
   47:             ITestOutputHelper testOutputHelper)
   48:         {
   49:             _testOutputHelper =
   50:                 testOutputHelper;
   51:         }

   53:         [Fact]
   54:         public void Scalar_eligibility_evaluates_received_propagated_value()
   55:         {
   56:             InitializeEmissionReport();
   57: 
   58:             TestLog.Section(
   59:                 "EMITTER GATE 6 - SCALAR ELIGIBILITY");
   60: 
   61:             TestLog.Test(
   62:                 "Eligibility evaluates received intensity rather than resolved source magnitude.");
   63: 
   64:             var propagated =
   65:                 CreateScalarPropagatedEmission(
   66:                     resolvedValue: 0.80,
   67:                     distance: 2.0,
   68:                     decay: 0.50);
   69: 
   70:             const double threshold =
   71:                 0.30;
   72: 
   73:             var eligibility =
   74:                 new EmissionEligibility(
   75:                     new MinimumIntensityEligibility(
   76:                         threshold));
   77: 
   78:             var result =
   79:                 eligibility.Evaluate(
   80:                     propagated);
   81: 
   82:             TestLog.State(
   83:                 $"Resolved value = " +
   84:                 $"{propagated.ResolvedValue:R}");
   85: 
   86:             TestLog.State(
   87:                 $"Received value = " +
   88:                 $"{propagated.Value:R}");
   89: 
   90:             TestLog.State(
   91:                 $"Eligibility threshold = " +
   92:                 $"{threshold:R}");
   93: 
   94:             TestLog.State(
   95:                 $"Eligibility evaluated value = " +
   96:                 $"{result.EvaluatedValue:R}");
   97: 
   98:             TestLog.State(
   99:                 $"Eligible = {result.IsEligible}");
  100: 
  101:             Assert.True(
  102:                 propagated.ResolvedValue >
  103:                 threshold);
  104: 
  105:             Assert.True(
  106:                 propagated.Value <
  107:                 threshold);
  108: 
  109:             Assert.Same(
  110:                 propagated,
  111:                 result.Emission);
  112: 
  113:             Assert.Equal(
  114:                 propagated.Value,
  115:                 result.EvaluatedValue,
  116:                 12);
  117: 
  118:             Assert.False(
  119:                 result.IsEligible);
  120: 
  121:             TestLog.Pass(
  122:                 "Eligibility ignored the stronger resolved magnitude and evaluated the received intensity.");
  123: 
  124:             TestLog.Pass(
  125:                 "A source emission above threshold remained ineligible after propagation attenuated it below threshold.");
  126: 
  127:             PublishLatestReport();
  128: 
  129:             WriteFinished(
  130:                 "SCALAR ELIGIBILITY");
  131:         }

  187:         public void Vector_eligibility_evaluates_every_received_channel()
  188:         {
  189:             InitializeEmissionReport();
  190: 
  191:             TestLog.Section(
  192:                 "EMITTER GATE 6 - VECTOR ELIGIBILITY");
  193: 
  194:             TestLog.Test(
  195:                 "Every propagated vector channel receives an independent eligibility decision.");
  196: 
  197:             const double threshold =
  198:                 0.10;
  199: 
  200:             var propagated =
  201:                 CreateFiveChannelPropagatedVector();
  202:

  208:             var result =

  211:

  216:                 $"Threshold = {threshold:R}");

  231:

  233:                 propagated.Dimension,
  234:                 result.Dimension);

  237:                 5,

  243: 
  244:             Assert.True(
  245:                 result.AnyEligible);
  246: 
  247:             Assert.False(
  248:                 result.AllEligible);
  249: 
  250:             for (var index = 0;
  251:                  index < result.Dimension;
  252:                  index++)
  253:             {

  284: 
  285:             Assert.True(
  286:                 result.Emissions[0].IsEligible);
  287:

  469:         [Fact]
  470:         public void Eligibility_preserves_complete_gate5_provenance_chain()
  471:         {
  472:             InitializeEmissionReport();
  473: 
  474:             TestLog.Section(
  475:                 "EMITTER GATE 6 - PROVENANCE CONTINUITY");
  476: 
  477:             TestLog.Test(
  478:                 "Eligibility preserves the complete propagated-to-emitter provenance chain.");
  479: 
  480:             var component =
  481:                 new TestComponent(
  482:                     "gate6.provenance.component");
  483: 
  484:             var emitter =
  485:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateEmitter(
  486:                     component);
  487: 
  488:             var receiver =
  489:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
  490:                     component,
  491:                     "gate6.provenance.receiver");
  492: 
  493:             Assert.True(
  494:                 emitter.Neighbors.Add(
  495:                     receiver,
  496:                     "conversation",
  497:                     2.0));
  498: 
  499:             Assert.True(
  500:                 emitter.Neighbors.TryGet(
  501:                     receiver.Id,
  502:                     "conversation",
  503:                     out var relationship));
  504: 
  505:             Assert.NotNull(
  506:                 relationship);
  507: 
  508:             var resolvedVector =
  509:                 new ResolvedEmissionVector(
  510:                     new IResolvedEmission[]
  511:                     {
  512:                         new ResolvedEmission(
  513:                             emitter,
  514:                             "panic",
  515:                             8.4),
  516: 
  517:                         new ResolvedEmission(
  518:                             emitter,
  519:                             "urgency",
  520:                             5.7),
  521: 
  522:                         new ResolvedEmission(
  523:                             emitter,
  524:                             "confusion",
  525:                             2.1),
  526: 
  527:                         new ResolvedEmission(
  528:                             emitter,
  529:                             "hesitation",
  530:                             1.3),
  531: 
  532:                         new ResolvedEmission(
  533:                             emitter,
  534:                             "trust",
  535:                             0.6)
  536:                     });
  537: 
  538:             var propagation =
  539:                 new EmissionVectorPropagation(
  540:                     new ProportionalEmissionNormalization(),
  541:                     new ExponentialDistancePropagation(
  542:                         0.25));
  543: 
  544:             var propagatedVector =
  545:                 propagation.Propagate(
  546:                     resolvedVector,
  547:                     relationship!);
  548: 
  549:             var normalizedVector =
  550:                 propagatedVector.Source;
  551: 
  552:             var eligibility =
  553:                 new EmissionVectorEligibility(
  554:                     new MinimumIntensityEligibility(
  555:                         0.10));
  556: 
  557:             var eligibilityVector =
  558:                 eligibility.Evaluate(
  559:                     propagatedVector);
  560: 
  561:             TestLog.State(
  562:                 $"Eligibility exact propagated source = " +
  563:                 $"{ReferenceEquals(
  564:                     propagatedVector,
  565:                     eligibilityVector.Source)}");
  566: 
  567:             TestLog.State(
  568:                 $"Propagated exact normalized source = " +
  569:                 $"{ReferenceEquals(
  570:                     normalizedVector,
  571:                     eligibilityVector.Source.Source)}");
  572: 
  573:             TestLog.State(
  574:                 $"Normalized exact resolved source = " +
  575:                 $"{ReferenceEquals(
  576:                     resolvedVector,
  577:                     eligibilityVector.Source.Source.Source)}");
  578: 
  579:             TestLog.State(
  580:                 $"Resolved exact emitter source = " +
  581:                 $"{ReferenceEquals(
  582:                     emitter,
  583:                     eligibilityVector.Source.Source.Source.Source)}");
  584: 
  585:             TestLog.State(
  586:                 $"Relationship membership = " +
  587:                 $"{eligibilityVector.Source.Relationship.Membership}");
  588: 
  589:             TestLog.State(
  590:                 $"Frozen propagation distance = " +
  591:                 $"{eligibilityVector.Source.PropagationDistance:R}");
  592: 
  593:             TestLog.State(
  594:                 $"Eligibility dimensions = " +
  595:                 $"{eligibilityVector.Dimension}");
  596: 
  597:             TestLog.State(
  598:                 $"Eligible components = " +
  599:                 $"{eligibilityVector.EligibleCount}");
  600: 
  601:             Assert.Same(
  602:                 propagatedVector,
  603:                 eligibilityVector.Source);
  604: 
  605:             Assert.Same(
  606:                 normalizedVector,
  607:                 eligibilityVector.Source.Source);
  608: 
  609:             Assert.Same(
  610:                 resolvedVector,
  611:                 eligibilityVector.Source.Source.Source);
  612: 
  613:             Assert.Same(
  614:                 emitter,
  615:                 eligibilityVector.Source.Source.Source.Source);
  616: 
  617:             Assert.Same(
  618:                 relationship,
  619:                 eligibilityVector.Source.Relationship);
  620: 
  621:             Assert.Equal(
  622:                 relationship.Distance,
  623:                 eligibilityVector.Source.PropagationDistance,
  624:                 12);
  625: 
  626:             Assert.Equal(
  627:                 resolvedVector.Dimension,
  628:                 eligibilityVector.Dimension);
  629: 
  630:             for (var index = 0;
  631:                  index < eligibilityVector.Dimension;
  632:                  index++)
  633:             {
  634:                 var resolved =
  635:                     resolvedVector.Emissions[index];
  636: 
  637:                 var normalized =
  638:                     normalizedVector.Emissions[index];
  639: 
  640:                 var propagated =
  641:                     propagatedVector.Emissions[index];
  642: 
  643:                 var decision =
  644:                     eligibilityVector.Emissions[index];
  645: 
  646:                 TestLog.State(
  647:                     $"{resolved.Name} | " +
  648:                     $"resolved = {resolved.Value:R} | " +
  649:                     $"normalized = " +
  650:                     $"{normalized.NormalizedValue:R} | " +
  651:                     $"received = {propagated.Value:R} | " +
  652:                     $"evaluated = {decision.EvaluatedValue:R} | " +
  653:                     $"eligible = {decision.IsEligible}");
  654: 
  655:                 Assert.Same(
  656:                     propagated,
  657:                     decision.Emission);
  658: 
  659:                 Assert.Same(
  660:                     resolved,
  661:                     normalized.Emission);
  662: 
  663:                 Assert.Same(
  664:                     resolved,
  665:                     propagated.Emission);
  666: 
  667:                 Assert.Same(
  668:                     relationship,
  669:                     propagated.Relationship);
  670: 
  671:                 Assert.Equal(
  672:                     propagated.PropagationDistance,
  673:                     eligibilityVector.Source.PropagationDistance,
  674:                     12);
  675: 
  676:                 Assert.Equal(
  677:                     resolved.Value,
  678:                     propagated.ResolvedValue,
  679:                     12);
  680: 
  681:                 Assert.Equal(
  682:                     normalized.NormalizedValue,
  683:                     propagated.NormalizedValue!.Value,
  684:                     12);
  685: 
  686:                 Assert.Equal(
  687:                     propagated.Value,
  688:                     decision.EvaluatedValue,
  689:                     12);
  690:             }
  691: 
  692:             TestLog.Pass(
  693:                 "Eligibility retained exact propagated, normalized, resolved, emitter, and relationship provenance.");
  694: 
  695:             TestLog.Pass(
  696:                 "Gate 6 added decisions without replacing or rewriting Gate 5 facts.");
  697: 
  698:             PublishLatestReport();
  699: 
  700:             WriteFinished(
  701:                 "PROVENANCE CONTINUITY");
  702:         }

  704:         [Fact]
  705:         public void Eligibility_vector_snapshots_component_decisions()
  706:         {
  707:             InitializeEmissionReport();
  708: 
  709:             TestLog.Section(
  710:                 "EMITTER GATE 6 - ELIGIBILITY IMMUTABILITY");
  711: 
  712:             TestLog.Test(
  713:                 "Eligibility vector remains stable after caller-owned decision collection mutation.");
  714: 
  715:             var propagated =
  716:                 CreateFiveChannelPropagatedVector();
  717: 
  718:             var scalarEligibility =
  719:                 new EmissionEligibility(
  720:                     new MinimumIntensityEligibility(
  721:                         0.10));
  722: 
  723:             var decisions =
  724:                 new List<IEmissionEligibilityResult>(
  725:                     propagated.Dimension);
  726: 
  727:             for (var index = 0;
  728:                  index < propagated.Dimension;
  729:                  index++)
  730:             {
  731:                 decisions.Add(
  732:                     scalarEligibility.Evaluate(
  733:                         propagated.Emissions[index]));
  734:             }
  735: 
  736:             var vector =
  737:                 new EmissionEligibilityVector(
  738:                     propagated,
  739:                     decisions);
  740: 
  741:             var originalDimension =
  742:                 vector.Dimension;
  743: 
  744:             var originalEligibleCount =
  745:                 vector.EligibleCount;
  746: 
  747:             decisions.Clear();
  748: 
  749:             TestLog.State(
  750:                 $"Caller decision count after mutation = " +
  751:                 $"{decisions.Count}");
  752: 
  753:             TestLog.State(
  754:                 $"Carrier dimension after mutation = " +
  755:                 $"{vector.Dimension}");
  756: 
  757:             TestLog.State(
  758:                 $"Carrier eligible count after mutation = " +
  759:                 $"{vector.EligibleCount}");
  760: 
  761:             Assert.Empty(
  762:                 decisions);
  763: 
  764:             Assert.Equal(
  765:                 originalDimension,
  766:                 vector.Dimension);
  767: 
  768:             Assert.Equal(
  769:                 originalEligibleCount,
  770:                 vector.EligibleCount);
  771: 
  772:             Assert.Equal(
  773:                 propagated.Dimension,
  774:                 vector.Emissions.Count);
  775: 
  776:             Assert.False(
  777:                 vector.Emissions is
  778:                     IEmissionEligibilityResult[]);
  779: 
  780:             TestLog.Pass(
  781:                 "Eligibility vector retained its immutable decision snapshot.");
  782: 
  783:             WriteFinished(
  784:                 "ELIGIBILITY IMMUTABILITY");
  785:         }

 1476:         private static IPropagatedEmission
 1477:             CreateScalarPropagatedEmission(
 1478:                 double resolvedValue,
 1479:                 double distance,
 1480:                 double decay)
 1481:         {
 1482:             var component =
 1483:                 new TestComponent(
 1484:                     "gate6.scalar.component");
 1485: 
 1486:             var emitter =
 1487:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateEmitter(
 1488:                     component);
 1489: 
 1490:             var receiver =
 1491:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
 1492:                     component,
 1493:                     "gate6.scalar.receiver");
 1494: 
 1495:             if (!emitter.Neighbors.Add(
 1496:                     receiver,
 1497:                     "eligibility",
 1498:                     distance))
 1499:             {
 1500:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
 1501:                     "Could not create the scalar eligibility " +
 1502:                     "test relationship.");
 1503:             }
 1504: 
 1505:             if (!emitter.Neighbors.TryGet(
 1506:                     receiver.Id,
 1507:                     "eligibility",
 1508:                     out var relationship) ||
 1509:                 relationship == null)
 1510:             {
 1511:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
 1512:                     "Could not retrieve the scalar eligibility " +
 1513:                     "test relationship.");
 1514:             }
 1515: 
 1516:             var resolved =
 1517:                 new ResolvedEmission(
 1518:                     emitter,
 1519:                     "scalar-signal",
 1520:                     resolvedValue);
 1521: 
 1522:             var propagation =
 1523:                 new EmissionPropagation(
 1524:                     new ExponentialDistancePropagation(
 1525:                         decay));
 1526: 
 1527:             return propagation.Propagate(
 1528:                 resolved,
 1529:                 relationship);
 1530:         }

 1610:         private static IPropagatedEmissionVector
 1611:             CreatePropagatedVector(
 1612:                 int dimension)
 1613:         {
 1614:             if (dimension <= 0)
 1615:             {
 1616:                 throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
 1617:                     nameof(dimension));
 1618:             }
 1619: 
 1620:             var component =
 1621:                 new TestComponent(
 1622:                     "gate6.dimension.component");
 1623: 
 1624:             var emitter =
 1625:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateEmitter(
 1626:                     component);
 1627: 
 1628:             var receiver =
 1629:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateTopologyObject(
 1630:                     component,
 1631:                     "gate6.dimension.receiver");
 1632: 
 1633:             if (!emitter.Neighbors.Add(
 1634:                     receiver,
 1635:                     "dimension",
 1636:                     1.0))
 1637:             {
 1638:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
 1639:                     "Could not create the dimensional " +
 1640:                     "eligibility test relationship.");
 1641:             }
 1642: 
 1643:             if (!emitter.Neighbors.TryGet(
 1644:                     receiver.Id,
 1645:                     "dimension",
 1646:                     out var relationship) ||
 1647:                 relationship == null)
 1648:             {
 1649:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
 1650:                     "Could not retrieve the dimensional " +
 1651:                     "eligibility test relationship.");
 1652:             }
 1653: 
 1654:             var emissions =
 1655:                 new IResolvedEmission[
 1656:                     dimension];
 1657: 
 1658:             for (var index = 0;
 1659:                  index < dimension;
 1660:                  index++)
 1661:             {
 1662:                 emissions[index] =
 1663:                     new ResolvedEmission(
 1664:                         emitter,
 1665:                         $"consumer-property-{index}",
 1666:                         index + 1.0);
 1667:             }
 1668: 
 1669:             var resolved =
 1670:                 new ResolvedEmissionVector(
 1671:                     emissions);
 1672: 
 1673:             var propagation =
 1674:                 new EmissionVectorPropagation(
 1675:                     new ProportionalEmissionNormalization(),
 1676:                     new ExponentialDistancePropagation(
 1677:                         0.50));
 1678: 
 1679:             return propagation.Propagate(
 1680:                 resolved,
 1681:                 relationship);
 1682:         }

   21:         {

   23:             var second = CreateEligibility(0.20, false);
   24:             var third = CreateEligibility(0.30, true);

   28:                 new TestEligibilityVector(

   30:                     second,
   31:                     third,
   32:                     fourth);

   36:                 new EmissionInstructionResolution(

   40:                 resolution.Resolve(

    1: using System;

    9:     /// <summary>
   10:     /// Gate 1 certification for the Wilds emitter surface.
   11:     ///
   12:     /// This gate proves:
   13:     ///
   14:     /// consumer data
   15:     ///     -> emitter
   16:     ///     -> scalar emission
   17:     ///
   18:     /// while preserving ordinary Wilds identity and topology.

   34:                 WildsFixtureFactory.CreateEmitter(
   35:                     component,
   36:                     properties:
   37:                         new Dictionary<string, object?>
   38:                         {
   39:                             ["appetite"] = 1.6
   40:                         });
   41: 
   42:             var emitted =
   43:                 emitter.TryEmit(
   44:                     "appetite",

   46:
