    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using System.Threading;
    4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
    5: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    6: using WildsEngine.Core.Processing;
    7: using WildsEngine.Tests.Logging;
    8: using WildsEngine.Tests.Registry;
    9: using Xunit;
   10: 
   11: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Tests
   12: {
   13:     /// <summary>
   14:     /// Certifies the current complete processing route:
   15:     ///
   16:     /// WildsEngine
   17:     ///     -> instruction processor lease
   18:     ///     -> instruction registry
   19:     ///     -> task processor lease
   20:     ///     -> task registry
   21:     ///     -> processor return
   22:     ///     -> instruction removal
   23:     ///
   24:     /// These tests intentionally use the current composition surface.
   25:     /// They do not invent the future WildsEngine.Process(...) contract.
   26:     /// </summary>
   27:     public static class EndToEndProcessingTests
   28:     {
   29:         private static readonly List<string> Passed =
   30:             new List<string>();
   31: 
   32:         public static async Task RunAllAsync()
   33:         {
   34:             Passed.Clear();
   35: 
   36:             TestLog.Write(
   37:                 "=== End-to-End Processing Tests ===");
   38: 
   39:             await RunAsync(
   40:                     "Instruction flows through complete processing route",
   41:                     InstructionFlowsThroughCompleteProcessingRoute)
   42:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
   43: 
   44:             await RunAsync(
   45:                     "Processing failure returns processors and removes instruction",
   46:                     ProcessingFailureReturnsProcessorsAndRemovesInstruction)
   47:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
   48: 
   49:             await RunAsync(
   50:                     "Processing cancellation returns processors and removes instruction",
   51:                     ProcessingCancellationReturnsProcessorsAndRemovesInstruction)
   52:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
   53: 
   54:             TestLog.Write(
   55:                 $"End-to-end processing tests passed: " +
   56:                 $"{Passed.Count}/{Passed.Count}");
   57:         }
   58: 
   59: private static async Task
   60:     InstructionFlowsThroughCompleteProcessingRoute()
   61: {
   62:     var component =
   63:         CreateComponent(
   64:             "certification.end-to-end.success");
   65: 
   66:     using var engine =
   67:         CreateEngine(
   68:             component);
   69: 
   70:     Assert.True(
   71:         engine.Initialize());
   72: 
   73:     var instruction =
   74:         new SetContextVariableInstruction(
   75:             "PlayerHealth",
   76:             10);
   77: 
   78:     IInstructionsRegistry? observedInstructionRegistry =
   79:         null;
   80: 
   81:     ITaskRegistry? observedTaskRegistry =
   82:         null;
   83: 
   84:     ITaskProcessor? observedTaskProcessor =
   85:         null;
   86: 
   87:     SetContextVariable? observedTask =
   88:         null;
   89: 
   90:     TestLog.Write(
   91:         $"[PARK] Instruction {instruction.Id}");
   92: 
   93:     var result =
   94:         await engine.ExecuteInstructionAsync<int>(
   95:                 async (
   96:                     instructionProcessor,
   97:                     cancellationToken) =>
   98:                 {
   99:                     cancellationToken
  100:                         .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
  101: 
  102:                     Assert.Same(
  103:                         component,
  104:                         instructionProcessor.Component);
  105: 
  106:                     observedInstructionRegistry =
  107:                         instructionProcessor.Registry;
  108: 
  109:                     Assert.Same(
  110:                         component,
  111:                         observedInstructionRegistry.Component);
  112: 
  113:                     Assert.True(
  114:                         observedInstructionRegistry.Register(
  115:                             instruction));
  116: 
  117:                     Assert.True(
  118:                         observedInstructionRegistry.TryGet(
  119:                             instruction.Id,
  120:                             out var parkedInstruction));
  121: 
  122:                     Assert.Same(
  123:                         instruction,
  124:                         parkedInstruction);
  125: 
  126:                     TestLog.Write(
  127:                         $"[READ] Instruction {instruction.Id}");
  128: 
  129:                     try
  130:                     {
  131:                         using var taskLease =
  132:                             await instructionProcessor
  133:                                 .RentTaskProcessorAsync(
  134:                                     cancellationToken)
  135:                                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  136: 
  137:                         cancellationToken
  138:                             .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
  139: 
  140:                         observedTaskProcessor =
  141:                             taskLease.Instance;
  142: 
  143:                         observedTaskRegistry =
  144:                             observedTaskProcessor.Registry;
  145: 
  146:                         Assert.NotNull(
  147:                             observedTaskProcessor);
  148: 
  149:                         Assert.NotNull(
  150:                             observedTaskRegistry);
  151: 
  152:                         Assert.Same(
  153:                             component,
  154:                             observedTaskProcessor.Component);
  155: 
  156:                         Assert.Same(
  157:                             component,
  158:                             observedTaskRegistry.Component);
  159: 
  160:                         observedTask =
  161:                             new SetContextVariable(
  162:                                 component,
  163:                                 component.State.Context,
  164:                                 instruction.Key,
  165:                                 instruction.Value);
  166: 
  167:                         Assert.Same(
  168:                             component,
  169:                             observedTask.Component);
  170: 
  171:                         Assert.Same(
  172:                             component.State.Context,
  173:                             observedTask.Context);
  174: 
  175:                         Assert.True(
  176:                             observedTaskProcessor.RegisterTask(
  177:                                 observedTask));
  178: 
  179:                         Assert.True(
  180:                             observedTaskProcessor.ContainsTask(
  181:                                 observedTask.Id));
  182: 
  183:                         Assert.True(
  184:                             observedTaskProcessor.TryGetTask(
  185:                                 observedTask.Id,
  186:                                 out var parkedTask));
  187: 
  188:                         Assert.Same(
  189:                             observedTask,
  190:                             parkedTask);
  191: 
  192:                         TestLog.Write(
  193:                             $"[TASK] Parked task {observedTask.Id}");
  194: 
  195:                         try
  196:                         {
  197:                             cancellationToken
  198:                                 .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
  199: 
  200:                             Assert.True(
  201:                                 component.State.Process(
  202:                                     instruction));
  203: 
  204:                             Assert.True(
  205:                                 component.State.Context.Variables
  206:                                     .TryGetValue(
  207:                                         instruction.Key,
  208:                                         out var processedValue));
  209: 
  210:                             Assert.Equal(
  211:                                 instruction.Value,
  212:                                 processedValue);
  213: 
  214:                             TestLog.State(
  215:                                 $"{instruction.Key}={processedValue}");
  216: 
  217:                             return Assert.IsType<int>(
  218:                                 processedValue);
  219:                         }
  220:                         finally
  221:                         {
  222:                             Assert.True(
  223:                                 observedTaskProcessor.RemoveTask(
  224:                                     observedTask.Id));
  225: 
  226:                             TestLog.Write(
  227:                                 $"[TASK] Removed task {observedTask.Id}");
  228:                         }
  229:                     }
  230:                     finally
  231:                     {
  232:                         Assert.True(
  233:                             observedInstructionRegistry.Remove(
  234:                                 instruction.Id));
  235: 
  236:                         TestLog.Write(
  237:                             $"[REMOVE] Instruction {instruction.Id}");
  238:                     }
  239:                 })
  240:             .ConfigureAwait(false);
  241: 
  242:     Assert.Equal(
  243:         10,
  244:         result);
  245: 
  246:     Assert.NotNull(
  247:         observedInstructionRegistry);
  248: 
  249:     Assert.NotNull(
  250:         observedTaskProcessor);
  251: 
  252:     Assert.NotNull(
  253:         observedTaskRegistry);
  254: 
  255:     Assert.NotNull(
  256:         observedTask);
  257: 
  258:     Assert.False(
  259:         observedInstructionRegistry.TryGet(
  260:             instruction.Id,
  261:             out _));
  262: 
  263:     Assert.False(
  264:         observedTaskProcessor.TryGetTask(
  265:             observedTask.Id,
  266:             out _));
  267: 
  268:     Assert.True(
  269:         component.State.Context.Variables
  270:             .TryGetValue(
  271:                 "PlayerHealth",
  272:                 out var finalPlayerHealth));
  273: 
  274:     Assert.Equal(
  275:         10,
  276:         Assert.IsType<int>(
  277:             finalPlayerHealth));
  278: 
  279:     Assert.Equal(
  280:         0,
  281:         engine.Instructions.ActiveCount);
  282: 
  283:     Assert.Equal(
  284:         1,
  285:         engine.Instructions.AvailableCount);
  286: 
  287:     TestLog.State(
  288:         "Successful stateful route complete | " +
  289:         $"PlayerHealth={finalPlayerHealth}, " +
  290:         $"Active={engine.Instructions.ActiveCount}, " +
  291:         $"Available={engine.Instructions.AvailableCount}, " +
  292:         $"Created={engine.Instructions.CreatedCount}");
  293: }

  295:         private static async Task
  296:             ProcessingFailureReturnsProcessorsAndRemovesInstruction()
  297:         {
  298:             var component =
  299:                 CreateComponent(
  300:                     "certification.end-to-end.failure");
  301: 
  302:             using var engine =
  303:                 CreateEngine(
  304:                     component);
  305: 
  306:             Assert.True(
  307:                 engine.Initialize());
  308: 
  309:             var instruction =
  310:                 new SetContextVariableInstruction(
  311:                     "PlayerHealth",
  312:                     10);
  313: 
  314:             IInstructionsRegistry? observedInstructionRegistry =
  315:                 null;
  316: 
  317:             ITaskRegistry? observedTaskRegistry =
  318:                 null;
  319: 
  320:             TestLog.Write(
  321:                 $"[PARK] Failure instruction {instruction.Id}");
  322: 
  323:             await Assert.ThrowsAsync<ExpectedProcessingException>(
  324:                 async () =>
  325:                 {
  326:                     await engine.ExecuteInstructionAsync<int>(
  327:                             async (
  328:                                 instructionProcessor,
  329:                                 cancellationToken) =>
  330:                             {
  331:                                 Assert.Same(
  332:                                     component,
  333:                                     instructionProcessor.Component);
  334: 
  335:                                 observedInstructionRegistry =
  336:                                     instructionProcessor.Registry;
  337: 
  338:                                 Assert.Same(
  339:                                     component,
  340:                                     observedInstructionRegistry.Component);
  341: 
  342:                                 Assert.True(
  343:                                     observedInstructionRegistry.Register(
  344:                                         instruction));
  345: 
  346:                                 try
  347:                                 {
  348:                                     using var taskLease =
  349:                                         await instructionProcessor
  350:                                             .RentTaskProcessorAsync(
  351:                                                 cancellationToken)
  352:                                             .ConfigureAwait(false);
  353: 
  354:                                     Assert.Same(
  355:                                         component,
  356:                                         taskLease.Instance.Component);
  357: 
  358:                                     observedTaskRegistry =
  359:                                         taskLease.Instance.Registry;
  360: 
  361:                                     Assert.NotNull(
  362:                                         observedTaskRegistry);
  363: 
  364:                                     Assert.Same(
  365:                                         component,
  366:                                         observedTaskRegistry.Component);
  367: 
  368:                                     throw new ExpectedProcessingException();
  369:                                 }
  370:                                 finally
  371:                                 {
  372:                                     Assert.True(
  373:                                         observedInstructionRegistry.Remove(
  374:                                             instruction.Id));
  375: 
  376:                                     TestLog.Write(
  377:                                         $"[REMOVE] Failure instruction " +
  378:                                         $"{instruction.Id}");
  379:                                 }
  380:                             })
  381:                         .ConfigureAwait(false);
  382:                 });
  383: 
  384:             TestLog.Expected(
  385:                 nameof(ExpectedProcessingException));
  386: 
  387:             Assert.NotNull(
  388:                 observedInstructionRegistry);
  389: 
  390:             Assert.NotNull(
  391:                 observedTaskRegistry);
  392: 
  393:             Assert.False(
  394:                 observedInstructionRegistry.TryGet(
  395:                     instruction.Id,
  396:                     out _));
  397: 
  398:             Assert.Equal(
  399:                 0,
  400:                 engine.Instructions.ActiveCount);
  401: 
  402:             Assert.Equal(
  403:                 1,
  404:                 engine.Instructions.AvailableCount);
  405: 
  406:             TestLog.State(
  407:                 "Failure cleanup complete | " +
  408:                 $"Active={engine.Instructions.ActiveCount}, " +
  409:                 $"Available={engine.Instructions.AvailableCount}");
  410: 
  411:             var recoveryResult =
  412:                 await ExecuteRecoveryAsync(
  413:                         engine,
  414:                         component)
  415:                     .ConfigureAwait(false);
  416: 
  417:             Assert.Equal(
  418:                 42,
  419:                 recoveryResult);
  420: 
  421:             Assert.Equal(
  422:                 0,
  423:                 engine.Instructions.ActiveCount);
  424: 
  425:             TestLog.State(
  426:                 "Engine recovered after processing failure");
  427:         }

  429:         private static async Task
  430:             ProcessingCancellationReturnsProcessorsAndRemovesInstruction()
  431:         {
  432:             var component =
  433:                 CreateComponent(
  434:                     "certification.end-to-end.cancellation");
  435: 
  436:             using var engine =
  437:                 CreateEngine(
  438:                     component);
  439: 
  440:             Assert.True(
  441:                 engine.Initialize());
  442: 
  443:             var instruction =
  444:                 new SetContextVariableInstruction(
  445:                     "PlayerHealth",
  446:                     10);
  447: 
  448:             IInstructionsRegistry? observedInstructionRegistry =
  449:                 null;
  450: 
  451:             ITaskRegistry? observedTaskRegistry =
  452:                 null;
  453: 
  454:             var enteredProcessing =
  455:                 new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
  456:                     TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
  457: 
  458:             using var cancellation =
  459:                 new CancellationTokenSource();
  460: 
  461:             TestLog.Write(
  462:                 $"[PARK] Cancellation instruction {instruction.Id}");
  463: 
  464:             var processing =
  465:                 engine.ExecuteInstructionAsync<int>(
  466:                         async (
  467:                             instructionProcessor,
  468:                             cancellationToken) =>
  469:                         {
  470:                             Assert.Same(
  471:                                 component,
  472:                                 instructionProcessor.Component);
  473: 
  474:                             observedInstructionRegistry =
  475:                                 instructionProcessor.Registry;
  476: 
  477:                             Assert.Same(
  478:                                 component,
  479:                                 observedInstructionRegistry.Component);
  480: 
  481:                             Assert.True(
  482:                                 observedInstructionRegistry.Register(
  483:                                     instruction));
  484: 
  485:                             try
  486:                             {
  487:                                 using var taskLease =
  488:                                     await instructionProcessor
  489:                                         .RentTaskProcessorAsync(
  490:                                             cancellationToken)
  491:                                         .ConfigureAwait(false);
  492: 
  493:                                 Assert.Same(
  494:                                     component,
  495:                                     taskLease.Instance.Component);
  496: 
  497:                                 observedTaskRegistry =
  498:                                     taskLease.Instance.Registry;
  499: 
  500:                                 Assert.NotNull(
  501:                                     observedTaskRegistry);
  502: 
  503:                                 Assert.Same(
  504:                                     component,
  505:                                     observedTaskRegistry.Component);
  506: 
  507:                                 enteredProcessing.TrySetResult(
  508:                                     true);
  509: 
  510:                                 await Task.Delay(
  511:                                         Timeout.Infinite,
  512:                                         cancellationToken)
  513:                                     .ConfigureAwait(false);
  514: 
  515:                                 return 10;
  516:                             }
  517:                             finally
  518:                             {
  519:                                 Assert.True(
  520:                                     observedInstructionRegistry.Remove(
  521:                                         instruction.Id));
  522: 
  523:                                 TestLog.Write(
  524:                                     $"[REMOVE] Cancellation instruction " +
  525:                                     $"{instruction.Id}");
  526:                             }
  527:                         },
  528:                         cancellation.Token)
  529:                     .AsTask();
  530: 
  531:             await enteredProcessing.Task
  532:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  533: 
  534:             TestLog.Write(
  535:                 "[TASK] Cancelling active processing route");
  536: 
  537:             cancellation.Cancel();
  538: 
  539:             await Assert.ThrowsAnyAsync<OperationCanceledException>(
  540:                 async () =>
  541:                 {
  542:                     await processing
  543:                         .ConfigureAwait(false);
  544:                 });
  545: 
  546:             TestLog.Expected(
  547:                 nameof(OperationCanceledException));
  548: 
  549:             Assert.NotNull(
  550:                 observedInstructionRegistry);
  551: 
  552:             Assert.NotNull(
  553:                 observedTaskRegistry);
  554: 
  555:             Assert.False(
  556:                 observedInstructionRegistry.TryGet(
  557:                     instruction.Id,
  558:                     out _));
  559: 
  560:             Assert.Equal(
  561:                 0,
  562:                 engine.Instructions.ActiveCount);
  563: 
  564:             Assert.Equal(
  565:                 1,
  566:                 engine.Instructions.AvailableCount);
  567: 
  568:             TestLog.State(
  569:                 "Cancellation cleanup complete | " +
  570:                 $"Active={engine.Instructions.ActiveCount}, " +
  571:                 $"Available={engine.Instructions.AvailableCount}");
  572: 
  573:             var recoveryResult =
  574:                 await ExecuteRecoveryAsync(
  575:                         engine,
  576:                         component)
  577:                     .ConfigureAwait(false);
  578: 
  579:             Assert.Equal(
  580:                 42,
  581:                 recoveryResult);
  582: 
  583:             Assert.Equal(
  584:                 0,
  585:                 engine.Instructions.ActiveCount);
  586: 
  587:             TestLog.State(
  588:                 "Engine recovered after processing cancellation");
  589:         }
  590: 
  591:         private static async Task<int> ExecuteRecoveryAsync(
  592:             Core.WildsEngine engine,
  593:             IComponent component)
  594:         {
  595:             return await engine.ExecuteInstructionAsync<int>(
  596:                     async (
  597:                         instructionProcessor,
  598:                         cancellationToken) =>
  599:                     {
  600:                         Assert.Same(
  601:                             component,
  602:                             instructionProcessor.Component);
  603: 
  604:                         Assert.Same(
  605:                             component,
  606:                             instructionProcessor.Registry.Component);
  607: 
  608:                         using var taskLease =
  609:                             await instructionProcessor
  610:                                 .RentTaskProcessorAsync(
  611:                                     cancellationToken)
  612:                                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  613: 
  614:                         Assert.NotNull(
  615:                             taskLease.Instance);
  616: 
  617:                         Assert.NotNull(
  618:                             taskLease.Instance.Registry);
  619: 
  620:                         Assert.Same(
  621:                             component,
  622:                             taskLease.Instance.Component);
  623: 
  624:                         Assert.Same(
  625:                             component,
  626:                             taskLease.Instance.Registry.Component);
  627: 
  628:                         return 42;
  629:                     })
  630:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  631:         }
  632: 
  633:         private static Core.WildsEngine CreateEngine(
  634:             IComponent component)
  635:         {
  636:             return new Core.WildsEngine(
  637:                 component,
  638:                 CreateOptions());
  639:         }
  640: 
  641:         private static IComponent CreateComponent(
  642:             string layer)
  643:         {
  644:             return new TestComponent(
  645:                 layer);
  646:         }
  647:

  649:         {

  651:             {
  652:                 Layer =
  653:                     "certification.end-to-end",
  654: 
  655:                 RetainedInstructionsProcessors =
  656:                     1,
  657: 
  658:                 ConcurrentInstructionsProcessors =
  659:                     1,
  660: 
  661:                 RetainedTaskProcessors =
  662:                     1,
  663: 
  664:                 ConcurrentTaskProcessors =
  665:                     1
  666:             };
  667:         }
  668: 
  669:         private static async Task RunAsync(
  670:             string name,
  671:             Func<Task> test)
  672:         {
  673:             TestLog.Test(
  674:                 name);
  675: 
  676:             try
  677:             {
  678:                 await test()
  679:                     .ConfigureAwait(false);
  680: 
  681:                 Passed.Add(
  682:                     name);
  683: 
  684:                 TestLog.Pass(
  685:                     name);
  686:             }
  687:             catch (Exception exception)
  688:             {
  689:                 TestLog.Fail(
  690:                     name,
  691:                     exception);
  692: 
  693:                 throw;
  694:             }
  695:         }

   82:                         catch (OperationCanceledException)

   89: 
   90:                             throw;
   91:                         }
   92: 
   93:                         return forbiddenResult;
   94:                     },
   95:                     cancellation.Token)

  100:

  105:             "Cancelling the request after active execution has begun.");

  108:

  110:             .ConfigureAwait(false);
  111:

  196:     [Fact]
  197:     public async Task
  198:         EngineRecoversAfterActiveExecuteAsyncCancellation()
  199:     {
  200:         TestLog.Section(
  201:             "WILDSENGINE ACTIVE CANCELLATION RECOVERY");
  202: 
  203:         TestLog.Test(
  204:             "Engine accepts successful work after an actively cancelled request.");
  205: 
  206:         var component =
  207:             CreateComponent(
  208:                 "execute.active-cancellation-recovery");
  209: 
  210:         using var engine =
  211:             CreateEngine(
  212:                 component);
  213: 
  214:         Assert.True(
  215:             engine.Initialize());
  216: 
  217:         using var cancellation =
  218:             new CancellationTokenSource();
  219: 
  220:         var enteredOperation =
  221:             new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
  222:                 TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
  223: 
  224:         var cancelledRequest =
  225:             new TestRuntimeObject(
  226:                 "cancelled-request");
  227: 
  228:         var cancelledExecution =
  229:             engine.ExecuteAsync(
  230:                     cancelledRequest,
  231:                     async (
  232:                         observedRequest,
  233:                         cancellationToken) =>
  234:                     {
  235:                         Assert.Same(
  236:                             cancelledRequest,
  237:                             observedRequest);
  238: 
  239:                         enteredOperation.TrySetResult(
  240:                             true);
  241: 
  242:                         await Task.Delay(
  243:                                 Timeout.Infinite,
  244:                                 cancellationToken)
  245:                             .ConfigureAwait(false);
  246: 
  247:                         return new TestRuntimeObject(
  248:                             "must-not-complete");
  249:                     },
  250:                     cancellation.Token)
  251:                 .AsTask();
  252: 
  253:         await enteredOperation.Task
  254:             .ConfigureAwait(false);
  255: 
  256:         TestLog.Task(
  257:             "Cancelling active execution.");
  258: 
  259:         cancellation.Cancel();
  260: 
  261:         var cancelledMoment =
  262:             await cancelledExecution
  263:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  264: 
  265:         Assert.Equal(
  266:             MomentOutcome.Cancelled,
  267:             cancelledMoment.Outcome);
  268: 
  269:         Assert.Null(
  270:             cancelledMoment.Result);
  271: 
  272:         Assert.Null(
  273:             cancelledMoment.Exception);
  274: 
  275:         Assert.Single(
  276:             cancelledMoment.WorkUnitIds);
  277: 
  278:         Assert.Equal(
  279:             1,
  280:             engine.Timeline.Count);
  281: 
  282:         var recoveryRequest =
  283:             new TestRuntimeObject(
  284:                 "recovery-request");
  285: 
  286:         var recoveryResult =
  287:             new TestRuntimeObject(
  288:                 "recovery-result");
  289: 
  290:         TestLog.Task(
  291:             "Submitting recovery work through the same engine.");
  292: 
  293:         var completedMoment =
  294:             await engine.ExecuteAsync(
  295:                     recoveryRequest,
  296:                     (
  297:                         observedRequest,
  298:                         cancellationToken) =>
  299:                     {
  300:                         cancellationToken
  301:                             .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
  302: 
  303:                         Assert.Same(
  304:                             recoveryRequest,
  305:                             observedRequest);
  306: 
  307:                         return new ValueTask<object?>(
  308:                             recoveryResult);
  309:                     })
  310:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  311: 
  312:         Assert.Equal(
  313:             MomentOutcome.Completed,
  314:             completedMoment.Outcome);
  315: 
  316:         Assert.Same(
  317:             recoveryResult,
  318:             completedMoment.Result);
  319: 
  320:         Assert.Null(
  321:             completedMoment.Exception);
  322: 
  323:         Assert.Single(
  324:             completedMoment.WorkUnitIds);
  325: 
  326:         Assert.NotEqual(
  327:             cancelledMoment.PulseId,
  328:             completedMoment.PulseId);
  329: 
  330:         Assert.NotEqual(
  331:             cancelledMoment.WorkUnitIds[0],
  332:             completedMoment.WorkUnitIds[0]);
  333: 
  334:         Assert.Equal(
  335:             2,
  336:             engine.Timeline.Count);
  337: 
  338:         Assert.Same(
  339:             cancelledMoment,
  340:             engine.Timeline.Moments[0]);
  341: 
  342:         Assert.Same(
  343:             completedMoment,
  344:             engine.Timeline.Moments[1]);
  345: 
  346:         Assert.Equal(
  347:             MomentOutcome.Cancelled,
  348:             engine.Timeline.Moments[0].Outcome);
  349: 
  350:         Assert.Equal(
  351:             MomentOutcome.Completed,
  352:             engine.Timeline.Moments[1].Outcome);
  353: 
  354:         Assert.Equal(
  355:             1,
  356:             engine.Epoch.Count);
  357: 
  358:         Assert.Same(
  359:             engine.Timeline,
  360:             engine.Epoch.Timelines[0]);
  361: 
  362:         Assert.Equal(
  363:             2,
  364:             engine.Epoch
  365:                 .Timelines[0]
  366:                 .Moments
  367:                 .Count);
  368: 
  369:         TestLog.State(
  370:             "Timeline outcomes = " +
  371:             $"{engine.Timeline.Moments[0].Outcome} -> " +
  372:             $"{engine.Timeline.Moments[1].Outcome}");
  373: 
  374:         TestLog.Pass(
  375:             "The engine recovered after active cancellation.");
  376: 
  377:         TestLog.Pass(
  378:             "Cancelled and completed requests remained distinct in history.");
  379:     }

  381:     [Fact]
  382:     public async Task
  383:         CancellationAfterOperationResultPreventsFalseSuccess()
  384:     {
  385:         TestLog.Section(
  386:             "WILDSENGINE POST-OPERATION CANCELLATION");
  387: 
  388:         TestLog.Test(
  389:             "Cancellation after operation work but before completion prevents false success.");
  390: 
  391:         var component =
  392:             CreateComponent(
  393:                 "execute.post-operation-cancellation");
  394: 
  395:         using var engine =
  396:             CreateEngine(
  397:                 component);
  398: 
  399:         Assert.True(
  400:             engine.Initialize());
  401: 
  402:         using var cancellation =
  403:             new CancellationTokenSource();
  404: 
  405:         var operationEntered =
  406:             new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
  407:                 TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
  408: 
  409:         var allowOperationReturn =
  410:             new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
  411:                 TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
  412: 
  413:         var request =
  414:             new TestRuntimeObject(
  415:                 "post-operation-cancellation-request");
  416: 
  417:         var forbiddenResult =
  418:             new TestRuntimeObject(
  419:                 "completed-operation-result");
  420: 
  421:         var execution =
  422:             engine.ExecuteAsync(
  423:                     request,
  424:                     async (
  425:                         observedRequest,
  426:                         cancellationToken) =>
  427:                     {
  428:                         Assert.Same(
  429:                             request,
  430:                             observedRequest);
  431: 
  432:                         operationEntered.TrySetResult(
  433:                             true);
  434: 
  435:                         await allowOperationReturn.Task
  436:                             .ConfigureAwait(false);
  437: 
  438:                         /*
  439:                          * Deliberately return a value without checking
  440:                          * the token here.
  441:                          *
  442:                          * WildsEngine.ExecuteAsync must perform its own
  443:                          * post-operation cancellation check before it
  444:                          * completes the WorkUnit.
  445:                          */
  446:                         return forbiddenResult;
  447:                     },
  448:                     cancellation.Token)
  449:                 .AsTask();
  450: 
  451:         await operationEntered.Task
  452:             .ConfigureAwait(false);
  453: 
  454:         TestLog.Task(
  455:             "Cancelling after the operation entered but before it returned.");
  456: 
  457:         cancellation.Cancel();
  458: 
  459:         allowOperationReturn.TrySetResult(
  460:             true);
  461: 
  462:         var moment =
  463:             await execution
  464:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  465: 
  466:         Assert.Equal(
  467:             MomentOutcome.Cancelled,
  468:             moment.Outcome);
  469: 
  470:         Assert.Null(
  471:             moment.Result);
  472: 
  473:         Assert.Null(
  474:             moment.Exception);
  475: 
  476:         Assert.Single(
  477:             moment.WorkUnitIds);
  478: 
  479:         Assert.Single(
  480:             engine.Timeline.Moments);
  481: 
  482:         Assert.Same(
  483:             moment,
  484:             engine.Timeline.Moments[0]);
  485: 
  486:         Assert.False(
  487:             ReferenceEquals(
  488:                 forbiddenResult,
  489:                 moment.Result));
  490: 
  491:         TestLog.State(
  492:             $"Moment outcome = {moment.Outcome}");
  493: 
  494:         TestLog.Pass(
  495:             "Post-operation cancellation prevented false successful completion.");
  496:     }

  498:     [Fact]
  499: public async Task
  500:     ShutdownDuringActiveExecutionAllowsHonestCompletionAndRejectsNewWork()
  501: {
  502:     TestLog.Section(
  503:         "WILDSENGINE SHUTDOWN DURING ACTIVE EXECUTION");
  504: 
  505:     TestLog.Test(
  506:         "Shutdown rejects new work while allowing active work to finish honestly.");
  507: 
  508:     var component =
  509:         CreateComponent(
  510:             "execute.active-shutdown");
  511: 
  512:     using var engine =
  513:         CreateEngine(
  514:             component);
  515: 
  516:     Assert.True(
  517:         engine.Initialize());
  518: 
  519:     var enteredOperation =
  520:         new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
  521:             TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
  522: 
  523:     var allowCompletion =
  524:         new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
  525:             TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
  526: 
  527:     var request =
  528:         new TestRuntimeObject(
  529:             "active-shutdown-request");
  530: 
  531:     var result =
  532:         new TestRuntimeObject(
  533:             "active-shutdown-result");
  534: 
  535:     TestLog.Task(
  536:         "Starting work that remains active until explicitly released.");
  537:

  539:         engine.ExecuteAsync(
  540:                 request,
  541:                 async (
  542:                     observedRequest,
  543:                     cancellationToken) =>

  545:                     cancellationToken
  546:                         .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
  547: 
  548:                     Assert.Same(
  549:                         request,
  550:                         observedRequest);
  551: 
  552:                     enteredOperation.TrySetResult(
  553:                         true);
  554: 
  555:                     TestLog.State(
  556:                         "ExecuteAsync operation entered active work.");
  557: 
  558:                     await allowCompletion.Task
  559:                         .ConfigureAwait(false);

  562:                         .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();

  565:                         "Active operation was released after shutdown.");

  567:                     return result;
  568:                 })
  569:             .AsTask();

  571:     await enteredOperation.Task
  572:         .ConfigureAwait(false);
  573: 
  574:     Assert.False(
  575:         activeExecution.IsCompleted);
  576: 
  577:     Assert.True(
  578:         engine.IsInitialized);
  579: 
  580:     Assert.Equal(
  581:         0,
  582:         engine.Timeline.Count);
  583: 
  584:     TestLog.Task(
  585:         "Shutting down the engine while the request remains active.");
  586: 
  587:     var shutdown =
  588:         engine.Shutdown();
  589: 
  590:     Assert.True(
  591:         shutdown);
  592: 
  593:     Assert.False(
  594:         engine.IsInitialized);
  595: 
  596:     Assert.False(
  597:         activeExecution.IsCompleted);
  598: 
  599:     Assert.Equal(
  600:         0,
  601:         engine.Timeline.Count);
  602: 
  603:     TestLog.Pass(
  604:         "Shutdown did not silently discard or prematurely complete active work.");
  605: 
  606:     TestLog.Task(
  607:         "Verifying shutdown rejects new work.");
  608: 
  609:     await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(
  610:         async () =>
  611:         {
  612:             await engine.ExecuteAsync(
  613:                     new TestRuntimeObject(
  614:                         "must-not-start"),
  615:                     (
  616:                         _,
  617:                         _) =>
  618:                         new ValueTask<object?>(
  619:                             new TestRuntimeObject(
  620:                                 "must-not-complete")))
  621:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  622:         });
  623: 
  624:     Assert.Equal(
  625:         0,
  626:         engine.Timeline.Count);
  627: 
  628:     TestLog.Expected(
  629:         "New ExecuteAsync work was rejected after shutdown.");
  630: 
  631:     TestLog.Task(
  632:         "Allowing the already-active request to complete.");
  633: 
  634:     allowCompletion.TrySetResult(
  635:         true);
  636: 
  637:     var moment =
  638:         await activeExecution
  639:             .ConfigureAwait(false);
  640: 
  641:     TestLog.Task(
  642:         "Verifying active work produced honest temporal history.");
  643: 
  644:     Assert.Equal(
  645:         MomentOutcome.Completed,
  646:         moment.Outcome);
  647: 
  648:     Assert.Same(
  649:         result,
  650:         moment.Result);
  651: 
  652:     Assert.Null(
  653:         moment.Exception);
  654: 
  655:     Assert.Single(
  656:         moment.WorkUnitIds);
  657: 
  658:     Assert.NotEqual(
  659:         System.Guid.Empty,
  660:         moment.WorkUnitIds[0]);
  661: 
  662:     Assert.NotEqual(
  663:         System.Guid.Empty,
  664:         moment.PulseId);
  665: 
  666:     Assert.False(
  667:         engine.IsInitialized);
  668: 
  669:     Assert.Equal(
  670:         1,
  671:         engine.Timeline.Count);
  672: 
  673:     Assert.Single(
  674:         engine.Timeline.Moments);
  675: 
  676:     Assert.Same(
  677:         moment,
  678:         engine.Timeline.Moments[0]);
  679: 
  680:     Assert.Same(
  681:         result,
  682:         engine.Timeline
  683:             .Moments[0]
  684:             .Result);
  685: 
  686:     Assert.Equal(
  687:         1,
  688:         engine.Epoch.Count);
  689: 
  690:     Assert.Single(
  691:         engine.Epoch.Timelines);
  692: 
  693:     Assert.Same(
  694:         engine.Timeline,
  695:         engine.Epoch.Timelines[0]);
  696: 
  697:     Assert.Single(
  698:         engine.Epoch
  699:             .Timelines[0]
  700:             .Moments);
  701: 
  702:     Assert.Same(
  703:         moment,
  704:         engine.Epoch
  705:             .Timelines[0]
  706:             .Moments[0]);
  707: 
  708:     TestLog.State(
  709:         $"Engine initialized = {engine.IsInitialized}");
  710: 
  711:     TestLog.State(
  712:         $"Moment outcome = {moment.Outcome}");
  713: 
  714:     TestLog.State(
  715:         $"Timeline Moments = {engine.Timeline.Count}");
  716: 
  717:     TestLog.State(
  718:         $"Epoch Timelines = {engine.Epoch.Count}");
  719: 
  720:     TestLog.Pass(
  721:         "Active work completed honestly after shutdown.");
  722: 
  723:     TestLog.Pass(
  724:         "The completed Moment was retained in Timeline and Epoch.");
  725: 
  726:     TestLog.Pass(
  727:         "Shutdown-during-active-work certification completed successfully.");
  728: }

  632: [Fact]
  633: public async Task
  634:     ConcurrentExecuteAsyncRecordsEveryMomentExactlyOnce()
  635: {
  636:     const int requestCount =
  637:         64;
  638: 
  639:     TestLog.Section(
  640:         "WildsEngine ExecuteAsync Concurrency");
  641: 
  642:     TestLog.Test(
  643:         "Concurrent requests record every Moment exactly once");
  644: 
  645:     var component =
  646:         CreateComponent(
  647:             "execute.concurrent-history");
  648: 
  649:     using var engine =
  650:         CreateEngine(
  651:             component);
  652: 
  653:     Assert.True(
  654:         engine.Initialize());
  655: 
  656:     var requests =
  657:         Enumerable
  658:             .Range(
  659:                 0,
  660:                 requestCount)
  661:             .Select(
  662:                 index =>
  663:                     new TestRuntimeObject(
  664:                         $"concurrent-request-{index:D3}"))
  665:             .ToArray();
  666: 
  667:     var release =
  668:         new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
  669:             TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
  670: 
  671:     var enteredCount =
  672:         0;
  673: 
  674:     TestLog.Task(
  675:         $"Submitting {requestCount} concurrent requests.");
  676: 
  677:     var executions =
  678:         requests
  679:             .Select(
  680:                 request =>
  681:                     engine.ExecuteAsync(
  682:                             request,
  683:                             async (
  684:                                 observedRequest,
  685:                                 cancellationToken) =>
  686:                             {
  687:                                 cancellationToken
  688:                                     .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
  689: 
  690:                                 Assert.Same(
  691:                                     request,
  692:                                     observedRequest);
  693: 
  694:                                 Interlocked.Increment(
  695:                                     ref enteredCount);
  696: 
  697:                                 await release.Task
  698:                                     .ConfigureAwait(false);
  699: 
  700:                                 cancellationToken
  701:                                     .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
  702: 
  703:                                 return observedRequest;
  704:                             })
  705:                         .AsTask())
  706:             .ToArray();
  707: 
  708:     TestLog.State(
  709:         $"Submitted requests = {executions.Length}");
  710: 
  711:     Assert.Equal(
  712:         requestCount,
  713:         executions.Length);
  714: 
  715:     release.TrySetResult(
  716:         true);
  717: 
  718:     var moments =
  719:         await Task.WhenAll(
  720:                 executions)
  721:             .ConfigureAwait(false);
  722: 
  723:     TestLog.State(
  724:         $"Entered operations = {enteredCount}");
  725: 
  726:     TestLog.State(
  727:         $"Returned Moments = {moments.Length}");
  728: 
  729:     Assert.Equal(
  730:         requestCount,
  731:         enteredCount);
  732: 
  733:     Assert.Equal(
  734:         requestCount,
  735:         moments.Length);
  736: 
  737:     TestLog.Task(
  738:         "Verifying every concurrent request completed successfully.");
  739: 
  740:     Assert.All(
  741:         moments,
  742:         moment =>
  743:         {
  744:             Assert.Equal(
  745:                 MomentOutcome.Completed,
  746:                 moment.Outcome);
  747: 
  748:             Assert.Null(
  749:                 moment.Exception);
  750: 
  751:             Assert.NotNull(
  752:                 moment.Result);
  753: 
  754:             Assert.Single(
  755:                 moment.WorkUnitIds);
  756:         });
  757: 
  758:     TestLog.Pass(
  759:         "Every concurrent request produced a completed Moment.");
  760: 
  761:     TestLog.Task(
  762:         "Verifying request and result identity remained aligned.");
  763: 
  764:     for (var index = 0;
  765:          index < requestCount;
  766:          index++)
  767:     {
  768:         Assert.Same(
  769:             requests[index],
  770:             moments[index].Result);
  771:     }
  772: 
  773:     TestLog.Pass(
  774:         "Every Moment retained its exact request object as the result.");
  775: 
  776:     TestLog.Task(
  777:         "Verifying Pulse identities are unique.");
  778: 
  779:     var pulseIds =
  780:         moments
  781:             .Select(
  782:                 moment =>
  783:                     moment.PulseId)
  784:             .ToArray();
  785: 
  786:     Assert.Equal(
  787:         requestCount,
  788:         pulseIds.Distinct().Count());
  789: 
  790:     Assert.DoesNotContain(
  791:         Guid.Empty,
  792:         pulseIds);
  793: 
  794:     TestLog.Pass(
  795:         "Every concurrent request received a unique Pulse identity.");
  796: 
  797:     TestLog.Task(
  798:         "Verifying WorkUnit identities are unique.");
  799: 
  800:     var workUnitIds =
  801:         moments
  802:             .SelectMany(
  803:                 moment =>
  804:                     moment.WorkUnitIds)
  805:             .ToArray();
  806: 
  807:     Assert.Equal(
  808:         requestCount,
  809:         workUnitIds.Length);
  810: 
  811:     Assert.Equal(
  812:         requestCount,
  813:         workUnitIds.Distinct().Count());
  814: 
  815:     Assert.DoesNotContain(
  816:         Guid.Empty,
  817:         workUnitIds);
  818: 
  819:     TestLog.Pass(
  820:         "Every concurrent request received one unique WorkUnit identity.");
  821: 
  822:     TestLog.Task(
  823:         "Verifying Timeline recorded every returned Moment exactly once.");
  824: 
  825:     Assert.Equal(
  826:         requestCount,
  827:         engine.Timeline.Count);
  828: 
  829:     var recordedMoments =
  830:         engine.Timeline
  831:             .Moments
  832:             .ToArray();
  833: 
  834:     Assert.Equal(
  835:         requestCount,
  836:         recordedMoments.Length);
  837: 
  838:     Assert.Equal(
  839:         requestCount,
  840:         recordedMoments
  841:             .Select(
  842:                 moment =>
  843:                     moment.Id)
  844:             .Distinct()
  845:             .Count());
  846: 
  847:     foreach (var returnedMoment in moments)
  848:     {
  849:         Assert.Equal(
  850:             1,
  851:             recordedMoments.Count(
  852:                 recordedMoment =>
  853:                     ReferenceEquals(
  854:                         returnedMoment,
  855:                         recordedMoment)));
  856:     }
  857: 
  858:     TestLog.Pass(
  859:         "Timeline recorded every returned Moment exactly once.");
  860: 
  861:     TestLog.Task(
  862:         "Verifying every submitted request appears exactly once in history.");
  863: 
  864:     foreach (var request in requests)
  865:     {
  866:         Assert.Equal(
  867:             1,
  868:             recordedMoments.Count(
  869:                 moment =>
  870:                     ReferenceEquals(
  871:                         request,
  872:                         moment.Result)));
  873:     }
  874: 
  875:     TestLog.Pass(
  876:         "Timeline retained every submitted request exactly once.");
  877: 
  878:     TestLog.Task(
  879:         "Verifying Epoch retained the complete shared Timeline.");
  880: 
  881:     Assert.Equal(
  882:         1,
  883:         engine.Epoch.Count);
  884: 
  885:     Assert.Single(
  886:         engine.Epoch.Timelines);
  887: 
  888:     Assert.Same(
  889:         engine.Timeline,
  890:         engine.Epoch.Timelines[0]);
  891: 
  892:     Assert.Equal(
  893:         requestCount,
  894:         engine.Epoch
  895:             .Timelines[0]
  896:             .Moments
  897:             .Count);
  898: 
  899:     foreach (var returnedMoment in moments)
  900:     {
  901:         Assert.Equal(
  902:             1,
  903:             engine.Epoch
  904:                 .Timelines[0]
  905:                 .Moments
  906:                 .Count(
  907:                     recordedMoment =>
  908:                         ReferenceEquals(
  909:                             returnedMoment,
  910:                             recordedMoment)));
  911:     }
  912: 
  913:     TestLog.Pass(
  914:         "Epoch retained the complete concurrent Timeline.");
  915: 
  916:     TestLog.State(
  917:         $"Requests = {requestCount}");
  918: 
  919:     TestLog.State(
  920:         $"Unique Pulses = {pulseIds.Distinct().Count()}");
  921: 
  922:     TestLog.State(
  923:         $"Unique WorkUnits = {workUnitIds.Distinct().Count()}");
  924: 
  925:     TestLog.State(
  926:         $"Timeline Moments = {engine.Timeline.Count}");
  927: 
  928:     TestLog.State(
  929:         $"Epoch Timelines = {engine.Epoch.Count}");
  930: 
  931:     TestLog.Pass(
  932:         "Concurrent ExecuteAsync temporal-history certification completed successfully.");
  933: }

   11:     [Fact]

   13:     {
   14:         TestLog.Section(
   15:             "NEIGHBOR TOPOLOGY - STATE MUTATION AND OPERATOR QUERY");
   16: 
   17:         TestLog.Test(
   18:             "Creating independent topology objects A, B, C, and D.");
   19: 
   20:         var topology =
   21:             new NeighborTopologyFixture();
   22: 
   23:         TestLog.State(

   25: 
   26:         TestLog.State(
   27:             $"B = {topology.B.Slug}");
   28: 
   29:         TestLog.State(
   30:             $"C = {topology.C.Slug}");
   31: 
   32:         TestLog.State(
   33:             $"D = {topology.D.Slug}");
   34: 
   35:         TestLog.Task(
   36:             "Building topology through A.State.Process().");
   37: 
   38:         Assert.True(
   39:             topology.A.State.Process(
   40:                 new AddNeighborInstruction(
   41:                     topology.B,
   42:                     NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,

   44:

   46:             "A -> B | membership=local | distance=6");
   47: 
   48:         Assert.True(
   49:             topology.A.State.Process(
   50:                 new AddNeighborInstruction(
   51:                     topology.C,
   52:                     NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
   53:                     2.0)));
   54: 
   55:         TestLog.State(
   56:             "A -> C | membership=local | distance=2");
   57: 
   58:         Assert.True(
   59:             topology.A.State.Process(
   60:                 new AddNeighborInstruction(
   61:                     topology.D,
   62:                     NeighborTopologyFixture.RemoteMembership,
   63:                     1.0)));
   64: 
   65:         TestLog.State(
   66:             "A -> D | membership=remote | distance=1");
   67: 
   68:         TestLog.Expected(
   69:             "A should now contain exactly three Neighbor relationships.");
   70: 
   71:         Assert.Equal(

   74:

   79:

   83:                 NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership));
   84:

   86:             topology.A.Neighbors.Contains(
   87:                 topology.D.Id,
   88:                 NeighborTopologyFixture.RemoteMembership));
   89: 
   90:         TestLog.Pass(
   91:             "Topology established through the state machine.");
   92: 
   93:         var originalOrder =
   94:             topology.A.Neighbors
   95:                 .Relationships
   96:                 .Select(
   97:                     relationship =>
   98:                         relationship.Neighbor.Id)
   99:                 .ToArray();
  100: 
  101:         TestLog.Task(
  102:             "Querying topology through ApplyNeighborOperator().");
  103: 
  104:         var nearest =
  105:             topology.A.ApplyNeighborOperator(
  106:                 new NearestNeighbor());
  107: 
  108:         var localNeighbors =
  109:             topology.A.ApplyNeighborOperator(
  110:                 new MembershipNeighborFilter(
  111:                     NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership));
  112: 
  113:         var orderedNeighbors =
  114:             topology.A.ApplyNeighborOperator(
  115:                 new NearestNeighborOrder());
  116: 
  117:         TestLog.Expected(
  118:             "D should be the nearest Neighbor at distance 1.");
  119: 
  120:         Assert.NotNull(
  121:             nearest);
  122:

  126: 
  127:         Assert.Equal(
  128:             1.0,
  129:             nearest.Distance);
  130:

  132:             $"Nearest Neighbor = {nearest.Neighbor.Slug} | distance={nearest.Distance}");
  133:

  135:             "The local membership should contain exactly B and C.");
  136: 
  137:         Assert.Equal(
  138:             2,

  152:             topology.D.Id,
  153:             orderedNeighbors[0].Neighbor.Id);
  154:

  157:

  159:             "Verifying query operators did not mutate source topology.");
  160: 
  161:         Assert.Equal(
  162:             originalOrder,
  163:             topology.A.Neighbors
  164:                 .Relationships
  165:                 .Select(
  166:                     relationship =>
  167:                         relationship.Neighbor.Id)
  168:                 .ToArray());
  169: 
  170:         Assert.Equal(
  171:             3,

  173:

  176: 
  177:         TestLog.Task(
  178:             "Moving B from distance 6 to distance 0.5 through the state machine.");
  179: 
  180:         Assert.True(
  181:             topology.A.State.Process(
  182:                 new SetNeighborDistanceInstruction(

  184:                     NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  185:                     0.5)));
  186:

  199:             nearestAfterDistanceChange!.Neighbor.Id);
  200:

  202:             0.5,

  256:             topology.A.Neighbors.Count;

  261:

  264:                 new MembershipNeighborFilter(
  265:                     NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership));
  266: 
  267:         _ =
  268:             topology.A.ApplyNeighborOperator(

  272:             countBeforeFinalQueries,

  274:

  468:     [Fact]
  469:     public void Topology_OperatorPipeline_IsDeterministic_AndPreservesSource()
  470:     {
  471:         TestLog.Section(
  472:             "NEIGHBOR TOPOLOGY - OPERATOR PIPELINE DETERMINISM");
  473: 
  474:         TestLog.Test(
  475:             "Proving composed topology operations are deterministic and source-safe.");
  476: 
  477:         var topology =
  478:             new NeighborTopologyFixture();
  479: 
  480:         Assert.True(
  481:             topology.A.State.Process(
  482:                 new AddNeighborInstruction(
  483:                     topology.B,
  484:                     NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  485:                     6.0)));
  486: 
  487:         Assert.True(
  488:             topology.A.State.Process(
  489:                 new AddNeighborInstruction(
  490:                     topology.C,
  491:                     NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  492:                     2.0)));
  493: 
  494:         Assert.True(
  495:             topology.A.State.Process(
  496:                 new AddNeighborInstruction(
  497:                     topology.D,
  498:                     NeighborTopologyFixture.RemoteMembership,
  499:                     1.0)));
  500: 
  501:         var sourceBefore =
  502:             topology.A.Neighbors
  503:                 .Relationships
  504:                 .Select(
  505:                     relationship =>
  506:                         (
  507:                             relationship.Neighbor.Id,
  508:                             relationship.Membership,
  509:                             relationship.Distance))
  510:                 .ToArray();
  511: 
  512:         TestLog.State(
  513:             $"Source relationship count = {sourceBefore.Length}");
  514: 
  515:         TestLog.Task(
  516:             "Building local -> nearest-first topology pipeline.");
  517: 
  518:         var pipeline =
  519:             new NeighborPipeline(
  520:                 new MembershipNeighborFilter(
  521:                     NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership),
  522:                 new NearestNeighborOrder());
  523: 
  524:         var first =
  525:             topology.A.ApplyNeighborOperator(
  526:                 pipeline);
  527: 
  528:         var second =
  529:             topology.A.ApplyNeighborOperator(
  530:                 pipeline);
  531: 
  532:         TestLog.Expected(
  533:             "Both executions should produce C then B.");
  534: 
  535:         Assert.Equal(
  536:             2,
  537:             first.Count);
  538: 
  539:         Assert.Equal(
  540:             2,
  541:             second.Count);
  542: 
  543:         Assert.Equal(
  544:             topology.C.Id,
  545:             first[0].Neighbor.Id);
  546: 
  547:         Assert.Equal(
  548:             topology.B.Id,
  549:             first[1].Neighbor.Id);
  550: 
  551:         Assert.Equal(
  552:             first.Select(
  553:                 relationship =>
  554:                     relationship.Neighbor.Id),
  555:             second.Select(
  556:                 relationship =>
  557:                     relationship.Neighbor.Id));
  558: 
  559:         TestLog.State(
  560:             $"Pipeline result 1 = {first[0].Neighbor.Slug} -> {first[1].Neighbor.Slug}");
  561: 
  562:         TestLog.State(
  563:             $"Pipeline result 2 = {second[0].Neighbor.Slug} -> {second[1].Neighbor.Slug}");
  564: 
  565:         TestLog.Task(
  566:             "Comparing source topology before and after pipeline execution.");
  567: 
  568:         var sourceAfter =
  569:             topology.A.Neighbors
  570:                 .Relationships
  571:                 .Select(
  572:                     relationship =>
  573:                         (
  574:                             relationship.Neighbor.Id,
  575:                             relationship.Membership,
  576:                             relationship.Distance))
  577:                 .ToArray();
  578: 
  579:         Assert.Equal(
  580:             sourceBefore,
  581:             sourceAfter);
  582: 
  583:         Assert.Equal(
  584:             3,
  585:             topology.A.Neighbors.Count);
  586: 
  587:         TestLog.Pass(
  588:             "Operator pipeline was deterministic.");
  589: 
  590:         TestLog.Pass(
  591:             "Operator pipeline preserved the source Neighbor topology.");
  592:     }

  594:     [Fact]
  595: public void Topology_Relationships_AreDirectional_AndDoNotImplyReciprocity()
  596: {
  597:     TestLog.Section(
  598:         "NEIGHBOR TOPOLOGY - DIRECTIONAL INDEPENDENCE");
  599: 
  600:     TestLog.Test(
  601:         "Proving A -> B does not implicitly create B -> A.");
  602: 
  603:     var topology =
  604:         new NeighborTopologyFixture();
  605: 
  606:     TestLog.Task(
  607:         "Creating A -> B through the local membership.");
  608: 
  609:     Assert.True(
  610:         topology.A.State.Process(
  611:             new AddNeighborInstruction(
  612:                 topology.B,
  613:                 NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  614:                 4.0)));
  615: 
  616:     TestLog.Expected(
  617:         "A should contain B, while B should remain topologically independent.");
  618: 
  619:     Assert.True(
  620:         topology.A.Neighbors.Contains(
  621:             topology.B.Id,
  622:             NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership));
  623: 
  624:     Assert.False(
  625:         topology.B.Neighbors.Contains(
  626:             topology.A.Id,
  627:             NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership));
  628: 
  629:     Assert.Equal(
  630:         1,
  631:         topology.A.Neighbors.Count);
  632: 
  633:     Assert.Equal(
  634:         0,
  635:         topology.B.Neighbors.Count);
  636: 
  637:     TestLog.State(
  638:         $"A Neighbor count = {topology.A.Neighbors.Count}");
  639: 
  640:     TestLog.State(
  641:         $"B Neighbor count = {topology.B.Neighbors.Count}");
  642: 
  643:     TestLog.Pass(
  644:         "A -> B did not implicitly create B -> A.");
  645: 
  646:     TestLog.Task(
  647:         "Creating an explicit B -> A relationship with independent distance.");
  648: 
  649:     Assert.True(
  650:         topology.B.State.Process(
  651:             new AddNeighborInstruction(
  652:                 topology.A,
  653:                 NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  654:                 9.0)));
  655: 
  656:     TestLog.Expected(
  657:         "A -> B and B -> A should now exist as independent relationships.");
  658: 
  659:     Assert.True(
  660:         topology.A.Neighbors.TryGet(
  661:             topology.B.Id,
  662:             NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  663:             out var aToB));
  664: 
  665:     Assert.True(
  666:         topology.B.Neighbors.TryGet(
  667:             topology.A.Id,
  668:             NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  669:             out var bToA));
  670: 
  671:     Assert.NotNull(
  672:         aToB);
  673: 
  674:     Assert.NotNull(
  675:         bToA);
  676: 
  677:     Assert.Equal(
  678:         4.0,
  679:         aToB!.Distance);
  680: 
  681:     Assert.Equal(
  682:         9.0,
  683:         bToA!.Distance);
  684: 
  685:     TestLog.State(
  686:         $"A -> B distance = {aToB.Distance}");
  687: 
  688:     TestLog.State(
  689:         $"B -> A distance = {bToA.Distance}");
  690: 
  691:     TestLog.Pass(
  692:         "Reciprocal topology can exist without sharing relationship state.");
  693: 
  694:     TestLog.Task(
  695:         "Changing A -> B without modifying B -> A.");
  696: 
  697:     Assert.True(
  698:         topology.A.State.Process(
  699:             new SetNeighborDistanceInstruction(
  700:                 topology.B.Id,
  701:                 NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  702:                 1.5)));
  703: 
  704:     Assert.True(
  705:         topology.A.Neighbors.TryGet(
  706:             topology.B.Id,
  707:             NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  708:             out aToB));
  709: 
  710:     Assert.True(
  711:         topology.B.Neighbors.TryGet(
  712:             topology.A.Id,
  713:             NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership,
  714:             out bToA));
  715: 
  716:     Assert.NotNull(
  717:         aToB);
  718: 
  719:     Assert.NotNull(
  720:         bToA);
  721: 
  722:     Assert.Equal(
  723:         1.5,
  724:         aToB!.Distance);
  725: 
  726:     Assert.Equal(
  727:         9.0,
  728:         bToA!.Distance);
  729: 
  730:     TestLog.State(
  731:         $"Updated A -> B distance = {aToB.Distance}");
  732: 
  733:     TestLog.State(
  734:         $"Preserved B -> A distance = {bToA.Distance}");
  735: 
  736:     TestLog.Pass(
  737:         "Directional relationship state remained independent.");
  738: 
  739:     TestLog.Task(
  740:         "Removing A -> B while preserving B -> A.");
  741: 
  742:     Assert.True(
  743:         topology.A.State.Process(
  744:             new RemoveNeighborInstruction(
  745:                 topology.B.Id,
  746:                 NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership)));
  747: 
  748:     Assert.False(
  749:         topology.A.Neighbors.Contains(
  750:             topology.B.Id,
  751:             NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership));
  752: 
  753:     Assert.True(
  754:         topology.B.Neighbors.Contains(
  755:             topology.A.Id,
  756:             NeighborTopologyFixture.LocalMembership));
  757: 
  758:     Assert.Equal(
  759:         0,
  760:         topology.A.Neighbors.Count);
  761: 
  762:     Assert.Equal(
  763:         1,
  764:         topology.B.Neighbors.Count);
  765: 
  766:     TestLog.Pass(
  767:         "Removing one direction did not alter the reciprocal relationship.");
  768: 
  769:     TestLog.Pass(
  770:         "Neighbor topology directional-independence certification completed successfully.");
  771: }
  772: }

    1: using System;
    2: using System.Threading;
    3: using System.Threading.Tasks;
    4: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    5: using WildsEngine.Core.Pooling;
    6: using WildsEngine.Tests.Logging;
    7: 
    8: namespace WildsEngine.Tests.Pooling
    9: {
   10:     public static class ObjectPoolTests
   11:     {
   12:         private static int _passed;
   13: 
   14:         public static async Task RunAllAsync()
   15:         {
   16:             _passed = 0;
   17:             TestLog.Write("=== ObjectPool Tests ===");
   18:             Run("Rent creates instance", RentCreatesInstance);
   19:             Run("Return retains instance", ReturnRetainsInstance);
   20:             Run("Rent reuses instance", RentReusesInstance);
   21:             Run("Double lease dispose is safe", DoubleLeaseDisposeIsSafe);
   22:             Run("Retention limit is enforced", RetentionLimitIsEnforced);
   23:             Run("Reset is called on return", ResetIsCalledOnReturn);
   24:             Run("Failed reset rejects instance", FailedResetRejectsInstance);
   25:             Run("Dispose clears retained instances", DisposeClearsRetainedInstances);
   26:             Run("Rent after dispose throws", RentAfterDisposeThrows);
   27:             await RunAsync("Concurrent rent is bounded", ConcurrentRentIsBoundedAsync);
   28:             await RunAsync("Waiting rent can be cancelled", WaitingRentCanBeCancelledAsync);
   29:             TestLog.Write($"=== ObjectPool Tests Passed: {_passed}/{_passed} ===");
   30:         }
   31: 
   32:         private static void RentCreatesInstance()
   33:         {
   34:             using var pool = CreatePool();
   35:             using var lease = pool.Rent();
   36:             LogState(pool, "After first rent");
   37:             Assert(lease.Instance != null, "Rent should return an instance.");
   38:             Assert(pool.CreatedCount == 1, "First rent should create one instance.");
   39:             Assert(pool.ActiveCount == 1, "First rent should create one active lease.");
   40:         }
   41: 
   42:         private static void ReturnRetainsInstance()
   43:         {
   44:             using var pool = CreatePool();
   45:             var lease = pool.Rent();
   46:             lease.Dispose();
   47:             LogState(pool, "After return");
   48:             Assert(pool.ActiveCount == 0, "Returned instance should no longer be active.");
   49:             Assert(pool.AvailableCount == 1, "Returned instance should be retained.");
   50:         }
   51: 
   52:         private static void RentReusesInstance()
   53:         {
   54:             using var pool = CreatePool();
   55:             TestPoolObject first;
   56:             using (var lease = pool.Rent()) first = lease.Instance;
   57:             using (var lease = pool.Rent())
   58:                 Assert(ReferenceEquals(first, lease.Instance), "Second rent should reuse retained instance.");
   59:             Assert(pool.CreatedCount == 1, "Reusing an instance should not create another object.");
   60:         }
   61: 
   62:         private static void DoubleLeaseDisposeIsSafe()
   63:         {
   64:             using var pool = CreatePool();
   65:             var lease = pool.Rent();
   66:             lease.Dispose();
   67:             lease.Dispose();
   68:             Assert(pool.ActiveCount == 0, "Double lease disposal must not double-return.");
   69:             Assert(pool.AvailableCount == 1, "Double disposal must retain only one instance.");
   70:         }
   71: 
   72:         private static void RetentionLimitIsEnforced()
   73:         {
   74:             using var pool = new ObjectPool<TestPoolObject>(() => new TestPoolObject(), 1, 2);
   75:             var first = pool.Rent();
   76:             var second = pool.Rent();
   77:             first.Dispose();
   78:             second.Dispose();
   79:             LogState(pool, "After retention test");
   80:             Assert(pool.AvailableCount == 1, "Pool should retain no more than MaximumRetained.");
   81:             Assert(pool.CreatedCount == 2, "Two simultaneous leases should require two instances.");
   82:         }
   83: 
   84:         private static void ResetIsCalledOnReturn()
   85:         {
   86:             using var pool = CreatePool();
   87:             TestPoolObject instance;
   88:             using (var lease = pool.Rent()) { instance = lease.Instance; instance.Value = 42; }
   89:             TestLog.State($"ResetCount = {instance.ResetCount}; Value = {instance.Value}");
   90:             Assert(instance.ResetCount == 1, "Returning pooled object should call TryReset.");
   91:             Assert(instance.Value == 0, "Reset should clear transient state.");
   92:         }
   93: 
   94:         private static void FailedResetRejectsInstance()
   95:         {
   96:             using var pool = new ObjectPool<TestPoolObject>(() => new TestPoolObject { AllowReset = false }, 4, 4);
   97:             using (var lease = pool.Rent()) { }
   98:             Assert(pool.ActiveCount == 0, "Rejected instance should no longer be active.");
   99:             Assert(pool.AvailableCount == 0, "Failed reset should prevent retention.");
  100:         }
  101: 
  102:         private static void DisposeClearsRetainedInstances()
  103:         {
  104:             var pool = CreatePool();
  105:             TestPoolObject instance;
  106:             using (var lease = pool.Rent()) instance = lease.Instance;
  107:             pool.Dispose();
  108:             Assert(pool.AvailableCount == 0, "Disposal should clear retained instances.");
  109:             Assert(instance.IsDisposed, "Retained disposable instance should be disposed.");
  110:         }
  111: 
  112:         private static void RentAfterDisposeThrows()
  113:         {
  114:             var pool = CreatePool();
  115:             pool.Dispose();
  116:             var threw = false;
  117:             try { pool.Rent(); }
  118:             catch (ObjectDisposedException) { threw = true; TestLog.Expected("ObjectDisposedException"); }
  119:             Assert(threw, "Rent after pool disposal should throw.");
  120:         }
  121: 
  122:         private static async Task ConcurrentRentIsBoundedAsync()
  123:         {
  124:             using var pool = new ObjectPool<TestPoolObject>(() => new TestPoolObject(), 2, 2);
  125:             using var first = await pool.RentAsync();
  126:             using var second = await pool.RentAsync();
  127:             using var cancellation = new CancellationTokenSource();
  128:             var waiting = pool.RentAsync(cancellation.Token);
  129:             Assert(!waiting.IsCompletedSuccessfully, "Additional asynchronous rent should wait.");
  130:             cancellation.Cancel();
  131:             var cancelled = false;
  132:             try { using var ignored = await waiting; }
  133:             catch (OperationCanceledException) { cancelled = true; TestLog.Expected("OperationCanceledException"); }
  134:             Assert(cancelled, "Waiting rent should observe cancellation.");
  135:             Assert(pool.ActiveCount == 2, "Existing leases should remain active.");
  136:         }
  137: 
  138:         private static async Task WaitingRentCanBeCancelledAsync()
  139:         {
  140:             using var pool = new ObjectPool<TestPoolObject>(() => new TestPoolObject(), 1, 1);
  141:             using var active = await pool.RentAsync();
  142:             using var cancellation = new CancellationTokenSource();
  143:             var waiting = pool.RentAsync(cancellation.Token);
  144:             cancellation.Cancel();
  145:             var cancelled = false;
  146:             try { using var ignored = await waiting; }
  147:             catch (OperationCanceledException) { cancelled = true; TestLog.Expected("OperationCanceledException"); }
  148:             Assert(cancelled, "Cancellation should release a waiting renter.");
  149:             Assert(pool.ActiveCount == 1, "Cancellation must not affect existing lease.");
  150:         }
  151: 
  152:         private static ObjectPool<TestPoolObject> CreatePool() =>
  153:             new ObjectPool<TestPoolObject>(() => new TestPoolObject(), 4, 4);
  154: 
  155:         private static void Run(string name, Action test)
  156:         {
  157:             TestLog.Test(name);
  158:             try { test(); _passed++; TestLog.Pass(name); }
  159:             catch (Exception ex) { TestLog.Fail(name, ex); throw; }
  160:         }
  161: 
  162:         private static async Task RunAsync(string name, Func<Task> test)
  163:         {
  164:             TestLog.Test(name);
  165:             try { await test().ConfigureAwait(false); _passed++; TestLog.Pass(name); }
  166:             catch (Exception ex) { TestLog.Fail(name, ex); throw; }
  167:         }
  168: 
  169:         private static void LogState(ObjectPool<TestPoolObject> pool, string message) =>
  170:             TestLog.State($"{message} | Active={pool.ActiveCount}, Available={pool.AvailableCount}, Created={pool.CreatedCount}, Maximum={pool.MaximumConcurrent}");
  171: 
  172:         private static void Assert(bool condition, string message)
  173:         {
  174:             if (!condition) throw new InvalidOperationException($"ObjectPool test failed: {message}");
  175:         }
  176: 
  177:         private sealed class TestPoolObject : IResettablePoolObject, IDisposable
  178:         {
  179:             public int Value { get; set; }
  180:             public int ResetCount { get; private set; }
  181:             public bool AllowReset { get; set; } = true;
  182:             public bool IsDisposed { get; private set; }
  183:             public bool TryReset() { ResetCount++; if (!AllowReset) return false; Value = 0; return true; }
  184:             public void Dispose() => IsDisposed = true;
  185:         }
  186:     }
  187: }

    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using QSL.Core;
    4: using QSL.Core.Runtime;
