   12: public sealed class QslPackageLifecycleCertificationTests
   13: {
   14:     [Fact]
   15:     public void MultipleConsumersAndPackagesRemainTargetIsolated()
   16:     {
   17:         TestLog.Section(
   18:             "QSL PACKAGE LIFECYCLE - MULTIPLE TARGETS");
   19: 
   20:         TestLog.Test(
   21:             "Multiple consumers receive packages without cross-target contamination.");
   22: 
   23:         var engine = CreateQslEngine();
   24: 
   25:         var player = new TestPlayer(
   26:             100.0);
   27: 
   28:         var action = new TestAction(
   29:             20.0);
   30: 
   31:         var playerBinding = new QslConsumerBinding(
   32:             "player",
   33:             "Player",
   34:             player);
   35: 
   36:         var actionBinding = new QslConsumerBinding(
   37:             "action",
   38:             "Action",
   39:             action);
   40: 
   41:         engine.BindConsumer(
   42:             playerBinding);
   43: 
   44:         engine.BindConsumer(
   45:             actionBinding);
   46: 
   47:         var playerPackage = new QslStatePackage(
   48:             player,
   49:             new Dictionary<string, object?>
   50:             {
   51:                 {
   52:                     "Curiosity",
   53:                     11.0
   54:                 },
   55:                 {
   56:                     "Fatigue",
   57:                     4.0
   58:                 }
   59:             });
   60: 
   61:         var actionPackage = new QslStatePackage(
   62:             action,
   63:             new Dictionary<string, object?>
   64:             {
   65:                 {
   66:                     "SpaceDustAppetite",
   67:                     75.0
   68:                 },
   69:                 {
   70:                     "Urgency",
   71:                     8.0
   72:                 }
   73:             });
   74: 
   75:         TestLog.Task(
   76:             "Receiving packages for two exact target objects.");
   77: 
   78:         var playerReceived = engine.ReceiveState(
   79:             playerPackage);
   80: 
   81:         var actionReceived = engine.ReceiveState(
   82:             actionPackage);
   83: 
   84:         Assert.Equal(
   85:             2,
   86:             playerReceived);
   87: 
   88:         Assert.Equal(
   89:             2,
   90:             actionReceived);
   91: 
   92:         Assert.Same(
   93:             player,
   94:             playerPackage.Target);
   95: 
   96:         Assert.Same(
   97:             action,
   98:             actionPackage.Target);
   99: 
  100:         var playerCuriosity = engine.Evaluate(
  101:             "player.Curiosity");
  102: 
  103:         var playerFatigue = engine.Evaluate(
  104:             "player.Fatigue");
  105: 
  106:         var actionAppetite = engine.Evaluate(
  107:             "action.SpaceDustAppetite");
  108: 
  109:         var actionUrgency = engine.Evaluate(
  110:             "action.Urgency");
  111: 
  112:         AssertSucceededWithValue(
  113:             playerCuriosity,
  114:             11.0);
  115: 
  116:         AssertSucceededWithValue(

  305:     [Fact]
  306:     public void RemovingOnePropertyPreservesOtherAttachedAndNativeProperties()
  307:     {
  308:         TestLog.Section(
  309:             "QSL PACKAGE LIFECYCLE - PROPERTY REMOVAL");
  310: 
  311:         TestLog.Test(
  312:             "Removing one attached property preserves unrelated attached and native properties.");
  313: 
  314:         var engine = CreateQslEngine();
  315: 
  316:         var player = new TestPlayer(
  317:             50.0);
  318: 
  319:         engine.BindConsumer(
  320:             new QslConsumerBinding(
  321:                 "player",
  322:                 "Player",
  323:                 player));
  324: 
  325:         var received = engine.ReceiveState(
  326:             new QslStatePackage(
  327:                 player,
  328:                 new Dictionary<string, object?>
  329:                 {
  330:                     {
  331:                         "Curiosity",
  332:                         11.0
  333:                     },
  334:                     {
  335:                         "Fatigue",
  336:                         4.0
  337:                     }
  338:                 }));
  339: 
  340:         Assert.Equal(
  341:             2,
  342:             received);
  343: 
  344:         var removedOnce = engine.RemoveState(
  345:             player,
  346:             "Curiosity");
  347: 
  348:         var removedTwice = engine.RemoveState(
  349:             player,
  350:             "Curiosity");
  351: 
  352:         Assert.True(
  353:             removedOnce);
  354: 
  355:         Assert.False(
  356:             removedTwice);
  357: 
  358:         var removed = engine.Evaluate(
  359:             "player.Curiosity");
  360: 
  361:         var preservedAttached = engine.Evaluate(
  362:             "player.Fatigue");
  363: 
  364:         var preservedNative = engine.Evaluate(
  365:             "player.Health");
  366: 
  367:         Assert.False(
  368:             removed.Succeeded);
  369: 
  370:         AssertSucceededWithValue(
  371:             preservedAttached,
  372:             4.0);
  373: 
  374:         AssertSucceededWithValue(
  375:             preservedNative,
  376:             50.0);
  377: 
  378:         TestLog.State(
  379:             $"Initial package properties received = {received}");
  380: 
  381:         TestLog.State(
  382:             $"First removal succeeded = {removedOnce}");
  383: 
  384:         TestLog.State(
  385:             $"Repeated removal succeeded = {removedTwice}");
  386: 
  387:         TestLog.State(
  388:             $"Removed player.Curiosity resolved = {removed.Succeeded}");
  389: 
  390:         TestLog.State(
  391:             $"Preserved player.Fatigue = {preservedAttached.Value}");
  392: 
  393:         TestLog.State(
  394:             $"Preserved player.Health = {preservedNative.Value}");
  395: 
  396:         TestLog.Pass(
  397:             "The requested attached property was removed.");
  398: 
  399:         TestLog.Pass(
  400:             "Repeated removal correctly reported that no state remained.");
  401: 
  402:         TestLog.Pass(
  403:             "Unrelated attached and native properties remained available.");
  404:     }

  407: [Fact]

  409: {

  411:         "QSL PACKAGE LIFECYCLE - CONSUMER UNBIND");

  470:         8.0);
  471:

  663: [Fact]
  664: public void ResolvedZeroValueRemovalPackageRemovesWatchedAttachedState()
  665: {
  666:     TestLog.Section(
  667:         "QSL PACKAGE LIFECYCLE - RESOLVED REMOVAL PACKAGE");
  668: 
  669:     TestLog.Test(
  670:         "A resolved zero-value decay package removes watched attached state without affecting unrelated state.");
  671: 
  672:     var engine = CreateQslEngine();
  673: 
  674:     var player = new TestPlayer(
  675:         50.0);
  676: 
  677:     engine.BindConsumer(
  678:         new QslConsumerBinding(
  679:             "player",
  680:             "Player",
  681:             player));
  682: 
  683:     Assert.Equal(
  684:         2,
  685:         engine.ReceiveState(
  686:             new QslStatePackage(
  687:                 player,
  688:                 new Dictionary<string, object?>
  689:                 {
  690:                     {
  691:                         "Curiosity",
  692:                         11.0
  693:                     },
  694:                     {
  695:                         "Fatigue",
  696:                         4.0
  697:                     }
  698:                 })));
  699: 
  700:     AssertSucceededWithValue(
  701:         engine.Evaluate(
  702:             "player.Curiosity"),
  703:         11.0);
  704: 
  705:     AssertSucceededWithValue(
  706:         engine.Evaluate(
  707:             "player.Fatigue"),
  708:         4.0);
  709: 
  710:     TestLog.Task(
  711:         "Applying a Wilds-resolved zero-value decay package with removal enabled.");
  712: 
  713:     var decayPackage = new QslDecayPackage(
  714:         player,
  715:         new Dictionary<string, object?>
  716:         {
  717:             {
  718:                 "Curiosity",
  719:                 0.0
  720:             }
  721:         },
  722:         removeAtZero: true);
  723: 
  724:     var affected = engine.ReceiveDecay(
  725:         decayPackage);
  726: 
  727:     Assert.Equal(
  728:         1,
  729:         affected);
  730: 
  731:     var removed = engine.Evaluate(
  732:         "player.Curiosity");
  733: 
  734:     var preservedAttached = engine.Evaluate(
  735:         "player.Fatigue");
  736: 
  737:     var preservedNative = engine.Evaluate(
  738:         "player.Health");
  739: 
  740:     Assert.False(
  741:         removed.Succeeded);
  742: 
  743:     AssertSucceededWithValue(
  744:         preservedAttached,
  745:         4.0);
  746: 
  747:     AssertSucceededWithValue(
  748:         preservedNative,
  749:         50.0);
  750: 
  751:     TestLog.State(
  752:         $"Decay properties affected = {affected}");
  753: 
  754:     TestLog.State(
  755:         $"player.Curiosity resolved after decay = {removed.Succeeded}");
  756: 
  757:     TestLog.State(
  758:         $"Preserved player.Fatigue = {preservedAttached.Value}");
  759: 
  760:     TestLog.State(
  761:         $"Preserved player.Health = {preservedNative.Value}");
  762: 
  763:     TestLog.Pass(
  764:         "The resolved zero-value decay package retired the watched attached property.");
  765: 
  766:     TestLog.Pass(
  767:         "The decay package preserved unrelated attached state.");
  768: 
  769:     TestLog.Pass(
  770:         "The decay package preserved native consumer-owned state.");
  771: }

  773:     private static QslEngine CreateQslEngine()
  774:     {
  775:         var registry = new QslRuntimeRegistry();
  776: 
  777:         registry.RegisterDefaultEvaluators();
  778: 
  779:         var context = new QslRuntimeContext(
  780:             registry);
  781: 
  782:         return new QslEngine(
  783:             context);
  784:     }
  785: 
  786:     private static void AssertSucceededWithValue(
  787:         QslProcessingResult result,
  788:         double expected)
  789:     {
  790:         Assert.NotNull(
  791:             result);
  792: 
  793:         Assert.True(
  794:             result.Succeeded);
  795: 
  796:         Assert.False(
  797:             result.ParseFailed);
  798: 
  799:         Assert.False(
  800:             result.EvaluationFailed);
  801: 
  802:         Assert.False(
  803:             result.HasException);
  804: 
  805:         Assert.Empty(
  806:             result.ParserDiagnostics);
  807: 
  808:         Assert.Empty(
  809:             result.RuntimeDiagnostics);
  810: 
  811:         Assert.Null(
  812:             result.Exception);
  813: 
  814:         Assert.NotNull(
  815:             result.Value);
  816: 
  817:         Assert.Equal(
  818:             expected,
  819:             Convert.ToDouble(
  820:                 result.Value),
  821:             10);
  822:     }

    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using System.Threading.Tasks;
    4: using QSL.Core;

   14: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Tests
   15: {
   16:     /// <summary>
   17:     /// Certifies the complete Wilds -> QSL -> Wilds route.
   18:     ///
   19:     /// Consumer request
   20:     ///     -> Wilds
   21:     ///     -> Pulse
   22:     ///     -> WorkUnit
   23:     ///     -> QSL
   24:     ///     -> WorkUnit result
   25:     ///     -> Moment
   26:     ///     -> Timeline
   27:     ///     -> Epoch
   28:     ///
   29:     /// Wilds owns request processing and temporal resolution.
   30:     /// QSL performs delegated language work inside that route.
   31:     /// </summary>
   32:     public sealed class WildsQslEndToEndTests
   33:     {
   34:         [Fact]
   35:         public async Task QslWorkResolvesThroughCompleteWildsLifecycle()
   36:         {
   37:             TestLog.Section(
   38:                 "Wilds / QSL End-to-End");
   39: 
   40:             TestLog.Test(
   41:                 "QSL work resolves inside the Wilds lifecycle");
   42: 
   43:             var qslEngine =
   44:                 CreateQslEngine();
   45: 
   46:             var component =
   47:                 new TestComponent(
   48:                     "qsl.end-to-end");
   49: 
   50:             using var wildsEngine =
   51:                 CreateWildsEngine(
   52:                     component);
   53: 
   54:             Assert.True(
   55:                 wildsEngine.Initialize());
   56: 
   57:             var executor =
   58:                 new WildsQslExecutor(
   59:                     qslEngine,
   60:                     wildsEngine);
   61: 
   62:             var player =
   63:                 new TestPlayer(
   64:                     50.0);
   65: 
   66:             var action =
   67:                 new TestAction(
   68:                     10.0);
   69: 
   70:             var playerBinding =
   71:                 new QslConsumerBinding(
   72:                     "player",
   73:                     "Player",

  138:     public async Task
  139:         QslRuntimeDiagnosticsSurviveWildsFailureRoute()
  140:     {
  141:         TestLog.Section(
  142:             "Wilds / QSL Provenance Integration");
  143: 
  144:         TestLog.Test(
  145:             "QSL runtime provenance survives Wilds failure route");
  146: 
  147:         var qslEngine =
  148:             CreateQslEngine();
  149: 
  150:         var component =
  151:             new TestComponent(
  152:                 "qsl.provenance.runtime");
  153: 
  154:         using var wildsEngine =
  155:             CreateWildsEngine(
  156:                 component,
  157:                 "qsl.provenance.runtime");
  158: 
  159:         Assert.True(
  160:             wildsEngine.Initialize());
  161: 
  162:         var executor =
  163:             new WildsQslExecutor(
  164:                 qslEngine,
  165:                 wildsEngine);
  166: 
  167:         /*
  168:          * Valid QSL syntax with an identifier that has
  169:          * intentionally not been bound.
  170:          *
  171:          * Existing certification recognizes the QSL
  172:          * runtime diagnostic:
  173:          *
  174:          *     Unresolved identifier: missingConsumer
  175:          */
  176:         var request =
  177:             new WildsQslRequest(
  178:                 "missingConsumer.Value");
  179: 
  180:         var moment =
  181:             await executor.ExecuteAsync(
  182:                 request);
  183: 
  184:         Assert.Equal(
  185:             MomentOutcome.Failed,
  186:             moment.Outcome);
  187: 
  188:         Assert.Null(
  189:             moment.Result);
  190: 
  191:         Assert.Single(
  192:             moment.WorkUnitIds);
  193: 
  194:         var qslException =
  195:             Assert.IsType<WildsQslExecutionException>(
  196:                 moment.Exception);
  197: 
  198:         var processingResult =
  199:             qslException.Result;
  200: 
  201:         Assert.False(
  202:             processingResult.Succeeded);
  203: 
  204:         Assert.False(
  205:             processingResult.ParseFailed);
  206: 
  207:         Assert.True(
  208:             processingResult.EvaluationFailed);
  209: 
  210:         Assert.Empty(
  211:             processingResult.ParserDiagnostics);
  212: 
  213:         Assert.NotEmpty(
  214:             processingResult.RuntimeDiagnostics);
  215: 
  216:         var foundExpectedDiagnostic =
  217:             false;
  218: 
  219:         for (
  220:             var index = 0;
  221:             index <
  222:             processingResult.RuntimeDiagnostics.Count;
  223:             index++)
  224:         {
  225:             var diagnostic =
  226:                 processingResult
  227:                     .RuntimeDiagnostics[index];
  228: 
  229:             if (diagnostic.Message.Contains(
  230:                     "Unresolved identifier: missingConsumer",
  231:                     StringComparison.Ordinal))
  232:             {
  233:                 foundExpectedDiagnostic =
  234:                     true;
  235: 
  236:                 break;
  237:             }
  238:         }
  239: 
  240:         Assert.True(
  241:             foundExpectedDiagnostic,
  242:             "The original unresolved-identifier " +
  243:             "QSL provenance entry must remain available.");
  244: 
  245:         Assert.Same(
  246:             qslException,
  247:             moment.Exception);
  248: 
  249:         Assert.Single(
  250:             wildsEngine.Timeline.Moments);
  251: 
  252:         Assert.Same(
  253:             moment,
  254:             wildsEngine.Timeline.Moments[0]);
  255: 
  256:         Assert.Single(
  257:             wildsEngine.Epoch.Timelines);
  258: 
  259:         Assert.Same(
  260:             wildsEngine.Timeline,
  261:             wildsEngine.Epoch.Timelines[0]);
  262: 
  263:         Assert.Single(
  264:             wildsEngine.Epoch
  265:                 .Timelines[0]
  266:                 .Moments);
  267: 
  268:         Assert.Same(
  269:             moment,
  270:             wildsEngine.Epoch
  271:                 .Timelines[0]
  272:                 .Moments[0]);
  273: 
  274:         TestLog.State(
  275:             "Runtime diagnostics: " +
  276:             processingResult
  277:                 .RuntimeDiagnostics
  278:                 .Count);
  279: 
  280:         TestLog.State(
  281:             "Moment outcome: " +
  282:             moment.Outcome);
  283: 
  284:         TestLog.Pass(
  285:             "Original QSL runtime provenance remained " +
  286:             "authoritative through Wilds");
  287:     }

    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using System.Globalization;
    4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
    5: using QSL.Core;

   14: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Tests.Certification
   15: {
   16:     /// <summary>
   17:     /// Certifies the complete WildsQslRequest integration
   18:     /// boundary.
   19:     ///
   20:     /// WildsQslRequest
   21:     ///     -> Pulse
   22:     ///     -> WorkUnit
   23:     ///     -> consumer binding
   24:     ///     -> attached state
   25:     ///     -> QSL evaluation
   26:     ///     -> Moment
   27:     ///     -> Timeline
   28:     ///     -> Epoch
   29:     ///
   30:     /// These tests intentionally exercise consumer-owned
   31:     /// runtime objects through the public Wilds/QSL boundary.
   32:     /// </summary>
   33:     public static class WildsQslRequestCertification
   34:     {
   35:         public static async Task RunAllAsync()
   36:         {
   37:             TestLog.Write(
   38:                 "=== Wilds / QSL Request Certification ===");
   39: 
   40:             await CertifyEnvelopeExecutionAsync();
   41: 
   42:             await CertifyAttachedStateAsync();
   43: 
   44:             await CertifySpaceDustMutationAsync();
   45: 
   46:             TestLog.Pass(
   47:                 "Wilds / QSL request certification");
   48:         }
   49: 
   50:         private static async Task CertifyEnvelopeExecutionAsync()
   51:         {
   52:             TestLog.Test(
   53:                 "WildsQslRequest traverses complete Wilds lifecycle");
   54: 
   55:             var qslEngine =
   56:                 CreateQslEngine();
   57: 
   58:             var component =
   59:                 CreateComponent(
   60:                     "certification.qsl.request.envelope");
   61: 
   62:             using var wildsEngine =
   63:                 CreateWildsEngine(
   64:                     component,
   65:                     "certification.qsl.request.envelope");
   66: 
   67:             Assert(
   68:                 wildsEngine.Initialize(),
   69:                 "WildsEngine initialization should succeed.");
   70: 
   71:             var executor =
   72:                 new WildsQslExecutor(
   73:                     qslEngine,
   74:                     wildsEngine);
   75: 
   76:             var request =
   77:                 new WildsQslRequest(
   78:                     "1 + 2");
   79: 
   80:             var moment =
   81:                 await executor.ExecuteAsync(
   82:                     request);
   83: 
   84:             Assert(
   85:                 moment.Outcome ==
   86:                 MomentOutcome.Completed,
   87:                 "Envelope execution must produce a completed Moment.");
   88: 
   89:             Assert(
   90:                 moment.Exception == null,
   91:                 "Completed envelope execution must not carry an exception.");
   92: 
   93:             Assert(
   94:                 NumericEquals(
   95:                     moment.Result,
   96:                     3.0),
   97:                 "Envelope arithmetic result must equal 3.");
   98: 
   99:             Assert(
  100:                 moment.WorkUnitIds.Count == 1,
  101:                 "Envelope execution must resolve through exactly one WorkUnit.");
  102: 
  103:             AssertCompleteHistory(
  104:                 wildsEngine,
  105:                 moment);
  106: 
  107:             TestLog.State(
  108:                 "Envelope result: " +
  109:                 FormatValue(
  110:                     moment.Result));
  111: 
  112:             TestLog.Pass(
  113:                 "WildsQslRequest completed through Wilds history");
  114:         }
  115:

  209: 
  210:             TestLog.State(
  211:                 "Native Amount: " +
  212:                 action.Amount);
  213: 
  214:             TestLog.State(
  215:                 "Attached SpaceDustAppetite: 87");
  216: 
  217:             TestLog.State(
  218:                 "QSL result: " +
  219:                 FormatValue(
  220:                     moment.Result));
  221: 
  222:             TestLog.Pass(
  223:                 "Native and attached runtime vocabulary composed through Wilds");
  224:         }
  225: 
  226:         private static async Task CertifySpaceDustMutationAsync()
  227:         {
  228:             TestLog.Test(
  229:                 "Space Dust mutates exact consumer-owned Player");
  230: 
  231:             var qslEngine =
  232:                 CreateQslEngine();
  233: 
  234:             var component =
  235:                 CreateComponent(
  236:                     "certification.qsl.request.space-dust");
  237: 
  238:             using var wildsEngine =
  239:                 CreateWildsEngine(
  240:                     component,
  241:                     "certification.qsl.request.space-dust");
  242: 
  243:             Assert(
  244:                 wildsEngine.Initialize(),
  245:                 "WildsEngine initialization should succeed.");
  246: 
  247:             var executor =
  248:                 new WildsQslExecutor(
  249:                     qslEngine,
  250:                     wildsEngine);
  251: 
  252:             var player =
  253:                 new TestPlayer(
  254:                     50.0);
  255: 
  256:             var action =
  257:                 new TestAction(
  258:                     10.0);
  259: 
  260:             var playerBinding =
  261:                 new QslConsumerBinding(
  262:                     "player",
  263:                     "Player",
  264:                     player);
  265: 
  266:             var actionBinding =
  267:                 new QslConsumerBinding(
  268:                     "action",
  269:                     "Action",
  270:                     action);
  271: 
  272:             var actionState =
  273:                 new QslStatePackage(
  274:                     action,
  275:                     new Dictionary<string, object?>
  276:                     {
  277:                         {
  278:                             "SpaceDustAppetite",
  279:                             87.0
  280:                         }
  281:                     });
  282: 
  283:             var request =
  284:                 new WildsQslRequest(
  285:                     "player.Health = player.Health - " +
  286:                     "(action.Amount * " +
  287:                     "(action.SpaceDustAppetite / 100))",
  288:                     new[]
  289:                     {
  290:                         playerBinding,
  291:                         actionBinding
  292:                     },
  293:                     new[]
  294:                     {
  295:                         actionState
  296:                     });
  297: 
  298:             var moment =
  299:                 await executor.ExecuteAsync(
  300:                     request);
  301: 
  302:             Assert(
  303:                 moment.Outcome ==
  304:                 MomentOutcome.Completed,
  305:                 "Space Dust request must produce a completed Moment.");
  306: 
  307:             Assert(
  308:                 moment.Exception == null,
  309:                 "Space Dust request must not carry an exception.");
  310: 
  311:             Assert(
  312:                 NumericEquals(
  313:                     moment.Result,
  314:                     41.3),
  315:                 "Space Dust QSL result must equal 41.3.");
  316: 
  317:             Assert(
  318:                 NumericEquals(
  319:                     player.Health,
  320:                     41.3),
  321:                 "Space Dust must mutate Player.Health to 41.3.");
  322: 
  323:             Assert(
  324:                 ReferenceEquals(
  325:                     player,
  326:                     playerBinding.Value),
  327:                 "Player binding must retain the exact consumer object.");
  328: 
  329:             Assert(
  330:                 ReferenceEquals(
  331:                     action,
  332:                     actionBinding.Value),
  333:                 "Action binding must retain the exact consumer object.");
  334: 
  335:             Assert(
  336:                 ReferenceEquals(
  337:                     action,
  338:                     actionState.Target),
  339:                 "Attached Action state must target the exact Action object.");
  340: 
  341:             AssertCompleteHistory(
  342:                 wildsEngine,
  343:                 moment);
  344: 
  345:             Assert(
  346:                 ReferenceEquals(
  347:                     moment,
  348:                     wildsEngine.Timeline.Moments[0]),
  349:                 "Timeline must retain the exact Space Dust Moment.");
  350: 
  351:             Assert(
  352:                 ReferenceEquals(
  353:                     moment,
  354:                     wildsEngine.Epoch
  355:                         .Timelines[0]
  356:                         .Moments[0]),
  357:                 "Epoch history must retain the exact Space Dust Moment.");
  358: 
  359:             TestLog.State(
  360:                 "Player.Health: 50 -> " +
  361:                 player.Health.ToString(
  362:                     CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
  363: 
  364:             TestLog.State(
  365:                 "Action.Amount: " +
  366:                 action.Amount.ToString(
  367:                     CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
  368: 
  369:             TestLog.State(
  370:                 "Action.SpaceDustAppetite: 87");
  371: 
  372:             TestLog.State(
  373:                 "Moment result: " +
  374:                 FormatValue(
  375:                     moment.Result));
  376: 
  377:             TestLog.Pass(
  378:                 "Space Dust mutated the exact Player through Wilds");
  379:         }
  380: 
  381:         private static void AssertCompleteHistory(
  382:             global::WildsEngine.Core.WildsEngine wildsEngine,
  383:             IMoment moment)
  384:         {
  385:             Assert(
  386:                 wildsEngine.Timeline.Count == 1,
  387:                 "Certification engine must record exactly one Moment.");
  388: 
  389:             Assert(
  390:                 ReferenceEquals(
  391:                     moment,
  392:                     wildsEngine.Timeline.Moments[0]),
  393:                 "Timeline must retain the exact terminal Moment.");
  394: 
  395:             Assert(
  396:                 wildsEngine.Epoch.Count == 1,
  397:                 "Certification Epoch must contain exactly one Timeline.");
  398: 
  399:             Assert(
  400:                 wildsEngine.Epoch.Timelines.Count == 1,
  401:                 "Epoch Timeline collection must contain one Timeline.");
  402: 
  403:             Assert(
  404:                 ReferenceEquals(
  405:                     wildsEngine.Timeline,
  406:                     wildsEngine.Epoch.Timelines[0]),
  407:                 "Epoch must retain the engine Timeline.");
  408: 
  409:             Assert(
  410:                 wildsEngine.Epoch
  411:                     .Timelines[0]
  412:                     .Moments
  413:                     .Count == 1,
  414:                 "Epoch Timeline must expose the terminal Moment.");
  415: 
  416:             Assert(
  417:                 ReferenceEquals(
  418:                     moment,
  419:                     wildsEngine.Epoch
  420:                         .Timelines[0]
  421:                         .Moments[0]),
  422:                 "Epoch must expose the exact terminal Moment.");
  423:         }
  424: 
  425:         private static bool NumericEquals(
  426:             object? value,
  427:             double expected)
  428:         {
  429:             if (value == null)
  430:             {
  431:                 return false;
  432:             }
  433: 
  434:             try
  435:             {
  436:                 var actual =
  437:                     Convert.ToDouble(
  438:                         value,
  439:                         CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
  440: 
  441:                 return Math.Abs(
  442:                            actual -
  443:                            expected) <
  444:                        0.0000001;
  445:             }
  446:             catch (
  447:                 InvalidCastException)
  448:             {
  449:                 return false;
  450:             }
  451:             catch (
  452:                 FormatException)
  453:             {
  454:                 return false;
  455:             }
  456:             catch (
  457:                 OverflowException)
  458:             {
  459:                 return false;
  460:             }
  461:         }
  462: 
  463:         private static string FormatValue(
  464:             object? value)
  465:         {
  466:             if (value == null)
  467:             {
  468:                 return "<null>";
  469:             }
  470: 
  471:             var formattable =
  472:                 value as IFormattable;
  473: 
  474:             if (formattable != null)
  475:             {
  476:                 return formattable.ToString(
  477:                            null,
  478:                            CultureInfo.InvariantCulture)
  479:                        ?? string.Empty;
  480:             }
  481: 
  482:             return value.ToString()
  483:                    ?? string.Empty;
  484:         }
  485: 
  486:         private static QslEngine CreateQslEngine()
  487:         {
  488:             var registry =
  489:                 new QslRuntimeRegistry();
  490: 
  491:             registry.RegisterDefaultEvaluators();
  492: 
  493:             var context =
  494:                 new QslRuntimeContext(
  495:                     registry);
  496: 
  497:             return new QslEngine(
  498:                 context);
  499:         }

  503:         {
  504:             return new TestComponent(
  505:                 layer);
  506:         }

  509:             global::WildsEngine.Core.WildsEngine
  510:             CreateWildsEngine(
  511:                 IComponent component,
  512:                 string layer)
  513:         {
  514:             return new
  515:                 global::WildsEngine.Core.WildsEngine(
  516:                     component,
  517:                     new WildsEngineOptions
  518:                     {
  519:                         Layer =
  520:                             layer,
  521: 
  522:                         RetainedInstructionsProcessors =
  523:                             1,
  524: 
  525:                         ConcurrentInstructionsProcessors =
  526:                             1,
  527: 
  528:                         RetainedTaskProcessors =
  529:                             1,
  530: 
  531:                         ConcurrentTaskProcessors =
  532:                             1
  533:                     });
  534:         }
  535: 
  536:         private static void Assert(
  537:             bool condition,
  538:             string message)
  539:         {
  540:             if (!condition)
  541:             {
  542:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  543:                     message);
  544:             }
  545:         }

   23:             "WILDS / QSL RUNTIME ISOLATION");
   24: 
   25:         TestLog.Test(
   26:             "Independent runtimes use identical aliases without sharing targets or attached state.");
   27: 
   28:         var qslA =
   29:             CreateQslEngine();
   30: 
   31:         var qslB =

   33:

   36:                 "qsl.isolation.a");

   39:             new TestComponent(

   41: 
   42:         using var wildsA =
   43:             CreateWildsEngine(
   44:                 componentA,
   45:                 "certification.qsl.isolation.a");
   46:

   48:             CreateWildsEngine(
   49:                 componentB,
   50:                 "certification.qsl.isolation.b");
   51: 
   52:         Assert.True(
   53:             wildsA.Initialize());
   54: 
   55:         Assert.True(
   56:             wildsB.Initialize());
   57:

   59:             new WildsQslExecutor(

   64:             new WildsQslExecutor(
   65:                 qslB,
   66:                 wildsB);
   67: 
   68:         var playerA =
   69:             new TestPlayer(
   70:                 100.0);
   71: 
   72:         var playerB =
   73:             new TestPlayer(
   74:                 200.0);
   75: 
   76:         var actionA =
   77:             new TestAction(
   78:                 10.0);
   79: 
   80:         var actionB =
   81:             new TestAction(
   82:                 20.0);
   83: 
   84:         /*
   85:          * Both runtimes intentionally use the exact
   86:          * same consumer aliases.
   87:          */
   88:         var playerBindingA =
   89:             new QslConsumerBinding(
   90:                 "player",
   91:                 "Player",
   92:                 playerA);
   93: 
   94:         var actionBindingA =
   95:             new QslConsumerBinding(
   96:                 "action",
   97:                 "Action",
   98:                 actionA);
   99: 
  100:         var playerBindingB =
  101:             new QslConsumerBinding(
  102:                 "player",
  103:                 "Player",
  104:                 playerB);
  105: 
  106:         var actionBindingB =
  107:             new QslConsumerBinding(
  108:                 "action",
  109:                 "Action",
  110:                 actionB);
  111: 
  112:         /*
  113:          * Both packages intentionally introduce the
  114:          * same attached-property name with different
  115:          * values and different exact target objects.
  116:          */
  117:         var packageA =
  118:             new QslStatePackage(

  125:                     }
  126:                 });
  127:

  129:             new QslStatePackage(
  130:                 actionB,
  131:                 new Dictionary<string, object?>
  132:                 {
  133:                     {
  134:                         "SpaceDustAppetite",
  135:                         75.0
  136:                     }
  137:                 });
  138: 
  139:         var source =
  140:             "player.Health = player.Health - " +
  141:             "(action.Amount * " +
  142:             "(action.SpaceDustAppetite / 100))";
  143:

  145:             new WildsQslRequest(
  146:                 source,
  147:                 new[]
  148:                 {
  149:                     playerBindingA,

  151:                 },
  152:                 new[]
  153:                 {
  154:                     packageA
  155:                 });
  156: 
  157:         var requestB =
  158:             new WildsQslRequest(
  159:                 source,
  160:                 new[]
  161:                 {
  162:                     playerBindingB,
  163:                     actionBindingB
  164:                 },
  165:                 new[]
  166:                 {
  167:                     packageB
  168:                 });
  169:

  171:             "Runtime A: player.Health=100, action.Amount=10, " +
  172:             "SpaceDustAppetite=25");
  173:

  175:             "Runtime B: player.Health=200, action.Amount=20, " +

  177:

  179:             "Executing both requests through their independent Wilds/QSL runtimes.");
  180:

  182:             await executorA.ExecuteAsync(

  184:

  186:             await executorB.ExecuteAsync(

  188:

  208:          *

  360: 
  361:         var qslA =

  469:

  472: 
  473:         var momentA =
  474:             await executorA.ExecuteAsync(
  475:                 requestA);
  476: 
  477:         Assert.Equal(
  478:             MomentOutcome.Completed,
  479:             momentA.Outcome);
  480: 
  481:         Assert.Equal(
  482:             45.0,
  483:             playerA.Health,
  484:             10);
  485: 
  486:         Assert.Equal(
  487:             45.0,
  488:             Convert.ToDouble(
  489:                 momentA.Result),
  490:             10);
  491: 
  492:         TestLog.Task(
  493:             "Executing intentionally failing Runtime B request.");
  494: 
  495:         var momentB =
  496:             await executorB.ExecuteAsync(
  497:                 requestB);
  498: 
  499:         Assert.Equal(
  500:             MomentOutcome.Failed,
  501:             momentB.Outcome);
  502: 
  503:         Assert.Null(
  504:             momentB.Result);
  505: 
  506:         Assert.NotNull(
  507:             momentB.Exception);
  508: 
  509:         /*
  510:          * Runtime B failure must not alter the already
  511:          * resolved consumer state belonging to Runtime A.
  512:          */
  513:         Assert.Equal(
  514:             45.0,
  515:             playerA.Health,
  516:             10);
  517: 
  518:         /*
  519:          * The failed source did not assign playerB.Health,
  520:          * so its native value must remain unchanged.
  521:          */
  522:         Assert.Equal(
  523:             80.0,
  524:             playerB.Health,
  525:             10);
  526: 
  527:         TestLog.State(
  528:             $"Runtime A outcome = {momentA.Outcome}");
  529: 
  530:         TestLog.State(
  531:             $"Runtime B outcome = {momentB.Outcome}");
  532: 
  533:         TestLog.State(
  534:             $"Runtime A Player.Health = {playerA.Health}");
  535: 
  536:         TestLog.State(
  537:             $"Runtime B Player.Health = {playerB.Health}");
  538: 
  539:         TestLog.Task(
  540:             "Verifying each engine retained only its own Moment.");
  541: 
  542:         Assert.Single(
  543:             wildsA.Timeline.Moments);
  544: 
  545:         Assert.Single(
  546:             wildsB.Timeline.Moments);
  547: 
  548:         Assert.Same(
  549:             momentA,
  550:             wildsA.Timeline.Moments[0]);
  551: 
  552:         Assert.Same(
  553:             momentB,
  554:             wildsB.Timeline.Moments[0]);
  555: 
  556:         Assert.NotSame(
  557:             momentA,
  558:             momentB);
  559: 
  560:         Assert.Equal(
  561:             MomentOutcome.Completed,
  562:             wildsA.Timeline.Moments[0].Outcome);
  563: 
  564:         Assert.Equal(
  565:             MomentOutcome.Failed,
  566:             wildsB.Timeline.Moments[0].Outcome);
  567: 
  568:         Assert.NotEqual(
  569:             momentA.PulseId,
  570:             momentB.PulseId);
  571: 
  572:         Assert.Same(
  573:             wildsA.Timeline,
  574:             wildsA.Epoch.Timelines[0]);
  575: 
  576:         Assert.Same(
  577:             wildsB.Timeline,
  578:             wildsB.Epoch.Timelines[0]);
  579: 
  580:         TestLog.Pass(
  581:             "Failure remained local to the failing runtime.");
  582: 
  583:         TestLog.Pass(
  584:             "Successful consumer state and history remained unchanged.");
  585: 
  586:         TestLog.Pass(
  587:             "Wilds/QSL failure-isolation certification completed successfully.");
  588:     }

  590:     [Fact]
  591: public void
  592:     ClearingOneQslRuntimeDoesNotAffectAnotherRuntime()
  593: {
  594:     TestLog.Section(
  595:         "WILDS / QSL CLEAR ISOLATION");
  596: 
  597:     TestLog.Test(
  598:         "Clearing one QSL runtime does not alter another runtime.");
  599: 
  600:     var qslA =
  601:         CreateQslEngine();
  602: 
  603:     var qslB =
  604:         CreateQslEngine();
  605: 
  606:     var playerA =
  607:         new TestPlayer(
  608:             50.0);
  609: 
  610:     var playerB =
  611:         new TestPlayer(
  612:             80.0);
  613: 
  614:     var bindingA =
  615:         new QslConsumerBinding(
  616:             "player",
  617:             "Player",
  618:             playerA);
  619: 
  620:     var bindingB =
  621:         new QslConsumerBinding(
  622:             "player",
  623:             "Player",
  624:             playerB);
  625: 
  626:     qslA.BindConsumer(
  627:         bindingA);
  628: 
  629:     qslB.BindConsumer(
  630:         bindingB);
  631: 
  632:     Assert.True(
  633:         qslA.ReceiveState(
  634:             playerA,
  635:             "Curiosity",
  636:             11.0));
  637: 
  638:     Assert.True(
  639:         qslB.ReceiveState(
  640:             playerB,
  641:             "Curiosity",
  642:             22.0));
  643: 
  644:     var beforeA =
  645:         qslA.Evaluate(
  646:             "player.Curiosity");
  647: 
  648:     var beforeB =
  649:         qslB.Evaluate(
  650:             "player.Curiosity");
  651: 
  652:     Assert.True(
  653:         beforeA.Succeeded);
  654: 
  655:     Assert.True(
  656:         beforeB.Succeeded);
  657: 
  658:     Assert.Equal(
  659:         11.0,
  660:         Convert.ToDouble(
  661:             beforeA.Value),
  662:         10);
  663: 
  664:     Assert.Equal(
  665:         22.0,
  666:         Convert.ToDouble(
  667:             beforeB.Value),
  668:         10);
  669: 
  670:     TestLog.State(
  671:         "Runtime A player.Curiosity = 11");
  672: 
  673:     TestLog.State(
  674:         "Runtime B player.Curiosity = 22");
  675: 
  676:     TestLog.Task(
  677:         "Clearing Runtime A only.");
  678: 
  679:     qslA.Clear();
  680: 
  681:     var afterA =
  682:         qslA.Evaluate(
  683:             "player.Curiosity");
  684: 
  685:     var afterB =
  686:         qslB.Evaluate(
  687:             "player.Curiosity");
  688: 
  689:     TestLog.Task(
  690:         "Verifying Runtime A no longer resolves its cleared consumer state.");
  691: 
  692:     Assert.False(
  693:         afterA.Succeeded);
  694: 
  695:     TestLog.Pass(
  696:         "Runtime A active bindings and attached state were cleared.");
  697: 
  698:     TestLog.Task(
  699:         "Verifying Runtime B remains completely operational.");
  700: 
  701:     Assert.True(
  702:         afterB.Succeeded);
  703: 
  704:     Assert.Equal(
  705:         22.0,
  706:         Convert.ToDouble(
  707:             afterB.Value),
  708:         10);
  709: 
  710:     Assert.Same(
  711:         playerB,
  712:         bindingB.Value);
  713: 
  714:     Assert.Equal(
  715:         80.0,
  716:         playerB.Health,
  717:         10);
  718: 
  719:     TestLog.State(
  720:         $"Runtime B player.Curiosity = {afterB.Value}");
  721: 
  722:     TestLog.Pass(
  723:         "Runtime B binding and attached state survived Runtime A clear.");
  724: 
  725:     TestLog.Pass(
  726:         "QSL runtime clear isolation certification completed successfully.");
  727: }

  729: [Fact]
  730: public void
  731:     UnbindingConsumerInOneRuntimeDoesNotRemoveSameAliasFromAnotherRuntime()
  732: {
  733:     TestLog.Section(
  734:         "WILDS / QSL CONSUMER UNBIND ISOLATION");
  735: 
  736:     TestLog.Test(
  737:         "Unbinding one consumer does not remove the same alias from another runtime.");
  738: 
  739:     var qslA =
  740:         CreateQslEngine();
  741: 
  742:     var qslB =
  743:         CreateQslEngine();
  744: 
  745:     var playerA =
  746:         new TestPlayer(
  747:             50.0);
  748: 
  749:     var playerB =
  750:         new TestPlayer(
  751:             80.0);
  752: 
  753:     var bindingA =
  754:         new QslConsumerBinding(
  755:             "player",
  756:             "Player",
  757:             playerA);
  758: 
  759:     var bindingB =
  760:         new QslConsumerBinding(
  761:             "player",
  762:             "Player",
  763:             playerB);
  764: 
  765:     qslA.BindConsumer(
  766:         bindingA);
  767: 
  768:     qslB.BindConsumer(
  769:         bindingB);
  770: 
  771:     Assert.True(
  772:         qslA.ReceiveState(
  773:             playerA,
  774:             "Curiosity",
  775:             11.0));
  776: 
  777:     Assert.True(
  778:         qslB.ReceiveState(
  779:             playerB,
  780:             "Curiosity",
  781:             22.0));
  782: 
  783:     var beforeA =
  784:         qslA.Evaluate(
  785:             "player.Curiosity");
  786: 
  787:     var beforeB =
  788:         qslB.Evaluate(
  789:             "player.Curiosity");
  790: 
  791:     Assert.True(
  792:         beforeA.Succeeded);
  793: 
  794:     Assert.True(
  795:         beforeB.Succeeded);
  796: 
  797:     Assert.Equal(
  798:         11.0,
  799:         Convert.ToDouble(
  800:             beforeA.Value),
  801:         10);
  802: 
  803:     Assert.Equal(
  804:         22.0,
  805:         Convert.ToDouble(
  806:             beforeB.Value),
  807:         10);
  808: 
  809:     TestLog.Task(
  810:         "Unbinding Runtime A player.");
  811: 
  812:     Assert.True(
  813:         qslA.UnbindConsumer(
  814:             bindingA));
  815: 
  816:     var afterA =
  817:         qslA.Evaluate(
  818:             "player.Curiosity");
  819: 
  820:     var afterB =
  821:         qslB.Evaluate(
  822:             "player.Curiosity");
  823: 
  824:     TestLog.Task(
  825:         "Verifying Runtime A no longer resolves the unbound consumer.");
  826: 
  827:     Assert.False(
  828:         afterA.Succeeded);
  829: 
  830:     TestLog.Pass(
  831:         "Runtime A consumer binding was removed.");
  832: 
  833:     TestLog.Task(
  834:         "Verifying Runtime B still resolves its independent player alias.");
  835: 
  836:     Assert.True(
  837:         afterB.Succeeded);
  838: 
  839:     Assert.Equal(
  840:         22.0,
  841:         Convert.ToDouble(
  842:             afterB.Value),
  843:         10);
  844: 
  845:     Assert.Same(
  846:         playerB,
  847:         bindingB.Value);
  848: 
  849:     Assert.Equal(
  850:         80.0,
  851:         playerB.Health,
  852:         10);
  853: 
  854:     TestLog.Pass(
  855:         "Runtime B same-name consumer remained bound.");
  856: 
  857:     TestLog.Task(
  858:         "Verifying Runtime A unbind retired attached state for the exact object.");
  859: 
  860:     /*
  861:      * Rebinding the exact object must not resurrect
  862:      * the attached Curiosity state that UnbindConsumer
  863:      * retired.
  864:      */
  865:     qslA.BindConsumer(
  866:         bindingA);
  867: 
  868:     var reboundA =
  869:         qslA.Evaluate(
  870:             "player.Curiosity");
  871: 
  872:     Assert.False(
  873:         reboundA.Succeeded);
  874: 
  875:     /*
  876:      * Runtime B must still retain its own attached state.
  877:      */
  878:     var stillBoundB =
  879:         qslB.Evaluate(
  880:             "player.Curiosity");
  881: 
  882:     Assert.True(
  883:         stillBoundB.Succeeded);
  884: 
  885:     Assert.Equal(
  886:         22.0,
  887:         Convert.ToDouble(
  888:             stillBoundB.Value),
  889:         10);
  890: 
  891:     TestLog.Pass(
  892:         "Unbinding retired only Runtime A attached state.");
  893: 
  894:     TestLog.Pass(
  895:         "Runtime B attached state remained intact.");
  896: 
  897:     TestLog.Pass(
  898:         "QSL consumer-unbind isolation certification completed successfully.");
  899: }

  721:         private static void TaskRegistrySupportsCoreBehavior()
  722:         {
  723:             TestLog.Write(
  724:                 "[TEST] Repeat core behavior for task registry");
  725: 
  726:             var component =
  727:                 CreateComponent(
  728:                     "certification.task");
  729: 
  730:             var registry =
  731:                 CreateTaskRegistry(
  732:                     component);
  733: 
  734:             Assert(
  735:                 registry.Count == 0,
  736:                 "A new task registry should start empty.");
  737: 
  738:             var first =
  739:                 new TestTask(
  740:                     component,
  741:                     "certification.task.first");
  742: 
  743:             var second =
  744:                 new TestTask(
  745:                     component,
  746:                     "certification.task.second");
  747: 
  748:             TestLog.Write(
  749:                 $"    [PARK] {DescribeTask(first)}");
  750: 
  751:             TestLog.Write(
  752:                 $"    [PARK] {DescribeTask(second)}");
  753: 
  754:             Assert(
  755:                 registry.Register(
  756:                     first),
  757:                 "The first task should be parked.");
  758: 
  759:             Assert(
  760:                 registry.Register(
  761:                     second),
  762:                 "The second task should be parked.");
  763: 
  764:             Assert(
  765:                 registry.Count == 2,
  766:                 "The task registry should contain both tasks.");
  767: 
  768:             Assert(
  769:                 ReferenceEquals(
  770:                     first,
  771:                     registry.Get(first.Id)),
  772:                 "The task registry should preserve reference identity.");
  773: 
  774:             Assert(
  775:                 !registry.Register(
  776:                     first),
  777:                 "Duplicate task registration should be rejected.");
  778: 
  779:             foreach (var task in registry.Items)
  780:             {
  781:                 TestLog.Write(
  782:                     $"    [ITEM] {DescribeTask(task)}");
  783:             }
  784: 
  785:             TestLog.Write(
  786:                 $"    [REMOVE] Task {first.Id}");
  787: 
  788:             Assert(
  789:                 registry.Remove(
  790:                     first.Id),
  791:                 "Removing the first task should succeed.");
  792: 
  793:             Assert(
  794:                 !registry.Contains(
  795:                     first.Id),
  796:                 "The removed task should no longer be parked.");
  797: 
  798:             Assert(
  799:                 registry.Contains(
  800:                     second.Id),
  801:                 "The remaining task should be unaffected.");
  802: 
  803:             registry.Clear();
  804: 
  805:             Assert(
  806:                 registry.Count == 0,
  807:                 "Clearing should empty the task registry.");
  808: 
  809:             Assert(
  810:                 registry.Items.Count == 0,
  811:                 "The task registry should enumerate no items after Clear.");
  812: 
  813:             TestLog.Pass(
  814:                 "Repeat core behavior for task registry");
  815:         }
  816: 
  817:         private static async Task
  818:             ConcurrentRegistrationAndRemovalStressAsync()
  819:         {
  820:             TestLog.Write(
  821:                 "[TEST] Concurrent registration/removal stress");
  822: 
  823:             var component =
  824:                 CreateComponent(
  825:                     "certification.registry.concurrent");
  826: 
  827:             var registry =
  828:                 CreateInstructionRegistry(
  829:                     component);
  830: 
  831:             var instructions =
  832:                 CreateInstructionSet(
  833:                     ConcurrentItemCount,
  834:                     "certification.instruction.concurrent");
  835: 
  836:             TestLog.Write(
  837:                 $"    [TASK] Concurrently parking " +
  838:                 $"{instructions.Count} instructions");
  839: 
  840:             var registrationTasks =
  841:                 new List<Task>(
  842:                     instructions.Count);
  843: 
  844:             foreach (var instruction in instructions)
  845:             {
  846:                 registrationTasks.Add(
  847:                     Task.Run(
  848:                         () =>
  849:                         {
  850:                             var registered =
  851:                                 registry.Register(
  852:                                     instruction);
  853: 
  854:                             Assert(
  855:                                 registered,
  856:                                 $"Concurrent registration failed " +
  857:                                 $"for {instruction.Id}.");
  858:                         }));
  859:             }
  860: 
  861:             await Task.WhenAll(
  862:                     registrationTasks)
  863:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  864: 
  865:             TestLog.Write(
  866:                 $"    [STATE] Count after registration = " +
  867:                 $"{registry.Count}");
  868: 
  869:             Assert(
  870:                 registry.Count == instructions.Count,
  871:                 "Concurrent registration should retain " +
  872:                 "every unique instruction.");
  873: 
  874:             foreach (var instruction in instructions)
  875:             {
  876:                 Assert(
  877:                     registry.Contains(
  878:                         instruction.Id),
  879:                     $"Instruction {instruction.Id} should be parked.");
  880:             }
  881: 
  882:             var removedInstructions =
  883:                 instructions
  884:                     .Where(
  885:                         (_, index) =>
  886:                             index % 2 == 0)
  887:                     .ToArray();
  888: 
  889:             var retainedInstructions =
  890:                 instructions
  891:                     .Where(
  892:                         (_, index) =>
  893:                             index % 2 != 0)
  894:                     .ToArray();
  895: 
  896:             TestLog.Write(
  897:                 $"    [TASK] Concurrently removing " +
  898:                 $"{removedInstructions.Length} instructions");
  899: 
  900:             var removalTasks =
  901:                 new List<Task>(
  902:                     removedInstructions.Length);
  903: 
  904:             foreach (var instruction in removedInstructions)
  905:             {
  906:                 removalTasks.Add(
  907:                     Task.Run(
  908:                         () =>
  909:                         {
  910:                             var removed =
  911:                                 registry.Remove(
  912:                                     instruction.Id);
  913: 
  914:                             Assert(
  915:                                 removed,
  916:                                 $"Concurrent removal failed " +
  917:                                 $"for {instruction.Id}.");
  918:                         }));
  919:             }
  920: 
  921:             await Task.WhenAll(
  922:                     removalTasks)
  923:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  924: 
  925:             TestLog.Write(
  926:                 $"    [STATE] Count after removal = " +
  927:                 $"{registry.Count}");
  928: 
  929:             Assert(
  930:                 registry.Count == retainedInstructions.Length,
  931:                 "Concurrent removal should leave the " +
  932:                 "expected instruction count.");
  933: 
  934:             foreach (var instruction in removedInstructions)
  935:             {
  936:                 Assert(
  937:                     !registry.Contains(
  938:                         instruction.Id),
  939:                     $"Removed instruction {instruction.Id} " +
  940:                     "should be absent.");
  941:             }
  942: 
  943:             foreach (var instruction in retainedInstructions)
  944:             {
  945:                 Assert(
  946:                     registry.Contains(
  947:                         instruction.Id),
  948:                     $"Retained instruction {instruction.Id} " +
  949:                     "should remain parked.");
  950: 
  951:                 Assert(
  952:                     ReferenceEquals(
  953:                         instruction,
  954:                         registry.Get(
  955:                             instruction.Id)),
  956:                     $"Retained instruction {instruction.Id} " +
  957:                     "should preserve its reference.");
  958:             }
  959: 
  960:             registry.Clear();
  961: 
  962:             Assert(
  963:                 registry.Count == 0,
  964:                 "The stressed registry should remain clearable.");
  965: 
  966:             TestLog.Pass(
  967:                 "Concurrent registration/removal stress");
  968:         }

 1005:             CreateInstructionSet(
 1006:                 int count,
 1007:                 string intentPrefix)
 1008:         {
 1009:             var instructions =
 1010:                 new List<TestInstruction>(
 1011:                     count);
 1012: 
 1013:             for (var i = 0; i < count; i++)
 1014:             {
 1015:                 instructions.Add(
 1016:                     new TestInstruction(
 1017:                         $"{intentPrefix}.{i:D4}",
 1018:                         payload: i));
 1019:             }
 1020: 
 1021:             return instructions;
 1022:         }

 1067:                     $"Registry test failed: {message}");
 1068:             }

 1071:         private sealed class TestInstructionRegistry :

   49:         private static void BasicTaskLifecycle()
   50:         {
   51:             const string testName =
   52:                 "Task registry basic lifecycle";
   53: 
   54:             TestLog.Write(
   55:                 $"[TEST] {testName}");
   56: 
   57:             var component =
   58:                 CreateComponent(
   59:                     "test.task-registry.basic");
   60: 
   61:             var registry =
   62:                 new DefaultTasksRegistry(
   63:                     component,
   64:                     "test.task-registry.basic");
   65: 
   66:             TestLog.Write(
   67:                 "    [TASK] Initializing task registry");
   68: 
   69:             Assert(
   70:                 registry.Initialize(),
   71:                 "First registry initialization should succeed.");
   72: 
   73:             Assert(
   74:                 registry.IsInitialized,
   75:                 "Registry should report initialized.");
   76: 
   77:             Assert(
   78:                 registry.Count == 0,
   79:                 "Registry should begin empty.");
   80: 
   81:             var task =
   82:                 new TestTask(
   83:                     component,
   84:                     "test.task.basic");
   85: 
   86:             TestLog.Write(
   87:                 $"    [PARK] Task {task.Id}");
   88: 
   89:             Assert(
   90:                 registry.Register(task),
   91:                 "Task should register successfully.");
   92: 
   93:             Assert(
   94:                 registry.Count == 1,
   95:                 "Registry count should become one.");
   96: 
   97:             Assert(
   98:                 registry.Contains(task.Id),
   99:                 "Registry should contain the parked task.");
  100: 
  101:             var retrieved =
  102:                 registry.Get(
  103:                     task.Id);
  104: 
  105:             TestLog.Write(
  106:                 $"    [READ] Task {task.Id}");
  107: 
  108:             Assert(
  109:                 retrieved != null,
  110:                 "Parked task should be retrievable.");
  111: 
  112:             if (retrieved == null)
  113:             {
  114:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  115:                     "TaskRegistry test failed: " +
  116:                     "Parked task retrieval returned null.");
  117:             }
  118: 
  119:             Assert(
  120:                 ReferenceEquals(
  121:                     task,
  122:                     retrieved),
  123:                 "Retrieved task should be the parked instance.");
  124: 
  125:             Assert(
  126:                 registry.TryGet(
  127:                     task.Id,
  128:                     out var tried),
  129:                 "TryGet should find the parked task.");
  130: 
  131:             Assert(
  132:                 tried != null,
  133:                 "TryGet should return a task.");
  134: 
  135:             Assert(
  136:                 ReferenceEquals(
  137:                     task,
  138:                     tried),
  139:                 "TryGet should return the parked instance.");
  140: 
  141:             Assert(
  142:                 !registry.Register(task),
  143:                 "Duplicate task registration should be rejected.");
  144: 
  145:             Assert(
  146:                 registry.Count == 1,
  147:                 "Duplicate registration must not change count.");
  148: 
  149:             TestLog.Write(
  150:                 $"    [REMOVE] Task {task.Id}");
  151: 
  152:             Assert(
  153:                 registry.Remove(task.Id),
  154:                 "Parked task should be removable.");
  155: 
  156:             Assert(
  157:                 registry.Count == 0,
  158:                 "Registry should be empty after removal.");
  159: 
  160:             Assert(
  161:                 !registry.Contains(task.Id),
  162:                 "Removed task should no longer be contained.");
  163: 
  164:             Assert(
  165:                 registry.Get(task.Id) == null,
  166:                 "Removed task should no longer be retrievable.");
  167: 
  168:             Assert(
  169:                 !registry.Remove(task.Id),
  170:                 "Removing an absent task should return false.");
  171: 
  172:             Assert(
  173:                 registry.Shutdown(),
  174:                 "First registry shutdown should succeed.");
  175: 
  176:             Assert(
  177:                 !registry.IsInitialized,
  178:                 "Registry should report stopped.");
  179: 
  180:             TestLog.Write(
  181:                 $"[PASS] {testName}");
  182:         }

  184:         private static void HighVolumeTaskLifecycle(
  185:             int taskCount)
  186:         {
  187:             var testName =
  188:                 $"Task registry lifecycle at {taskCount:N0}";
  189: 
  190:             TestLog.Write(
  191:                 $"[TEST] {testName}");
  192: 
  193:             var component =
  194:                 CreateComponent(
  195:                     $"test.task-registry.{taskCount}");
  196: 
  197:             var registry =
  198:                 new DefaultTasksRegistry(
  199:                     component,
  200:                     $"test.task-registry.{taskCount}");
  201: 
  202:             Assert(
  203:                 registry.Initialize(),
  204:                 "Registry initialization should succeed.");
  205: 
  206:             var taskIds =
  207:                 new Guid[taskCount];
  208: 
  209:             var registrationWatch =
  210:                 Stopwatch.StartNew();
  211: 
  212:             TestLog.Write(
  213:                 $"    [TASK] Parking {taskCount:N0} tasks");
  214: 
  215:             for (var i = 0; i < taskCount; i++)
  216:             {
  217:                 var task =
  218:                     new TestTask(
  219:                         component,
  220:                         "test.task.parked");
  221: 
  222:                 taskIds[i] =
  223:                     task.Id;
  224: 
  225:                 if (!registry.Register(task))
  226:                 {
  227:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  228:                         $"Task registration failed at index {i:N0}.");
  229:                 }
  230:             }
  231: 
  232:             registrationWatch.Stop();
  233: 
  234:             TestLog.Write(
  235:                 $"    [STATE] Parked count = {registry.Count:N0}");
  236: 
  237:             TestLog.Write(
  238:                 $"    [TIME] Registration = " +
  239:                 $"{registrationWatch.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds:F3} ms");
  240: 
  241:             Assert(
  242:                 registry.Count == taskCount,
  243:                 $"Registry should contain {taskCount:N0} tasks.");
  244: 
  245:             Assert(
  246:                 registry.Items.Count == taskCount,
  247:                 "Items should expose every parked task.");
  248: 
  249:             VerifyRepresentativeTasks(
  250:                 registry,
  251:                 taskIds);
  252: 
  253:             var duplicateId =
  254:                 taskIds[taskCount / 2];
  255: 
  256:             var duplicateTask =
  257:                 registry.Get(
  258:                     duplicateId);
  259: 
  260:             Assert(
  261:                 duplicateTask != null,
  262:                 "Representative task should be available.");
  263: 
  264:             if (duplicateTask == null)
  265:             {
  266:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  267:                     "TaskRegistry test failed: " +
  268:                     "Representative task retrieval returned null.");
  269:             }
  270: 
  271:             Assert(
  272:                 !registry.Register(duplicateTask),
  273:                 "Duplicate task registration should be rejected.");
  274: 
  275:             Assert(
  276:                 registry.Count == taskCount,
  277:                 "Duplicate registration must not alter count.");
  278: 
  279:             var retrievalWatch =
  280:                 Stopwatch.StartNew();
  281: 
  282:             TestLog.Write(
  283:                 $"    [TASK] Reading {taskCount:N0} parked tasks");
  284: 
  285:             for (var i = 0; i < taskIds.Length; i++)
  286:             {
  287:                 if (!registry.TryGet(
  288:                         taskIds[i],
  289:                         out var task))
  290:                 {
  291:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  292:                         $"Task retrieval failed at index {i:N0}.");
  293:                 }
  294: 
  295:                 if (task == null)
  296:                 {
  297:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  298:                         $"Task retrieval returned null at index {i:N0}.");
  299:                 }
  300: 
  301:                 if (task.Id != taskIds[i])
  302:                 {
  303:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  304:                         $"Task identity mismatch at index {i:N0}.");
  305:                 }
  306:             }
  307: 
  308:             retrievalWatch.Stop();
  309: 
  310:             TestLog.Write(
  311:                 $"    [TIME] Retrieval = " +
  312:                 $"{retrievalWatch.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds:F3} ms");
  313: 
  314:             var removalWatch =
  315:                 Stopwatch.StartNew();
  316: 
  317:             TestLog.Write(
  318:                 $"    [TASK] Removing {taskCount:N0} parked tasks");
  319: 
  320:             for (var i = 0; i < taskIds.Length; i++)
  321:             {
  322:                 if (!registry.Remove(
  323:                         taskIds[i]))
  324:                 {
  325:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  326:                         $"Task removal failed at index {i:N0}.");
  327:                 }
  328:             }
  329: 
  330:             removalWatch.Stop();
  331: 
  332:             TestLog.Write(
  333:                 $"    [STATE] Remaining count = {registry.Count:N0}");
  334: 
  335:             TestLog.Write(
  336:                 $"    [TIME] Removal = " +
  337:                 $"{removalWatch.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds:F3} ms");
  338: 
  339:             Assert(
  340:                 registry.Count == 0,
  341:                 "Registry should be empty after every task is removed.");
  342: 
  343:             Assert(
  344:                 registry.Items.Count == 0,
  345:                 "Items should be empty after removal.");
  346: 
  347:             VerifyTasksAreAbsent(
  348:                 registry,
  349:                 taskIds);
  350: 
  351:             Assert(
  352:                 registry.Shutdown(),
  353:                 "Registry shutdown should succeed.");
  354: 
  355:             TestLog.Write(
  356:                 $"[PASS] {testName}");
  357:         }

  359:         private static void VerifyRepresentativeTasks(
  360:             ITaskRegistry registry,
  361:             Guid[] taskIds)
  362:         {
  363:             var indexes =
  364:                 new[]
  365:                 {
  366:                     0,
  367:                     taskIds.Length / 2,
  368:                     taskIds.Length - 1
  369:                 };
  370: 
  371:             for (var i = 0; i < indexes.Length; i++)
  372:             {
  373:                 var index =
  374:                     indexes[i];
  375: 
  376:                 var id =
  377:                     taskIds[index];
  378: 
  379:                 TestLog.Write(
  380:                     $"    [READ] Representative task " +
  381:                     $"{index:N0}: {id}");
  382: 
  383:                 Assert(
  384:                     registry.Contains(id),
  385:                     $"Registry should contain task at index {index:N0}.");
  386: 
  387:                 var task =
  388:                     registry.Get(id);
  389: 
  390:                 Assert(
  391:                     task != null,
  392:                     $"Task at index {index:N0} should be retrievable.");
  393: 
  394:                 if (task == null)
  395:                 {
  396:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  397:                         "TaskRegistry test failed: " +
  398:                         $"Task at index {index:N0} returned null.");
  399:                 }
  400: 
  401:                 Assert(
  402:                     task.Id == id,
  403:                     $"Task at index {index:N0} should preserve identity.");
  404:             }
  405:         }
  406: 
  407:         private static void VerifyTasksAreAbsent(
  408:             ITaskRegistry registry,
  409:             Guid[] taskIds)
  410:         {
  411:             var indexes =
  412:                 new[]
  413:                 {
  414:                     0,
  415:                     taskIds.Length / 2,
  416:                     taskIds.Length - 1
  417:                 };

  420:             {
  421:                 var index =
  422:                     indexes[i];

  425:                     taskIds[index];

  428:                     $"    [VERIFY] Removed task " +
  429:                     $"{index:N0}: {id}");
  430: 
  431:                 Assert(
  432:                     !registry.Contains(id),
  433:                     $"Removed task at index {index:N0} " +

  437:                     registry.Get(id) == null,
  438:                     $"Removed task at index {index:N0} " +

  441:                 Assert(
  442:                     !registry.TryGet(
  443:                         id,
  444:                         out var task),
  445:                     $"TryGet should reject removed task " +
  446:                     $"at index {index:N0}.");
  447: 
  448:                 Assert(
  449:                     task == null,
  450:                     "Failed TryGet should return null.");
  451:             }
  452:         }

   21:         {

   25:             TestLog.Test(

   30:                     "player-request");
   31: 
   32:             var pulse =
   33:                 new Pulse(
   34:                     request);
   35: 
   36:             Assert.True(
   37:                 pulse.TryBeginDecomposition());
   38:

   43:

   51:                     pulse,
   52:                     "Task");

   57:

   61:

   63:                 coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
   64:                     second));
   65: 
   66:             Assert.True(
   67:                 coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
   68:                     third));
   69: 
   70:             TestLog.State(
   71:                 $"Pulse {pulse.Id} owns " +
   72:                 $"{coordinator.WorkUnitCount} required WorkUnits");
   73: 
   74:             Assert.True(
   75:                 pulse.TryMarkPending());
   76: 
   77:             Assert.True(
   78:                 pulse.TryMarkReady());
   79: 
   80:             Assert.True(
   81:                 pulse.TryBeginProcessing());
   82: 
   83:             BeginAndComplete(
   84:                 first,
   85:                 "qsl-result");
   86: 
   87:             TestLog.Task(
   88:                 "WorkUnit A completed");
   89: 
   90:             BeginAndComplete(
   91:                 second,
   92:                 "instruction-result");
   93: 
   94:             TestLog.Task(
   95:                 "WorkUnit B completed");
   96: 
   97:             Assert.True(
   98:                 third.TryBeginProcessing());
   99: 
  100:             TestLog.Task(
  101:                 "WorkUnit C still processing");
  102: 
  103:             Assert.False(
  104:                 coordinator.CanResolve);
  105: 
  106:             Assert.False(
  107:                 coordinator.TryResolve(
  108:                     "too-early",
  109:                     out var earlyMoment));
  110: 
  111:             Assert.Null(
  112:                 earlyMoment);
  113: 
  114:             Assert.Equal(
  115:                 PulseStatus.Processing,
  116:                 pulse.Status);
  117: 
  118:             TestLog.Expected(
  119:                 "Pulse refused early completion");
  120:

  122:                 new TestRuntimeObject(
  123:                     "final-result");
  124:

  126:                 third.TryComplete(
  127:                     finalResult));
  128: 
  129:             TestLog.Task(
  130:                 "WorkUnit C completed");
  131: 
  132:             Assert.True(
  133:                 coordinator.CanResolve);
  134: 
  135:             Assert.True(
  136:                 coordinator.TryResolve(
  137:                     finalResult,
  138:                     out var moment));
  139: 
  140:             Assert.NotNull(
  141:                 moment);
  142: 
  143:             Assert.Equal(
  144:                 PulseStatus.Completed,
  145:                 pulse.Status);
  146: 
  147:             Assert.True(
  148:                 pulse.IsTerminal);
  149: 
  150:             Assert.Equal(
  151:                 pulse.Id,
  152:                 moment!.PulseId);
  153: 
  154:             Assert.Equal(
  155:                 3,
  156:                 moment.WorkUnitIds.Count);
  157: 
  158:             Assert.Contains(
  159:                 first.Id,
  160:                 moment.WorkUnitIds);
  161: 
  162:             Assert.Contains(
  163:                 second.Id,
  164:                 moment.WorkUnitIds);
  165: 
  166:             Assert.Contains(
  167:                 third.Id,
  168:                 moment.WorkUnitIds);
  169: 
  170:             Assert.Same(
  171:                 finalResult,
  172:                 moment.Result);
  173: 
  174:             TestLog.State(
  175:                 "All required WorkUnits resolved");
  176: 
  177:             TestLog.State(
  178:                 $"Moment {moment.Id} closed Pulse {pulse.Id}");
  179: 
  180:             TestLog.Pass(
  181:                 "Pulse completed only after all required work completed");
  182:         }
