  230:                 coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  231:                     work));
  232: 
  233:             Assert.False(
  234:                 coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  235:                     work));
  236: 
  237:             Assert.Equal(
  238:                 1,
  239:                 coordinator.WorkUnitCount);
  240:         }
  241: 
  242:         [Fact]
  243:         public void FailedWorkPreventsSuccessfulResolution()
  244:         {
  245:             TestLog.Test(
  246:                 "Failed WorkUnit prevents successful Pulse resolution");
  247: 
  248:             var pulse =
  249:                 CreateProcessingPulse(
  250:                     "failure-request");
  251: 
  252:             var completed =
  253:                 CreateWork(
  254:                     pulse,
  255:                     "completed");
  256: 
  257:             var failed =
  258:                 CreateWork(
  259:                     pulse,
  260:                     "failed");
  261: 
  262:             var coordinator =
  263:                 new PulseCoordinator(
  264:                     pulse);
  265: 
  266:             Assert.True(
  267:                 coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  268:                     completed));
  269: 
  270:             Assert.True(
  271:                 coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  272:                     failed));
  273: 
  274:             BeginAndComplete(
  275:                 completed,
  276:                 "completed-result");
  277: 
  278:             Assert.True(
  279:                 failed.TryBeginProcessing());
  280: 
  281:             var failure =
  282:                 new InvalidOperationException(
  283:                     "Expected WorkUnit failure.");
  284: 
  285:             Assert.True(
  286:                 failed.TryFail(
  287:                     failure));
  288: 
  289:             Assert.False(
  290:                 coordinator.CanResolve);
  291: 
  292:             Assert.False(
  293:                 coordinator.TryResolve(
  294:                     "must-not-succeed",
  295:                     out var moment));
  296: 
  297:             Assert.Null(
  298:                 moment);
  299: 
  300:             Assert.Equal(
  301:                 PulseStatus.Processing,
  302:                 pulse.Status);
  303: 
  304:             Assert.Same(
  305:                 failure,
  306:                 failed.Exception);
  307: 
  308:             TestLog.Expected(
  309:                 "Failed WorkUnit blocked successful Pulse resolution");
  310: 
  311:             TestLog.Pass(
  312:                 "Failure cannot masquerade as successful completion");
  313:         }
  314:

  381:         public void EmptyCoordinatorCannotResolvePulse()
  382:         {
  383:             var pulse =
  384:                 CreateProcessingPulse(
  385:                     "empty-request");
  386: 
  387:             var coordinator =
  388:                 new PulseCoordinator(
  389:                     pulse);
  390: 
  391:             Assert.Equal(
  392:                 0,
  393:                 coordinator.WorkUnitCount);
  394: 
  395:             Assert.False(
  396:                 coordinator.CanResolve);
  397: 
  398:             Assert.False(
  399:                 coordinator.TryResolve(
  400:                     "result",
  401:                     out var moment));
  402:

  405: 
  406:             Assert.Equal(
  407:                 PulseStatus.Processing,
  408:                 pulse.Status);

  410: 
  411:         private static Pulse CreateProcessingPulse(
  412:             object? request)
  413:         {
  414:             var pulse =
  415:                 new Pulse(
  416:                     request);
  417: 
  418:             Assert.True(
  419:                 pulse.TryBeginDecomposition());
  420: 
  421:             Assert.True(
  422:                 pulse.TryMarkPending());
  423: 
  424:             Assert.True(
  425:                 pulse.TryMarkReady());
  426: 
  427:             Assert.True(
  428:                 pulse.TryBeginProcessing());
  429: 
  430:             return pulse;
  431:         }
  432: 
  433:         private static WorkUnit CreateWork(
  434:             Pulse pulse,
  435:             object? payload)
  436:         {
  437:             var work =
  438:                 new WorkUnit(
  439:                     pulse.Id,
  440:                     payload);
  441: 
  442:             Assert.True(
  443:                 work.TryMarkPending());
  444: 
  445:             return work;
  446:         }
  447: 
  448:         private static void BeginAndComplete(
  449:             WorkUnit work,
  450:             object? result)
  451:         {
  452:             Assert.True(
  453:                 work.TryBeginProcessing());
  454: 
  455:             Assert.True(
  456:                 work.TryComplete(
  457:                     result));
  458:         }
  459: 
  460:         private sealed class TestRuntimeObject
  461:         {
  462:             public TestRuntimeObject(
  463:                 string name)
  464:             {
  465:                 Name = name;
  466:             }
  467: 
  468:             public string Name { get; }
  469:         }
  470:     }
  471: }

   12:     [Fact]
   13:     public void
   14:         OneRequestCanOwnMultipleRequiredWorkUnits()
   15:     {
   16:         TestLog.Section(
   17:             "PULSE MULTI-WORK DECOMPOSITION");
   18: 
   19:         TestLog.Test(
   20:             "One request owns multiple required WorkUnits through one Pulse.");
   21: 
   22:         var request =
   23:             new TestRuntimeObject(
   24:                 "consumer-request");
   25: 
   26:         var pulse =
   27:             new Pulse(
   28:                 request);
   29: 
   30:         Assert.True(
   31:             pulse.TryBeginDecomposition());
   32: 
   33:         var qslWork =
   34:             new WorkUnit(
   35:                 pulse.Id,
   36:                 new TestRuntimeObject(
   37:                     "qsl-work"));
   38: 
   39:         var instructionWork =
   40:             new WorkUnit(
   41:                 pulse.Id,
   42:                 new TestRuntimeObject(
   43:                     "instruction-work"));
   44: 
   45:         var taskWork =
   46:             new WorkUnit(
   47:                 pulse.Id,
   48:                 new TestRuntimeObject(
   49:                     "task-work"));
   50: 
   51:         var coordinator =
   52:             new PulseCoordinator(
   53:                 pulse);
   54: 
   55:         Assert.True(
   56:             coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
   57:                 qslWork));
   58: 
   59:         Assert.True(
   60:             coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
   61:                 instructionWork));
   62: 
   63:         Assert.True(
   64:             coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
   65:                 taskWork));
   66: 
   67:         Assert.Equal(
   68:             3,
   69:             coordinator.WorkUnitCount);
   70: 
   71:         Assert.Equal(
   72:             pulse.Id,
   73:             qslWork.PulseId);
   74: 
   75:         Assert.Equal(
   76:             pulse.Id,
   77:             instructionWork.PulseId);
   78: 
   79:         Assert.Equal(
   80:             pulse.Id,
   81:             taskWork.PulseId);
   82: 
   83:         Assert.NotEqual(
   84:             qslWork.Id,
   85:             instructionWork.Id);
   86: 
   87:         Assert.NotEqual(
   88:             qslWork.Id,
   89:             taskWork.Id);
   90: 
   91:         Assert.NotEqual(
   92:             instructionWork.Id,
   93:             taskWork.Id);
   94: 
   95:         TestLog.State(
   96:             $"Pulse = {pulse.Id}");
   97: 
   98:         TestLog.State(
   99:             $"Required WorkUnits = {coordinator.WorkUnitCount}");
  100: 
  101:         TestLog.State(
  102:             $"QSL WorkUnit = {qslWork.Id}");
  103: 
  104:         TestLog.State(
  105:             $"Instruction WorkUnit = {instructionWork.Id}");
  106: 
  107:         TestLog.State(
  108:             $"Task WorkUnit = {taskWork.Id}");
  109: 
  110:         TestLog.Pass(
  111:             "One request decomposed into three distinct required WorkUnits.");
  112: 
  113:         TestLog.Pass(
  114:             "Every WorkUnit retained the owning Pulse identity.");
  115:     }

  435:

  438: 
  439:         Assert.Null(

  445:

  457:

  465:

  484:

  613:

  615:             completed.Id,
  616:             moment.WorkUnitIds);
  617: 
  618:         Assert.Contains(
  619:             cancelled.Id,
  620:             moment.WorkUnitIds);
  621: 
  622:         Assert.Contains(
  623:             remaining.Id,
  624:             moment.WorkUnitIds);
  625: 
  626:         Assert.Same(
  627:             subordinateResult,
  628:             completed.Result);
  629: 
  630:         Assert.False(
  631:             ReferenceEquals(
  632:                 subordinateResult,
  633:                 moment.Result));
  634: 
  635:         Assert.False(
  636:             ReferenceEquals(
  637:                 forbiddenFinalResult,
  638:                 moment.Result));
  639: 
  640:         TestLog.State(
  641:             $"Pulse outcome = {pulse.Status}");
  642: 
  643:         TestLog.State(
  644:             $"Moment outcome = {moment.Outcome}");
  645: 
  646:         TestLog.Pass(
  647:             "Partial success could not override Pulse cancellation.");
  648: 
  649:         TestLog.Pass(
  650:             "Cancellation became the authoritative terminal history.");
  651:     }
  652: 
  653:     private static Pulse CreateProcessingPulse(
  654:         object? request)
  655:     {
  656:         var pulse =
  657:             new Pulse(
  658:                 request);
  659: 
  660:         Assert.True(
  661:             pulse.TryBeginDecomposition());
  662: 
  663:         Assert.True(
  664:             pulse.TryMarkPending());
  665: 
  666:         Assert.True(
  667:             pulse.TryMarkReady());
  668: 
  669:         Assert.True(
  670:             pulse.TryBeginProcessing());
  671: 
  672:         return pulse;
  673:     }
  674: 
  675:     private static WorkUnit CreateProcessingWork(
  676:         Pulse pulse,
  677:         object? payload)
  678:     {
  679:         var work =
  680:             new WorkUnit(
  681:                 pulse.Id,
  682:                 payload);
  683: 
  684:         Assert.True(
  685:             work.TryMarkPending());
  686: 
  687:         Assert.True(
  688:             work.TryBeginProcessing());
  689: 
  690:         return work;
  691:     }

FILE: WildsEngine.Core.Tests\Temporal\TemporalConcurrencyOrderingCertificationTests.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using System.Threading;
    4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
    5: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    6: using WildsEngine.Core.Units;
    7: using WildsEngine.Tests.Logging;
    8: using WildsEngine.Tests.Registry;
    9: using Xunit;
   10: 
   11: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Tests;
   12: 
   13: public sealed class TemporalConcurrencyOrderingCertificationTests
   14: {
   15:     [Fact]
   16:     public async Task ConcurrentTimelineCommitsPreserveSuccessfulSerializedOrder()
   17:     {
   18:         TestLog.Section(
   19:             "TEMPORAL CONCURRENCY - TIMELINE COMMIT ORDER");
   20: 
   21:         TestLog.Test(
   22:             "Concurrent Moment commits produce one coherent serialized Timeline order.");
   23: 
   24:         const int count =
   25:             64;
   26: 
   27:         var timeline =
   28:             new Timeline();
   29: 
   30:         var moments =
   31:             new Moment[count];
   32: 
   33:         for (var index = 0;
   34:              index < count;
   35:              index++)
   36:         {
   37:             moments[index] =
   38:                 new Moment(
   39:                     Guid.NewGuid(),
   40:                     index,
   41:                     new[]
   42:                     {
   43:                         Guid.NewGuid()
   44:                     });
   45:         }
   46: 
   47:         var readyCount =
   48:             0;
   49: 
   50:         var allReady =
   51:             new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
   52:                 TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
   53: 
   54:         var release =
   55:             new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
   56:                 TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
   57: 
   58:         var tasks =
   59:             new Task<bool>[count];
   60: 
   61:         for (var index = 0;
   62:              index < count;
   63:              index++)
   64:         {
   65:             var captured =
   66:                 moments[index];
   67: 
   68:             tasks[index] =
   69:                 Task.Run(
   70:                     async () =>
   71:                     {
   72:                         if (Interlocked.Increment(
   73:                                 ref readyCount) == count)
   74:                         {
   75:                             allReady.TrySetResult(
   76:                                 true);
   77:                         }
   78: 
   79:                         await release.Task
   80:                             .ConfigureAwait(false);
   81: 
   82:                         return timeline.AddMoment(
   83:                             captured);
   84:                     });
   85:         }
   86: 
   87:         TestLog.Task(
   88:             "Waiting until every concurrent writer is ready.");
   89: 
   90:         await allReady.Task
   91:             .WaitAsync(
   92:                 TimeSpan.FromSeconds(
   93:                     10));
   94: 
   95:         TestLog.Task(
   96:             "Releasing all Timeline writers concurrently.");
   97: 
   98:         release.TrySetResult(
   99:             true);
  100: 
  101:         var committed =
  102:             await Task.WhenAll(
  103:                 tasks);
  104: 
  105:         for (var index = 0;
  106:              index < committed.Length;
  107:              index++)
  108:         {
  109:             Assert.True(
  110:                 committed[index]);
  111:         }
  112: 
  113:         var history =
  114:             timeline.Moments;
  115: 
  116:         Assert.Equal(
  117:             count,
  118:             timeline.Count);
  119: 
  120:         Assert.Equal(
  121:             count,
  122:             history.Count);
  123: 
  124:         var expectedIds =
  125:             new HashSet<Guid>();
  126: 
  127:         for (var index = 0;
  128:              index < moments.Length;
  129:              index++)
  130:         {
  131:             Assert.True(
  132:                 expectedIds.Add(
  133:                     moments[index].Id));
  134:         }
  135: 
  136:         var committedIds =
  137:             new HashSet<Guid>();
  138: 
  139:         for (var index = 0;
  140:              index < history.Count;
  141:              index++)
  142:         {
  143:             Assert.True(
  144:                 committedIds.Add(
  145:                     history[index].Id));
  146: 
  147:             Assert.Contains(
  148:                 history[index].Id,
  149:                 expectedIds);
  150:         }
  151: 
  152:         Assert.Equal(
  153:             count,
  154:             committedIds.Count);
  155: 
  156:         /*
  157:          * We intentionally do not assert that Timeline order
  158:          * equals creation, submission, task-start, or task-
  159:          * completion order.
  160:          *
  161:          * The Timeline contract is successful serialized commit
  162:          * order. The observable Moments snapshot is the
  163:          * authoritative historical sequence.
  164:          */
  165: 
  166:         TestLog.State(
  167:             $"Concurrent commits = {count}");
  168: 
  169:         TestLog.State(
  170:             $"Timeline Moments = {history.Count}");
  171: 
  172:         TestLog.State(
  173:             $"Unique Moment identities = {committedIds.Count}");
  174: 
  175:         TestLog.Pass(
  176:             "Every concurrent Moment was committed exactly once.");
  177: 
  178:         TestLog.Pass(
  179:             "Timeline exposed one coherent serialized history.");
  180: 
  181:         TestLog.Pass(
  182:             "No unsupported submission or completion ordering was assumed.");
  183:     }
  184: 
  185:     [Fact]
  186:     public async Task ConcurrentExecuteAsyncHistoryUsesTimelineCommitOrder()
  187:     {
  188:         TestLog.Section(
  189:             "TEMPORAL CONCURRENCY - ENGINE TIMELINE ORDER");
  190: 
  191:         TestLog.Test(
  192:             "Concurrent Wilds executions expose their terminal Moments in committed Timeline order.");
  193: 
  194:         const int count =
  195:             32;
  196: 
  197:         using var engine =
  198:             CreateEngine(
  199:                 "timeline-order-certification");
  200: 
  201:         Assert.True(
  202:             engine.Initialize());
  203: 
  204:         var requests =
  205:             new object[count];
  206: 
  207:         for (var index = 0;
  208:              index < count;
  209:              index++)
  210:         {
  211:             requests[index] =
  212:                 new object();
  213:         }
  214: 
  215:         var readyCount =
  216:             0;
  217: 
  218:         var allReady =
  219:             new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
  220:                 TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
  221: 
  222:         var release =
  223:             new TaskCompletionSource<bool>(
  224:                 TaskCreationOptions.RunContinuationsAsynchronously);
  225: 
  226:         var executions =
  227:             new Task<IMoment>[count];
  228: 
  229:         for (var index = 0;
  230:              index < count;
  231:              index++)
  232:         {
  233:             var request =
  234:                 requests[index];
  235: 
  236:             executions[index] =
  237:                 Task.Run(
  238:                     async () =>
  239:                     {
  240:                         return await engine.ExecuteAsync(
  241:                             request,
  242:                             async (
  243:                                 value,
  244:                                 cancellationToken) =>
  245:                             {
  246:                                 if (Interlocked.Increment(
  247:                                         ref readyCount) == count)
  248:                                 {
  249:                                     allReady.TrySetResult(
  250:                                         true);
  251:                                 }
  252: 
  253:                                 await release.Task
  254:                                     .WaitAsync(
  255:                                         cancellationToken)
  256:                                     .ConfigureAwait(false);
  257: 
  258:                                 return value;
  259:                             });
  260:                     });
  261:         }
  262: 
  263:         TestLog.Task(
  264:             "Waiting until every concurrent Wilds operation is active.");
  265: 
  266:         await allReady.Task
  267:             .WaitAsync(
  268:                 TimeSpan.FromSeconds(
  269:                     10));
  270: 
  271:         TestLog.Task(
  272:             "Releasing concurrent Wilds operations.");
  273: 
  274:         release.TrySetResult(
  275:             true);
  276: 
  277:         var returned =
  278:             await Task.WhenAll(
  279:                 executions);
  280: 
  281:         var history =
  282:             engine.Timeline.Moments;
  283: 
  284:         Assert.Equal(
  285:             count,
  286:             returned.Length);
  287: 
  288:         Assert.Equal(
  289:             count,
  290:             engine.Timeline.Count);
  291: 
  292:         Assert.Equal(
  293:             count,
  294:             history.Count);
  295: 
  296:         var returnedById =
  297:             new Dictionary<Guid, IMoment>();
  298: 
  299:         for (var index = 0;
  300:              index < returned.Length;
  301:              index++)
  302:         {
  303:             Assert.True(
  304:                 returnedById.TryAdd(
  305:                     returned[index].Id,
  306:                     returned[index]));
  307:         }
  308: 
  309:         var historyIds =
  310:             new HashSet<Guid>();
  311: 
  312:         for (var index = 0;
  313:              index < history.Count;
  314:              index++)
  315:         {
  316:             var committed =
  317:                 history[index];
  318: 
  319:             Assert.True(
  320:                 historyIds.Add(
  321:                     committed.Id));
  322: 
  323:             Assert.True(
  324:                 returnedById.TryGetValue(
  325:                     committed.Id,
  326:                     out var returnedMoment));
  327: 
  328:             Assert.Same(
  329:                 returnedMoment,
  330:                 committed);
  331:         }
  332: 
  333:         Assert.Equal(
  334:             count,
  335:             returnedById.Count);
  336: 
  337:         Assert.Equal(
  338:             count,
  339:             historyIds.Count);
  340: 
  341:         Assert.Single(
  342:             engine.Epoch.Timelines);
  343: 
  344:         Assert.Same(
  345:             engine.Timeline,
  346:             engine.Epoch.Timelines[0]);
  347: 
  348:         var epochHistory =
  349:             engine.Epoch.Timelines[0]
  350:                 .Moments;
  351: 
  352:         Assert.Equal(
  353:             history.Count,
  354:             epochHistory.Count);
  355: 
  356:         for (var index = 0;
  357:              index < history.Count;
  358:              index++)
  359:         {
  360:             Assert.Same(
  361:                 history[index],
  362:                 epochHistory[index]);
  363:         }
  364: 
  365:         /*
  366:          * Timeline.Moments is the authoritative observation of
  367:          * serialized commit order.
  368:          *
  369:          * This test intentionally does not equate that order with
  370:          * request submission, Pulse creation, operation completion,
  371:          * or pre-commit finalization.
  372:          */
  373: 
  374:         TestLog.State(
  375:             $"Concurrent executions = {count}");
  376: 
  377:         TestLog.State(
  378:             $"Returned Moments = {returned.Length}");
  379: 
  380:         TestLog.State(
  381:             $"Committed Timeline Moments = {history.Count}");
  382: 
  383:         TestLog.State(
  384:             $"Epoch Timeline Moments = {epochHistory.Count}");
  385: 
  386:         TestLog.Pass(
  387:             "Every returned Moment appeared exactly once in committed history.");
  388: 
  389:         TestLog.Pass(
  390:             "Timeline and Epoch exposed the same committed Moment sequence.");
  391: 
  392:         TestLog.Pass(
  393:             "Concurrent Wilds history remained coherent under the successful-commit ordering contract.");
  394: 
  395:         TestLog.Pass(
  396:             "The certification did not impose an unsupported concurrent execution order.");
  397:     }

   18:     [Fact]
   19:     public async Task
   20:         ConcurrentTerminalTransitionsProduceExactlyOneWinner()
   21:     {
   22:         TestLog.Section(
   23:             "WORKUNIT TERMINAL-STATE RACE");
   24: 
   25:         TestLog.Test(
   26:             "Concurrent complete, fail, and cancel attempts produce exactly one winner.");
   27: 
   28:         var completedWins =
   29:             0;
   30: 
   31:         var failedWins =
   32:             0;
   33: 
   34:         var cancelledWins =
   35:             0;
   36: 
   37:         for (var iteration = 0;
   38:              iteration < RaceIterations;
   39:              iteration++)
   40:         {
   41:             var pulse =
   42:                 CreateProcessingPulse(
   43:                     $"terminal-race-{iteration:D4}");
   44: 
   45:             var work =
   46:                 CreateProcessingWork(
   47:                     pulse,
   48:                     $"terminal-work-{iteration:D4}");
   49: 
   50:             var completionResult =
   51:                 new TestRuntimeObject(
   52:                     $"completion-result-{iteration:D4}");
   53: 
   54:             var failure =
   55:                 new ExpectedRaceException(
   56:                     $"Expected race failure {iteration:D4}.");
   57: 
   58:             using var start =
   59:                 new ManualResetEventSlim(
   60:                     false);
   61: 
   62:             var completeAttempt =
   63:                 Task.Run(
   64:                     () =>
   65:                     {
   66:                         start.Wait();
   67: 
   68:                         return work.TryComplete(
   69:                             completionResult);
   70:                     });
   71: 
   72:             var failAttempt =
   73:                 Task.Run(
   74:                     () =>
   75:                     {
   76:                         start.Wait();
   77: 
   78:                         return work.TryFail(
   79:                             failure);
   80:                     });
   81: 
   82:             var cancelAttempt =
   83:                 Task.Run(
   84:                     () =>
   85:                     {
   86:                         start.Wait();
   87: 
   88:                         return work.TryCancel();
   89:                     });
   90: 
   91:             start.Set();
   92: 
   93:             var transitions =
   94:                 await Task.WhenAll(
   95:                         completeAttempt,
   96:                         failAttempt,
   97:                         cancelAttempt)
   98:                     .ConfigureAwait(false);
   99: 
  100:             Assert.Equal(
  101:                 1,
  102:                 transitions.Count(
  103:                     transition =>
  104:                         transition));
  105: 
  106:             Assert.True(
  107:                 work.IsTerminal);
  108: 
  109:             switch (work.Status)
  110:             {
  111:                 case WorkUnitStatus.Completed:
  112:                     completedWins++;
  113: 
  114:                     Assert.True(
  115:                         transitions[0]);
  116: 
  117:                     Assert.Same(
  118:                         completionResult,
  119:                         work.Result);
  120: 
  121:                     Assert.Null(
  122:                         work.Exception);
  123: 
  124:                     break;
  125: 
  126:                 case WorkUnitStatus.Failed:
  127:                     failedWins++;
  128: 
  129:                     Assert.True(
  130:                         transitions[1]);
  131: 
  132:                     Assert.Null(
  133:                         work.Result);
  134: 
  135:                     Assert.Same(
  136:                         failure,
  137:                         work.Exception);
  138: 
  139:                     break;
  140: 
  141:                 case WorkUnitStatus.Cancelled:
  142:                     cancelledWins++;
  143: 
  144:                     Assert.True(
  145:                         transitions[2]);
  146: 
  147:                     Assert.Null(
  148:                         work.Result);
  149: 
  150:                     Assert.Null(
  151:                         work.Exception);
  152: 
  153:                     break;
  154: 
  155:                 default:
  156:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  157:                         "The WorkUnit did not retain a valid " +
  158:                         "terminal status after the race.");
  159:             }
  160: 
  161:             Assert.False(
  162:                 work.TryComplete(
  163:                     new TestRuntimeObject(
  164:                         "must-not-replace-result")));
  165: 
  166:             Assert.False(
  167:                 work.TryFail(
  168:                     new ExpectedRaceException(
  169:                         "must-not-replace-failure")));
  170: 
  171:             Assert.False(
  172:                 work.TryCancel());
  173:         }
  174: 
  175:         TestLog.State(
  176:             $"Iterations = {RaceIterations}");
  177: 
  178:         TestLog.State(
  179:             $"Completed winners = {completedWins}");
  180: 
  181:         TestLog.State(
  182:             $"Failed winners = {failedWins}");
  183: 
  184:         TestLog.State(
  185:             $"Cancelled winners = {cancelledWins}");
  186: 
  187:         TestLog.State(
  188:             "Total winners = " +
  189:             (completedWins +
  190:              failedWins +
  191:              cancelledWins));
  192: 
  193:         Assert.Equal(
  194:             RaceIterations,
  195:             completedWins +
  196:             failedWins +
  197:             cancelledWins);
  198: 
  199:         TestLog.Pass(
  200:             "Every terminal-state race produced exactly one authoritative winner.");
  201: 
  202:         TestLog.Pass(
  203:             "Winning WorkUnit state remained internally consistent.");
  204: 
  205:         TestLog.Pass(
  206:             "All later terminal transitions were rejected.");

  404:     public void
  405:         MixedTerminalOutcomePrecedenceIsIndependentOfRegistrationOrder(

  407:     {
  408:         TestLog.Section(
  409:             "PULSE MIXED-OUTCOME PRECEDENCE");
  410: 
  411:         TestLog.Test(
  412:             "Failure precedence is independent of WorkUnit registration order.");
  413: 
  414:         var pulse =
  415:             CreateProcessingPulse(
  416:                 reverseRegistrationOrder
  417:                     ? "mixed-order-reversed"
  418:                     : "mixed-order-forward");
  419: 
  420:         var completed =
  421:             CreateProcessingWork(
  422:                 pulse,
  423:                 "completed-work");
  424: 
  425:         var failed =
  426:             CreateProcessingWork(
  427:                 pulse,
  428:                 "failed-work");
  429: 
  430:         var cancelled =
  431:             CreateProcessingWork(

  433:                 "cancelled-work");
  434:

  436:             new TestRuntimeObject(
  437:                 "completed-result");
  438: 
  439:         var finalResult =
  440:             new TestRuntimeObject(
  441:                 "must-not-be-used-as-final-result");
  442: 
  443:         var failure =
  444:             new ExpectedRaceException(
  445:                 "Authoritative mixed-outcome failure.");
  446: 
  447:         Assert.True(
  448:             completed.TryComplete(
  449:                 completedResult));
  450:

  452:             failed.TryFail(

  456:             cancelled.TryCancel());
  457: 
  458:         var coordinator =
  459:             new PulseCoordinator(
  460:                 pulse);
  461: 
  462:         if (reverseRegistrationOrder)
  463:         {
  464:             Assert.True(
  465:                 coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  466:                     cancelled));
  467: 
  468:             Assert.True(
  469:                 coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  470:                     failed));
  471: 
  472:             Assert.True(
  473:                 coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  474:                     completed));
  475:         }
  476:         else
  477:         {
  478:             Assert.True(
  479:                 coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  480:                     completed));
  481: 
  482:             Assert.True(
  483:                 coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  484:                     failed));
  485: 
  486:             Assert.True(
  487:                 coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  488:                     cancelled));
  489:         }
  490: 
  491:         Assert.Equal(
  492:             3,
  493:             coordinator.WorkUnitCount);
  494: 
  495:         Assert.False(
  496:             coordinator.CanResolve);
  497: 
  498:         Assert.True(
  499:             coordinator.CanFinalize);
  500: 
  501:         Assert.True(
  502:             coordinator.TryFinalize(
  503:                 finalResult,
  504:                 out var moment));
  505: 
  506:         Assert.NotNull(
  507:             moment);
  508: 
  509:         Assert.Equal(
  510:             MomentOutcome.Failed,
  511:             moment!.Outcome);
  512: 
  513:         Assert.Equal(
  514:             PulseStatus.Failed,
  515:             pulse.Status);
  516: 
  517:         Assert.Null(
  518:             moment.Result);
  519: 
  520:         Assert.Same(
  521:             failure,
  522:             moment.Exception);
  523: 
  524:         Assert.Equal(
  525:             3,
  526:             moment.WorkUnitIds.Count);
  527: 
  528:         Assert.Contains(
  529:             completed.Id,
  530:             moment.WorkUnitIds);
  531: 
  532:         Assert.Contains(
  533:             failed.Id,
  534:             moment.WorkUnitIds);
  535: 
  536:         Assert.Contains(
  537:             cancelled.Id,
  538:             moment.WorkUnitIds);
  539: 
  540:         TestLog.State(
  541:             reverseRegistrationOrder
  542:                 ? "Registration order = Cancelled, Failed, Completed"
  543:                 : "Registration order = Completed, Failed, Cancelled");
  544: 
  545:         TestLog.State(
  546:             $"Moment outcome = {moment.Outcome}");
  547: 
  548:         TestLog.State(
  549:             $"Pulse status = {pulse.Status}");
  550: 
  551:         TestLog.Pass(

  555:     [Fact]
  556: public async Task
  557:     RepeatedConcurrentTerminalTransitionsRemainRejected()
  558: {
  559:     const int contenderCount =
  560:         64;
  561: 
  562:     TestLog.Section(
  563:         "WORKUNIT TERMINAL REENTRY");
  564: 
  565:     TestLog.Test(
  566:         "Repeated concurrent terminal attempts cannot replace an established outcome.");
  567: 
  568:     var pulse =
  569:         CreateProcessingPulse(
  570:             "terminal-reentry");
  571: 
  572:     var work =
  573:         CreateProcessingWork(
  574:             pulse,
  575:             "terminal-reentry-work");
  576: 
  577:     var authoritativeResult =
  578:         new TestRuntimeObject(
  579:             "authoritative-result");
  580: 
  581:     Assert.True(
  582:         work.TryComplete(
  583:             authoritativeResult));
  584: 
  585:     Assert.Equal(
  586:         WorkUnitStatus.Completed,
  587:         work.Status);
  588: 
  589:     Assert.Same(
  590:         authoritativeResult,
  591:         work.Result);
  592: 
  593:     using var start =
  594:         new ManualResetEventSlim(
  595:             false);
  596: 
  597:     var attempts =
  598:         new Task<bool>[contenderCount];
  599: 
  600:     for (var index = 0;
  601:          index < contenderCount;
  602:          index++)
  603:     {
  604:         var contenderIndex =
  605:             index;
  606: 
  607:         attempts[index] =
  608:             Task.Run(
  609:                 () =>
  610:                 {
  611:                     start.Wait();
  612: 
  613:                     switch (contenderIndex % 3)
  614:                     {
  615:                         case 0:
  616:                             return work.TryComplete(
  617:                                 new TestRuntimeObject(
  618:                                     $"replacement-{contenderIndex:D3}"));
  619: 
  620:                         case 1:
  621:                             return work.TryFail(
  622:                                 new ExpectedRaceException(
  623:                                     $"replacement-{contenderIndex:D3}"));
  624: 
  625:                         default:
  626:                             return work.TryCancel();
  627:                     }
  628:                 });
  629:     }
  630: 
  631:     start.Set();
  632: 
  633:     bool[] results =
  634:         await Task.WhenAll(
  635:                 attempts)
  636:             .ConfigureAwait(false);
  637: 
  638:     Assert.Equal(
  639:         contenderCount,
  640:         results.Length);
  641: 
  642:     for (var index = 0;
  643:          index < results.Length;
  644:          index++)
  645:     {
  646:         Assert.False(
  647:             results[index]);
  648:     }
  649: 
  650:     Assert.Equal(
  651:         WorkUnitStatus.Completed,
  652:         work.Status);
  653: 
  654:     Assert.True(
  655:         work.IsTerminal);
  656: 
  657:     Assert.Same(
  658:         authoritativeResult,
  659:         work.Result);
  660: 
  661:     Assert.Null(
  662:         work.Exception);
  663: 
  664:     TestLog.State(
  665:         $"Rejected terminal reentry attempts = {results.Length}");
  666: 
  667:     TestLog.Pass(
  668:         "Concurrent terminal reentry could not replace the established result.");
  669: }

  671: [Theory]
  672: [InlineData(0, 1, 2)]
  673: [InlineData(0, 2, 1)]
  674: [InlineData(1, 0, 2)]
  675: [InlineData(1, 2, 0)]
  676: [InlineData(2, 0, 1)]
  677: [InlineData(2, 1, 0)]
  678: public void
  679:     MixedWorkUnitOutcomePrecedenceIsIndependentOfCompletionOrder(
  680:         int first,
  681:         int second,
  682:         int third)
  683: {
  684:     TestLog.Section(
  685:         "PULSE MIXED-OUTCOME COMPLETION ORDER");
  686: 
  687:     TestLog.Test(
  688:         "Failure precedence is independent of WorkUnit completion order.");
  689: 
  690:     var pulse =
  691:         CreateProcessingPulse(
  692:             $"completion-order-{first}-{second}-{third}");
  693: 
  694:     var completed =
  695:         CreateProcessingWork(
  696:             pulse,
  697:             "completed-work");
  698: 
  699:     var failed =
  700:         CreateProcessingWork(
  701:             pulse,
  702:             "failed-work");
  703: 
  704:     var cancelled =
  705:         CreateProcessingWork(
  706:             pulse,
  707:             "cancelled-work");
  708: 
  709:     var completedResult =
  710:         new TestRuntimeObject(
  711:             "completed-result");
  712: 
  713:     var finalResult =
  714:         new TestRuntimeObject(
  715:             "must-not-be-used-as-final-result");
  716: 
  717:     var failure =
  718:         new ExpectedRaceException(
  719:             "Authoritative completion-order failure.");
  720: 
  721:     var coordinator =
  722:         new PulseCoordinator(
  723:             pulse);
  724: 
  725:     /*
  726:      * Registration order remains fixed.
  727:      *
  728:      * Only terminal completion order changes.
  729:      *
  730:      * This isolates the contract being certified:
  731:      *
  732:      *     completion order must not affect
  733:      *     mixed-outcome precedence.
  734:      */
  735:     Assert.True(
  736:         coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  737:             completed));
  738: 
  739:     Assert.True(
  740:         coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  741:             failed));
  742: 
  743:     Assert.True(
  744:         coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  745:             cancelled));
  746: 
  747:     Assert.Equal(
  748:         3,
  749:         coordinator.WorkUnitCount);
  750: 
  751:     var order =
  752:         new[]
  753:         {
  754:             first,
  755:             second,
  756:             third
  757:         };
  758: 
  759:     for (var index = 0;
  760:          index < order.Length;
  761:          index++)
  762:     {
  763:         switch (order[index])
  764:         {
  765:             case 0:
  766:                 Assert.True(
  767:                     completed.TryComplete(
  768:                         completedResult));
  769: 
  770:                 TestLog.State(
  771:                     $"Terminal position {index + 1}: Completed");
  772: 
  773:                 break;
  774: 
  775:             case 1:
  776:                 Assert.True(
  777:                     failed.TryFail(
  778:                         failure));
  779: 
  780:                 TestLog.State(
  781:                     $"Terminal position {index + 1}: Failed");
  782: 
  783:                 break;
  784: 
  785:             case 2:
  786:                 Assert.True(
  787:                     cancelled.TryCancel());
  788: 
  789:                 TestLog.State(
  790:                     $"Terminal position {index + 1}: Cancelled");
  791: 
  792:                 break;
  793: 
  794:             default:
  795:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  796:                     "Unknown completion-order index.");
  797:         }
  798: 
  799:         /*
  800:          * Until every required WorkUnit is terminal,
  801:          * the Pulse must not finalize.
  802:          */
  803:         if (index < order.Length - 1)
  804:         {
  805:             Assert.False(
  806:                 coordinator.CanFinalize);
  807: 
  808:             Assert.False(
  809:                 coordinator.TryFinalize(
  810:                     finalResult,
  811:                     out var prematureMoment));
  812: 
  813:             Assert.Null(
  814:                 prematureMoment);
  815: 
  816:             Assert.Equal(
  817:                 PulseStatus.Processing,
  818:                 pulse.Status);
  819:         }
  820:     }
  821: 
  822:     Assert.Equal(
  823:         WorkUnitStatus.Completed,
  824:         completed.Status);
  825: 
  826:     Assert.Equal(
  827:         WorkUnitStatus.Failed,
  828:         failed.Status);
  829: 
  830:     Assert.Equal(
  831:         WorkUnitStatus.Cancelled,
  832:         cancelled.Status);
  833: 
  834:     Assert.True(
  835:         coordinator.CanFinalize);
  836: 
  837:     Assert.False(
  838:         coordinator.CanResolve);
  839: 
  840:     Assert.True(
  841:         coordinator.TryFinalize(
  842:             finalResult,
  843:             out var moment));
  844: 
  845:     Assert.NotNull(
  846:         moment);
  847: 
  848:     /*
  849:      * Failure must remain authoritative regardless
  850:      * of which WorkUnit reached its terminal state
  851:      * first, second, or third.
  852:      */
  853:     Assert.Equal(
  854:         MomentOutcome.Failed,
  855:         moment!.Outcome);
  856: 
  857:     Assert.Equal(
  858:         PulseStatus.Failed,
  859:         pulse.Status);
  860: 
  861:     Assert.True(
  862:         pulse.IsTerminal);
  863: 
  864:     Assert.Null(
  865:         moment.Result);
  866: 
  867:     Assert.Same(
  868:         failure,
  869:         moment.Exception);
  870: 
  871:     Assert.Equal(
  872:         pulse.Id,
  873:         moment.PulseId);
  874: 
  875:     Assert.Equal(
  876:         3,
  877:         moment.WorkUnitIds.Count);
  878: 
  879:     Assert.Contains(
  880:         completed.Id,
  881:         moment.WorkUnitIds);
  882: 
  883:     Assert.Contains(
  884:         failed.Id,
  885:         moment.WorkUnitIds);
  886: 
  887:     Assert.Contains(
  888:         cancelled.Id,
  889:         moment.WorkUnitIds);
  890: 
  891:     /*
  892:      * Verify subordinate successful work has not
  893:      * contaminated the authoritative failed Moment.
  894:      */
  895:     Assert.Same(
  896:         completedResult,
  897:         completed.Result);
  898: 
  899:     Assert.Null(
  900:         completed.Exception);
  901: 
  902:     Assert.Null(
  903:         failed.Result);
  904: 
  905:     Assert.Same(
  906:         failure,
  907:         failed.Exception);
  908: 
  909:     Assert.Null(
  910:         cancelled.Result);
  911: 
  912:     Assert.Null(
  913:         cancelled.Exception);
  914: 
  915:     /*
  916:      * Finalization must remain single-shot.
  917:      */
  918:     Assert.False(
  919:         coordinator.TryFinalize(
  920:             new object(),
  921:             out var duplicateMoment));
  922: 
  923:     Assert.Null(
  924:         duplicateMoment);
  925: 
  926:     TestLog.State(
  927:         $"Completion order = " +
  928:         $"{DescribeOutcome(first)} -> " +
  929:         $"{DescribeOutcome(second)} -> " +
  930:         $"{DescribeOutcome(third)}");
  931: 
  932:     TestLog.State(
  933:         $"Moment outcome = {moment.Outcome}");
  934: 
  935:     TestLog.State(
  936:         $"Pulse status = {pulse.Status}");
  937: 
  938:     TestLog.Pass(
  939:         "Failure remained authoritative regardless of completion order.");
  940: }
  941: 
  942:     private static Pulse CreateProcessingPulse(
  943:         object? request)
  944:     {
  945:         var pulse =
  946:             new Pulse(
  947:                 request);
  948: 
  949:         Assert.True(
  950:             pulse.TryBeginDecomposition());
  951: 
  952:         Assert.True(
  953:             pulse.TryMarkPending());
  954: 
  955:         Assert.True(
  956:             pulse.TryMarkReady());
  957: 
  958:         Assert.True(
  959:             pulse.TryBeginProcessing());
  960: 
  961:         return pulse;
  962:     }
  963: 
  964:     private static WorkUnit CreateProcessingWork(
  965:         Pulse pulse,
  966:         object? payload)
  967:     {
  968:         var work =
  969:             new WorkUnit(
  970:                 pulse.Id,
  971:                 payload);
  972: 
  973:         Assert.True(
  974:             work.TryMarkPending());
  975: 
  976:         Assert.True(
  977:             work.TryBeginProcessing());
  978: 
  979:         return work;
  980:     }

  994:     private static string DescribeOutcome(
  995:         int outcome)
  996:     {
  997:         return outcome switch
  998:         {
  999:             0 => "Completed",
 1000:             1 => "Failed",
 1001:             2 => "Cancelled",
 1002: 
 1003:             _ =>
 1004:                 throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
 1005:                     nameof(outcome))
 1006:         };
 1007:     }

  491:         {
  492:             TestLog.Section(

  494: 
  495:             var runtimeObject =

  504:                 "Complete Pulse -> WorkUnit -> Moment -> Timeline -> Epoch route");
  505: 
  506:             TestLog.State(
  507:                 $"Pulse created | Id={pulse.Id} | Status={pulse.Status}");
  508: 
  509:             Assert.Same(
  510:                 runtimeObject,
  511:                 pulse.Request);
  512: 
  513:             Assert.True(
  514:                 pulse.TryBeginDecomposition());
  515: 
  516:             TestLog.State(
  517:                 $"Pulse decomposing | Status={pulse.Status}");
  518: 
  519:             var work =
  520:                 new WorkUnit(
  521:                     pulse.Id,
  522:                     pulse.Request);
  523: 
  524:             TestLog.Task(
  525:                 $"WorkUnit created | Id={work.Id} | PulseId={work.PulseId}");
  526: 
  527:             Assert.Same(
  528:                 runtimeObject,
  529:                 work.Payload);
  530: 
  531:             TestLog.State(
  532:                 "Request reference preserved in WorkUnit payload");
  533: 
  534:             Assert.True(
  535:                 work.TryMarkPending());
  536: 
  537:             Assert.True(
  538:                 pulse.TryMarkPending());
  539: 
  540:             TestLog.State(
  541:                 $"Pulse pending | Status={pulse.Status}");
  542: 
  543:             Assert.True(
  544:                 pulse.TryMarkReady());
  545: 
  546:             TestLog.State(
  547:                 $"Pulse ready | Status={pulse.Status}");
  548: 
  549:             Assert.True(
  550:                 pulse.TryBeginProcessing());
  551: 
  552:             Assert.True(
  553:                 work.TryBeginProcessing());
  554: 
  555:             TestLog.Task(
  556:                 $"WorkUnit processing | Status={work.Status}");
  557: 
  558:             Assert.True(
  559:                 work.TryComplete(
  560:                     runtimeObject));
  561: 
  562:             Assert.Same(
  563:                 runtimeObject,
  564:                 work.Result);
  565: 
  566:             TestLog.Task(
  567:                 $"WorkUnit completed | Status={work.Status}");
  568: 
  569:             TestLog.State(
  570:                 "Runtime object reference preserved through WorkUnit result");
  571: 
  572:             Assert.True(
  573:                 pulse.TryComplete());
  574: 
  575:             TestLog.State(
  576:                 $"Pulse completed | Status={pulse.Status}");
  577: 
  578:             var moment =
  579:                 new Moment(
  580:                     pulse.Id,
  581:                     work.Result,
  582:                     new[]
  583:                     {
  584:                         work.Id
  585:                     });
  586: 
  587:             Assert.Equal(
  588:                 pulse.Id,
  589:                 moment.PulseId);
  590: 
  591:             Assert.Same(
  592:                 runtimeObject,
  593:                 moment.Result);
  594: 
  595:             Assert.Single(
  596:                 moment.WorkUnitIds);
  597: 
  598:             Assert.Equal(
  599:                 work.Id,
  600:                 moment.WorkUnitIds[0]);
  601: 
  602:             TestLog.State(
  603:                 $"Moment recorded | Id={moment.Id} | PulseId={moment.PulseId}");
  604: 
  605:             var timeline =
  606:                 new Timeline();
  607: 
  608:             Assert.True(
  609:                 timeline.AddMoment(
  610:                     moment));
  611: 
  612:             TestLog.State(
  613:                 $"Timeline recorded Moment | Moments={timeline.Count}");
  614: 
  615:             var epoch =
  616:                 new Epoch();
  617: 
  618:             Assert.True(
  619:                 epoch.AddTimeline(
  620:                     timeline));
  621: 
  622:             TestLog.State(
  623:                 $"Epoch recorded Timeline | Timelines={epoch.Count}");
  624: 
  625:             Assert.Same(
  626:                 runtimeObject,
  627:                 epoch.Timelines[0]
  628:                     .Moments[0]
  629:                     .Result);
  630: 
  631:             TestLog.Pass(
  632:                 "Exact runtime object survived " +
  633:                 "Pulse -> WorkUnit -> Moment -> Timeline -> Epoch");
  634:         }

############################################################
FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Abstractions\Base\NeighborDistance.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: 
    3: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Topology
    4: {
    5:     /// <summary>
    6:     /// Defines the canonical Wilds rules for relational distance.
    7:     ///
    8:     /// Distance is abstract and does not imply a physical
    9:     /// unit of measurement.
   10:     /// </summary>
   11:     public static class NeighborDistance
   12:     {
   13:         public static bool IsValid(
   14:             double distance)
   15:         {
   16:             return
   17:                 !double.IsNaN(distance) &&
   18:                 !double.IsInfinity(distance) &&
   19:                 distance >= 0d;
   20:         }
   21: 
   22:         public static double Validate(
   23:             double distance,
   24:             string parameterName)
   25:         {
   26:             if (!IsValid(distance))
   27:             {
   28:                 throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
   29:                     parameterName,
   30:                     distance,
   31:                     "Neighbor distance must be finite and non-negative.");
   32:             }
   33: 
   34:             return distance;
   35:         }
   36: 
   37:         public static bool IsAdjacent(
   38:             double distance)
   39:         {
   40:             return
   41:                 Validate(
   42:                     distance,
   43:                     nameof(distance)) == 1d;
   44:         }
   45:     }
   46: }

############################################################
FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Abstractions\Pooling\ObjectLease.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Threading;
    3: 
    4: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions
    5: {
    6:     /// <summary>
    7:     /// Represents temporary ownership of an object rented from a pool.
    8:     /// Disposing the lease returns the object to its originating pool.
    9:     /// </summary>
   10:     public sealed class ObjectLease<T> : IDisposable
   11:         where T : class
   12:     {
   13:         private IObjectPool<T>? _pool;
   14:         private T? _instance;
   15: 
   16:         internal ObjectLease(
   17:             IObjectPool<T> pool,
   18:             T instance)
   19:         {
   20:             _pool = pool ??
   21:                     throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(pool));
   22: 
   23:             _instance = instance ??
   24:                         throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(instance));
   25:         }
   26: 
   27:         public T Instance
   28:         {
   29:             get
   30:             {
   31:                 return _instance ??
   32:                        throw new ObjectDisposedException(
   33:                            nameof(ObjectLease<T>));
   34:             }
   35:         }
   36: 
   37:         public void Dispose()
   38:         {
   39:             var instance =
   40:                 Interlocked.Exchange(
   41:                     ref _instance,
   42:                     null);
   43: 
   44:             var pool =
   45:                 Interlocked.Exchange(
   46:                     ref _pool,
   47:                     null);
   48: 
   49:             if (instance == null || pool == null)
   50:                 return;
   51: 
   52:             pool.Return(instance);
   53:         }
   54:     }
   55: }

############################################################
FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Abstractions\Pooling\ObjectPool.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Concurrent;
    3: using System.Threading;
    4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
    5: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    6: 
    7: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Pooling
    8: {
    9:     /// <summary>
   10:     /// Thread-safe object pool with bounded retention
   11:     /// and bounded concurrent leasing.
   12:     /// </summary>
   13:     public class ObjectPool<T> :
   14:         IObjectPool<T>,
   15:         IDisposable
   16:         where T : class
   17:     {
   18:         private readonly ConcurrentQueue<T> _available =
   19:             new ConcurrentQueue<T>();
   20: 
   21:         private readonly Func<T> _factory;
   22: 
   23:         private readonly SemaphoreSlim _concurrencyGate;
   24: 
   25:         private int _availableCount;
   26:         private int _createdCount;
   27:         private int _activeCount;
   28:         private int _disposed;
   29: 
   30:         public ObjectPool(
   31:             Func<T> factory,
   32:             int maximumRetained,
   33:             int maximumConcurrent)
   34:         {
   35:             _factory = factory ??
   36:                        throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(factory));
   37: 
   38:             if (maximumRetained < 0)
   39:             {
   40:                 throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
   41:                     nameof(maximumRetained));
   42:             }
   43: 
   44:             if (maximumConcurrent <= 0)
   45:             {
   46:                 throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
   47:                     nameof(maximumConcurrent));
   48:             }
   49: 
   50:             MaximumRetained = maximumRetained;
   51:             MaximumConcurrent = maximumConcurrent;
   52: 
   53:             _concurrencyGate = new SemaphoreSlim(
   54:                 maximumConcurrent,
   55:                 maximumConcurrent);
   56:         }
   57: 
   58:         public int AvailableCount =>
   59:             Volatile.Read(ref _availableCount);
   60: 
   61:         public int CreatedCount =>
   62:             Volatile.Read(ref _createdCount);
   63: 
   64:         public int ActiveCount =>
   65:             Volatile.Read(ref _activeCount);
   66: 
   67:         public int MaximumRetained { get; }
   68: 
   69:         public int MaximumConcurrent { get; }
   70: 
   71:         public ObjectLease<T> Rent()
   72:         {
   73:             ThrowIfDisposed();
   74: 
   75:             _concurrencyGate.Wait();
   76: 
   77:             try
   78:             {
   79:                 // The pool may have been disposed while waiting.
   80:                 ThrowIfDisposed();
   81: 
   82:                 return CreateLease();
   83:             }
   84:             catch
   85:             {
   86:                 _concurrencyGate.Release();
   87: 
   88:                 throw;
   89:             }
   90:         }
   91: 
   92:         public async ValueTask<ObjectLease<T>> RentAsync(
   93:             CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
   94:         {
   95:             ThrowIfDisposed();
   96: 
   97:             await _concurrencyGate
   98:                 .WaitAsync(cancellationToken)
   99:                 .ConfigureAwait(false);
  100: 
  101:             try
  102:             {
  103:                 // The pool may have been disposed while waiting.
  104:                 ThrowIfDisposed();
  105: 
  106:                 return CreateLease();
  107:             }
  108:             catch
  109:             {
  110:                 _concurrencyGate.Release();
  111: 
  112:                 throw;
  113:             }
  114:         }
  115: 
  116:         public bool Return(T instance)
  117:         {
  118:             if (instance == null)
  119:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(instance));
  120: 
  121:             var remainingActive =
  122:                 Interlocked.Decrement(ref _activeCount);
  123: 
  124:             if (remainingActive < 0)
  125:             {
  126:                 Interlocked.Increment(ref _activeCount);
  127: 
  128:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  129:                     "An object was returned without an active lease.");
  130:             }
  131: 
  132:             try
  133:             {
  134:                 if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) != 0)
  135:                 {
  136:                     DisposeInstance(instance);
  137: 
  138:                     return false;
  139:                 }
  140: 
  141:                 try
  142:                 {
  143:                     if (instance is
  144:                         IResettablePoolObject
  145:                         resettable)
  146:                     {
  147:                         if (!resettable.TryReset())
  148:                         {
  149:                             DisposeInstance(instance);
  150: 
  151:                             return false;
  152:                         }
  153:                     }
  154:                 }
  155:                 catch
  156:                 {
  157:                     DisposeInstance(instance);
  158: 
  159:                     throw;
  160:                 }
  161: 
  162:                 var retained =
  163:                     TryRetain(instance);
  164: 
  165:                 if (!retained)
  166:                     DisposeInstance(instance);
  167: 
  168:                 return retained;
  169:             }
  170:             finally
  171:             {
  172:                 _concurrencyGate.Release();
  173:             }
  174:         }
  175: 
  176:         public void Dispose()
  177:         {
  178:             if (Interlocked.Exchange(
  179:                     ref _disposed,
  180:                     1) != 0)
  181:             {
  182:                 return;
  183:             }
  184: 
  185:             while (_available.TryDequeue(out var instance))
  186:             {
  187:                 Interlocked.Decrement(
  188:                     ref _availableCount);
  189: 
  190:                 DisposeInstance(instance);
  191:             }
  192: 
  193:             // Intentionally do not dispose the semaphore here.
  194:             // Active leases and waiting renters may still need
  195:             // to interact with it while observing pool disposal.
  196:         }
  197: 
  198:         private ObjectLease<T>
  199:             CreateLease()
  200:         {
  201:             T instance;
  202: 
  203:             if (_available.TryDequeue(out var pooled))
  204:             {
  205:                 Interlocked.Decrement(
  206:                     ref _availableCount);
  207: 
  208:                 instance = pooled;
  209:             }
  210:             else
  211:             {
  212:                 instance = _factory();
  213: 
  214:                 if (instance == null)
  215:                 {
  216:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  217:                         "The object pool factory returned null.");
  218:                 }
  219: 
  220:                 Interlocked.Increment(
  221:                     ref _createdCount);
  222:             }
  223: 
  224:             Interlocked.Increment(
  225:                 ref _activeCount);
  226: 
  227:             return new ObjectLease<T>(
  228:                 this,
  229:                 instance);
  230:         }
  231: 
  232:         private bool TryRetain(T instance)
  233:         {
  234:             while (true)
  235:             {
  236:                 if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) != 0)
  237:                     return false;
  238: 
  239:                 var available =
  240:                     Volatile.Read(ref _availableCount);
  241: 
  242:                 if (available >= MaximumRetained)
  243:                     return false;
  244: 
  245:                 if (Interlocked.CompareExchange(
  246:                         ref _availableCount,
  247:                         available + 1,
  248:                         available) != available)
  249:                 {
  250:                     continue;
  251:                 }
  252: 
  253:                 if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) != 0)
  254:                 {
  255:                     Interlocked.Decrement(
  256:                         ref _availableCount);
  257: 
  258:                     return false;
  259:                 }
  260: 
  261:                 _available.Enqueue(instance);
  262: 
  263:                 return true;
  264:             }
  265:         }
  266: 
  267:         private static void DisposeInstance(
  268:             T instance)
  269:         {
  270:             if (instance is IDisposable disposable)
  271:                 disposable.Dispose();
  272:         }
  273: 
  274:         private void ThrowIfDisposed()
  275:         {
  276:             if (Volatile.Read(ref _disposed) != 0)
  277:             {
  278:                 throw new ObjectDisposedException(
  279:                     nameof(ObjectPool<T>));
  280:             }
  281:         }
  282:     }
  283: }

############################################################
FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Abstractions\Units\IPulse.cs
############################################################
    1: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions
    2: {
    3:     /// <summary>
    4:     /// Represents one complete request submitted to Wilds.
    5:     ///
    6:     /// A pulse remains the request boundary regardless of
    7:     /// how many internal work units, instructions, tasks,
    8:     /// host frames, or asynchronous operations are required
    9:     /// to resolve it.

FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Emission\EmissionCompositionBase.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    3: 
    4: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Emission
    5: {
    6:     /// <summary>
    7:     /// Base implementation for emission composition policies.
    8:     ///
    9:     /// Supplies finite-value validation around the composition
   10:     /// operation while leaving the mathematical relationship
   11:     /// between emission and topology to derived implementations.
   12:     /// </summary>
   13:     public abstract class EmissionCompositionBase :
   14:         IEmissionComposition
   15:     {
   16:         public double Compose(
   17:             double emission,
   18:             double topology)
   19:         {
   20:             ValidateFinite(
   21:                 emission,
   22:                 nameof(emission));
   23: 
   24:             ValidateFinite(
   25:                 topology,
   26:                 nameof(topology));
   27: 
   28:             var resolved =
   29:                 ComposeCore(
   30:                     emission,
   31:                     topology);
   32: 
   33:             if (double.IsNaN(resolved) ||
   34:                 double.IsInfinity(resolved))
   35:             {
   36:                 throw new ArithmeticException(
   37:                     "Emission composition must produce a finite scalar.");
   38:             }
   39: 
   40:             return resolved;
   41:         }
   42: 
   43:         protected abstract double ComposeCore(
   44:             double emission,
   45:             double topology);
   46: 
   47:         private static void ValidateFinite(
   48:             double value,
   49:             string parameterName)
   50:         {
   51:             if (double.IsNaN(value) ||
   52:                 double.IsInfinity(value))
   53:             {
   54:                 throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
   55:                     parameterName,
   56:                     value,
   57:                     "Emission composition values must be finite.");
   58:             }
   59:         }
   60:     }
   61: }

FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Emission\EmissionEligibility.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions.Neighbors.Propagation;
    4: 
    5: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Emission
    6: {
    7:     /// <summary>
    8:     /// Evaluates one propagated emission using the existing
    9:     /// Neighbor propagation-eligibility contract.
   10:     ///
   11:     /// Eligibility consumes the received propagated Value.
   12:     /// </summary>
   13:     public sealed class EmissionEligibility
   14:     {
   15:         private readonly INeighborPropagationEligibility
   16:             _eligibility;
   17: 
   18:         public EmissionEligibility(
   19:             INeighborPropagationEligibility eligibility)
   20:         {
   21:             _eligibility =
   22:                 eligibility ??
   23:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   24:                     nameof(eligibility));
   25:         }
   26: 
   27:         public IEmissionEligibilityResult Evaluate(
   28:             IPropagatedEmission emission)
   29:         {
   30:             if (emission == null)
   31:             {
   32:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   33:                     nameof(emission));
   34:             }
   35: 
   36:             var evaluatedValue =
   37:                 emission.Value;
   38: 
   39:             var eligible =
   40:                 _eligibility.IsEligible(
   41:                     evaluatedValue);
   42: 
   43:             return new EmissionEligibilityResult(
   44:                 emission,
   45:                 evaluatedValue,
   46:                 eligible);
   47:         }
   48:     }
   49: }
