FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Emission\EmissionEligibilityResult.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    3: 
    4: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Emission
    5: {
    6:     /// <summary>
    7:     /// Immutable eligibility decision for one propagated
    8:     /// emission.
    9:     ///
   10:     /// EvaluatedValue snapshots the received propagated
   11:     /// magnitude supplied to the eligibility policy.
   12:     /// </summary>
   13:     public sealed class EmissionEligibilityResult :
   14:         IEmissionEligibilityResult
   15:     {
   16:         public EmissionEligibilityResult(
   17:             IPropagatedEmission emission,
   18:             double evaluatedValue,
   19:             bool isEligible)
   20:         {
   21:             Emission =
   22:                 emission ??
   23:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   24:                     nameof(emission));
   25: 
   26:             if (double.IsNaN(evaluatedValue) ||
   27:                 double.IsInfinity(evaluatedValue) ||
   28:                 evaluatedValue < 0.0)
   29:             {
   30:                 throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
   31:                     nameof(evaluatedValue),
   32:                     evaluatedValue,
   33:                     "Eligibility evaluation value must be " +
   34:                     "finite and non-negative.");
   35:             }
   36: 
   37:             if (evaluatedValue !=
   38:                 emission.Value)
   39:             {
   40:                 throw new ArgumentException(
   41:                     "Eligibility must evaluate the exact " +
   42:                     "received propagated value.",
   43:                     nameof(evaluatedValue));
   44:             }
   45: 
   46:             EvaluatedValue =
   47:                 evaluatedValue;
   48: 
   49:             IsEligible =
   50:                 isEligible;
   51:         }
   52: 
   53:         public IPropagatedEmission Emission { get; }
   54: 
   55:         public double EvaluatedValue { get; }
   56: 
   57:         public bool IsEligible { get; }
   58:     }
   59: }

############################################################
FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Emission\EmissionEligibilityVector.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    4: 
    5: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Emission
    6: {
    7:     /// <summary>
    8:     /// Immutable eligibility result for one exact propagated
    9:     /// emission vector.
   10:     ///
   11:     /// Every propagated channel retains a corresponding
   12:     /// eligibility result. Ineligible channels are not
   13:     /// removed.
   14:     /// </summary>
   15:     public sealed class EmissionEligibilityVector :
   16:         IEmissionEligibilityVector
   17:     {
   18:         private readonly IReadOnlyList<IEmissionEligibilityResult>
   19:             _emissions;
   20: 
   21:         public EmissionEligibilityVector(
   22:             IPropagatedEmissionVector source,
   23:             IReadOnlyList<IEmissionEligibilityResult> emissions)
   24:         {
   25:             Source =
   26:                 source ??
   27:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   28:                     nameof(source));
   29: 
   30:             if (emissions == null)
   31:             {
   32:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   33:                     nameof(emissions));
   34:             }
   35: 
   36:             if (emissions.Count !=
   37:                 source.Dimension)
   38:             {
   39:                 throw new ArgumentException(
   40:                     "Eligibility-vector dimension must match " +
   41:                     "the propagated-vector dimension.",
   42:                     nameof(emissions));
   43:             }
   44: 
   45:             var snapshot =
   46:                 new IEmissionEligibilityResult[
   47:                     emissions.Count];
   48: 
   49:             var eligibleCount =
   50:                 0;
   51: 
   52:             for (var index = 0;
   53:                  index < emissions.Count;
   54:                  index++)
   55:             {
   56:                 var result =
   57:                     emissions[index] ??
   58:                     throw new ArgumentException(
   59:                         "An eligibility vector cannot contain " +
   60:                         "a null component.",
   61:                         nameof(emissions));
   62: 
   63:                 if (!ReferenceEquals(
   64:                         source.Emissions[index],
   65:                         result.Emission))
   66:                 {
   67:                     throw new ArgumentException(
   68:                         "Eligibility must preserve exact " +
   69:                         "propagated-emission references and " +
   70:                         "component ordering.",
   71:                         nameof(emissions));
   72:                 }
   73: 
   74:                 if (result.EvaluatedValue !=
   75:                     source.Emissions[index].Value)
   76:                 {
   77:                     throw new ArgumentException(
   78:                         "Eligibility must preserve the exact " +
   79:                         "received value evaluated for each " +
   80:                         "component.",
   81:                         nameof(emissions));
   82:                 }
   83: 
   84:                 snapshot[index] =
   85:                     result;
   86: 
   87:                 if (result.IsEligible)
   88:                 {
   89:                     eligibleCount++;
   90:                 }
   91:             }
   92: 
   93:             _emissions =
   94:                 Array.AsReadOnly(
   95:                     snapshot);
   96: 
   97:             EligibleCount =
   98:                 eligibleCount;
   99:         }
  100: 
  101:         public IPropagatedEmissionVector Source { get; }
  102: 
  103:         public IReadOnlyList<IEmissionEligibilityResult> Emissions =>
  104:             _emissions;
  105: 
  106:         public int Dimension =>
  107:             _emissions.Count;
  108: 
  109:         public int EligibleCount { get; }
  110: 
  111:         public bool AnyEligible =>
  112:             EligibleCount > 0;
  113: 
  114:         public bool AllEligible =>
  115:             EligibleCount == Dimension;
  116:     }
  117: }

############################################################
FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Emission\EmissionInstructionResolution.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    4: 
    5: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Emission
    6: {
    7:     /// <summary>
    8:     /// Resolves eligible propagated-emission facts into the
    9:     /// existing Wilds state-instruction model.
   10:     ///
   11:     /// Resolution does not register, process, or execute the
   12:     /// resulting instructions.
   13:     /// </summary>
   14:     public sealed class EmissionInstructionResolution
   15:     {
   16:         private readonly IEmissionInstructionResolver _resolver;
   17: 
   18:         public EmissionInstructionResolution(
   19:             IEmissionInstructionResolver resolver)
   20:         {
   21:             _resolver =
   22:                 resolver ??
   23:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   24:                     nameof(resolver));
   25:         }
   26: 
   27:         public IEmissionStateInstruction Resolve(
   28:             IEmissionEligibilityResult eligibility)
   29:         {
   30:             if (eligibility == null)
   31:             {
   32:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   33:                     nameof(eligibility));
   34:             }
   35: 
   36:             if (!eligibility.IsEligible)
   37:             {
   38:                 throw new ArgumentException(
   39:                     "State-instruction resolution requires an " +
   40:                     "eligible propagated-emission decision.",
   41:                     nameof(eligibility));
   42:             }
   43: 
   44:             var instruction =
   45:                 _resolver.Resolve(
   46:                     eligibility);
   47: 
   48:             ValidateResolvedInstruction(
   49:                 eligibility,
   50:                 instruction);
   51: 
   52:             return instruction;
   53:         }
   54: 
   55:         public IReadOnlyList<IEmissionStateInstruction> Resolve(
   56:             IEmissionEligibilityVector eligibility)
   57:         {
   58:             if (eligibility == null)
   59:             {
   60:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   61:                     nameof(eligibility));
   62:             }
   63: 
   64:             var resolved =
   65:                 new List<IEmissionStateInstruction>(
   66:                     eligibility.EligibleCount);
   67: 
   68:             for (var index = 0;
   69:                  index < eligibility.Dimension;
   70:                  index++)
   71:             {
   72:                 var decision =
   73:                     eligibility.Emissions[index];
   74: 
   75:                 if (!decision.IsEligible)
   76:                 {
   77:                     continue;
   78:                 }
   79: 
   80:                 resolved.Add(
   81:                     Resolve(
   82:                         decision));
   83:             }
   84: 
   85:             return resolved.AsReadOnly();
   86:         }
   87: 
   88:         private static void ValidateResolvedInstruction(
   89:             IEmissionEligibilityResult eligibility,
   90:             IEmissionStateInstruction instruction)
   91:         {
   92:             if (instruction == null)
   93:             {
   94:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
   95:                     "The emission instruction resolver returned null.");
   96:             }
   97: 
   98:             if (!ReferenceEquals(
   99:                     eligibility,
  100:                     instruction.Source))
  101:             {
  102:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  103:                     "The resolved instruction must preserve the " +
  104:                     "exact eligibility-result reference.");
  105:             }
  106:         }
  107:     }
  108: }

############################################################
FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Emission\EmissionPropagation.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions.Neighbors.Propagation;
    4: 
    5: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Emission
    6: {
    7:     /// <summary>
    8:     /// Bridges resolved Wilds emissions into the existing
    9:     /// Neighbor intensity-propagation contract.
   10:     ///
   11:     /// Emission resolution remains complete before this
   12:     /// operation begins. Propagation never recalculates the
   13:     /// emitter's base scalar, topology scalar, or composition.
   14:     /// </summary>
   15:     public sealed class EmissionPropagation
   16:     {
   17:         private readonly INeighborPropagation _propagation;
   18: 
   19:         public EmissionPropagation(
   20:             INeighborPropagation propagation)
   21:         {
   22:             _propagation =
   23:                 propagation ??
   24:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   25:                     nameof(propagation));
   26:         }
   27: 
   28:         public IPropagatedEmission Propagate(
   29:             IResolvedEmission emission,
   30:             INeighborRelationship relationship)
   31:         {
   32:             if (emission == null)
   33:             {
   34:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   35:                     nameof(emission));
   36:             }
   37: 
   38:             if (relationship == null)
   39:             {
   40:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   41:                     nameof(relationship));
   42:             }
   43: 
   44:             var propagated =
   45:                 _propagation.Propagate(
   46:                     emission.Value,
   47:                     relationship);
   48: 
   49:             return new PropagatedEmission(
   50:                 emission,
   51:                 relationship,
   52:                 propagated);
   53:         }
   54:     }
   55: }

FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Emission\EmissionScalar.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Globalization;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    4: 
    5: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Emission
    6: {
    7:     /// <summary>
    8:     /// Resolves ordinary finite numeric consumer values into
    9:     /// Wilds emission scalars.
   10:     ///
   11:     /// No semantic conversion is performed for non-numeric
   12:     /// consumer values.
   13:     /// </summary>
   14:     public sealed class EmissionScalar :
   15:         IEmissionScalar
   16:     {
   17:         public double Resolve(
   18:             object? value)
   19:         {
   20:             if (value == null)
   21:             {
   22:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   23:                     nameof(value));
   24:             }
   25: 
   26:             double scalar;
   27: 
   28:             switch (value)
   29:             {
   30:                 case byte number:
   31:                     scalar = number;
   32:                     break;
   33: 
   34:                 case sbyte number:
   35:                     scalar = number;
   36:                     break;
   37: 
   38:                 case short number:
   39:                     scalar = number;
   40:                     break;
   41: 
   42:                 case ushort number:
   43:                     scalar = number;
   44:                     break;
   45: 
   46:                 case int number:
   47:                     scalar = number;
   48:                     break;
   49: 
   50:                 case uint number:
   51:                     scalar = number;
   52:                     break;
   53: 
   54:                 case long number:
   55:                     scalar = number;
   56:                     break;
   57: 
   58:                 case ulong number:
   59:                     scalar = number;
   60:                     break;
   61: 
   62:                 case float number:
   63:                     scalar = number;
   64:                     break;
   65: 
   66:                 case double number:
   67:                     scalar = number;
   68:                     break;
   69: 
   70:                 case decimal number:
   71:                     scalar =
   72:                         Convert.ToDouble(
   73:                             number,
   74:                             CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
   75:                     break;
   76: 
   77:                 default:
   78:                     throw new ArgumentException(
   79:                         "Emission scalar values must be numeric.",
   80:                         nameof(value));
   81:             }
   82: 
   83:             if (double.IsNaN(scalar) ||
   84:                 double.IsInfinity(scalar))
   85:             {
   86:                 throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
   87:                     nameof(value),
   88:                     scalar,
   89:                     "Emission scalar values must be finite.");
   90:             }
   91: 
   92:             return scalar;
   93:         }
   94:     }
   95: }

   19:

   21:             INeighborPropagationEligibility eligibility)

   23:             _eligibility =
   24:                 eligibility ??
   25:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   26:                     nameof(eligibility));
   27:         }
   28: 
   29:         public IEmissionEligibilityVector Evaluate(
   30:             IPropagatedEmissionVector vector)
   31:         {
   32:             if (vector == null)
   33:             {
   34:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   35:                     nameof(vector));
   36:             }
   37: 
   38:             var results =
   39:                 new List<IEmissionEligibilityResult>(
   40:                     vector.Dimension);
   41: 
   42:             for (var index = 0;
   43:                  index < vector.Dimension;
   44:                  index++)

   47:                     vector.Emissions[index];

   50:                     emission.Value;

   53:                     _eligibility.IsEligible(
   54:                         evaluatedValue);

############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    4: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions.Neighbors.Propagation;
    5: 
    6: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Emission
    7: {
    8:     /// <summary>
    9:     /// Normalizes and propagates one immutable resolved
   10:     /// emission vector through one exact Neighbor
   11:     /// relationship.
   12:     ///
   13:     /// The operation preserves vector identity, component
   14:     /// ordering, exact emission references, resolved values,
   15:     /// normalized values, and relationship identity.
   16:     /// </summary>
   17:     public sealed class EmissionVectorPropagation
   18:     {
   19:         private readonly IEmissionNormalizationPolicy
   20:             _normalization;
   21: 
   22:         private readonly INeighborPropagation
   23:             _propagation;
   24: 
   25:         public EmissionVectorPropagation(
   26:             IEmissionNormalizationPolicy normalization,
   27:             INeighborPropagation propagation)
   28:         {
   29:             _normalization =
   30:                 normalization ??
   31:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   32:                     nameof(normalization));
   33: 
   34:             _propagation =
   35:                 propagation ??
   36:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   37:                     nameof(propagation));
   38:         }
   39: 
   40:         public IPropagatedEmissionVector Propagate(
   41:             IResolvedEmissionVector vector,
   42:             INeighborRelationship relationship)
   43:         {
   44:             if (vector == null)
   45:             {
   46:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   47:                     nameof(vector));
   48:             }
   49: 
   50:             if (relationship == null)
   51:             {
   52:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   53:                     nameof(relationship));
   54:             }
   55: 
   56:             var normalized =
   57:                 _normalization.Normalize(
   58:                     vector);
   59: 
   60:             if (normalized == null)
   61:             {
   62:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
   63:                     "The normalization policy returned null.");
   64:             }
   65: 
   66:             if (!ReferenceEquals(
   67:                     vector,
   68:                     normalized.Source))
   69:             {
   70:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
   71:                     "Normalization must preserve the exact " +
   72:                     "resolved-emission vector.");
   73:             }
   74: 
   75:             var propagated =
   76:                 new List<IPropagatedEmission>(
   77:                     normalized.Dimension);
   78: 
   79:             for (var index = 0;
   80:                  index < normalized.Dimension;
   81:                  index++)
   82:             {
   83:                 var component =
   84:                     normalized.Emissions[index];
   85: 
   86:                 var received =
   87:                     _propagation.Propagate(
   88:                         component.NormalizedValue,
   89:                         relationship);
   90: 
   91:                 propagated.Add(
   92:                     new PropagatedEmission(
   93:                         component.Emission,
   94:                         relationship,
   95:                         component.NormalizedValue,
   96:                         received));
   97:             }
   98: 
   99:             return new PropagatedEmissionVector(
  100:                 normalized,
  101:                 relationship,
  102:                 propagated);
  103:         }
  104:     }
  105: }

    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    4: using WildsEngine.Core.Objects;
    5: 
    6: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Emission
    7: {
    8:     /// <summary>
    9:     /// Base implementation for identifiable Wilds objects
   10:     /// capable of resolving consumer-owned data into scalar
   11:     /// emissions.
   12:     ///
   13:     /// The emitter owns no consumer vocabulary. Property
   14:     /// names, group names, and their values remain defined
   15:     /// by the consumer.
   16:     ///
   17:     /// As a BaseObject, every emitter also participates in
   18:     /// ordinary Wilds neighbor topology.
   19:     /// </summary>
   20:     public abstract class EmitterBase :
   21:         BaseObject,
   22:         IEmitter
   23:     {
   24:         private readonly IComponent _component;
   25:         private readonly IEmissionScalar _scalar;
   26: 
   27:         protected EmitterBase(
   28:             IComponent component,
   29:             string layer,
   30:             IEmissionDataSource dataSource,
   31:             IEmissionScalar scalar)
   32:             : base(layer)
   33:         {
   34:             _component =
   35:                 component ??
   36:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   37:                     nameof(component));
   38: 
   39:             DataSource =
   40:                 dataSource ??
   41:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   42:                     nameof(dataSource));
   43: 
   44:             _scalar =
   45:                 scalar ??
   46:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   47:                     nameof(scalar));
   48:         }
   49: 
   50:         public override IComponent Component =>
   51:             _component;
   52: 
   53:         public IEmissionDataSource DataSource { get; }
   54: 
   55:         protected IEmissionScalar Scalar =>
   56:             _scalar;
   57: 
   58:         public virtual bool TryEmit(
   59:             string propertyName,
   60:             out double value)
   61:         {
   62:             value =
   63:                 0.0;
   64: 
   65:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
   66:                     propertyName))
   67:             {
   68:                 return false;
   69:             }
   70: 
   71:             if (!DataSource.TryGetProperty(
   72:                     propertyName,
   73:                     out var rawValue))
   74:             {
   75:                 return false;
   76:             }
   77: 
   78:             value =
   79:                 ResolveScalar(
   80:                     rawValue);
   81: 
   82:             return true;
   83:         }
   84: 
   85:         public virtual bool TryEmitGroup(
   86:             string groupName,
   87:             out IReadOnlyDictionary<string, double> values)
   88:         {
   89:             values =
   90:                 new Dictionary<string, double>();
   91: 
   92:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
   93:                     groupName))
   94:             {
   95:                 return false;
   96:             }
   97: 
   98:             if (!DataSource.TryGetGroup(
   99:                     groupName,
  100:                     out var rawValues))
  101:             {
  102:                 return false;
  103:             }
  104: 
  105:             var resolved =
  106:                 new Dictionary<string, double>(
  107:                     StringComparer.Ordinal);
  108: 
  109:             foreach (var pair in rawValues)
  110:             {
  111:                 if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
  112:                         pair.Key))
  113:                 {
  114:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  115:                         "Emission groups cannot contain " +
  116:                         "an empty property name.");
  117:                 }
  118: 
  119:                 resolved.Add(
  120:                     pair.Key,
  121:                     ResolveScalar(
  122:                         pair.Value));
  123:             }
  124: 
  125:             values =
  126:                 resolved;
  127: 
  128:             return true;
  129:         }
  130: 
  131:         protected virtual double ResolveScalar(
  132:             object? value)
  133:         {
  134:             return _scalar.Resolve(
  135:                 value);
  136:         }
  137: 
  138:         protected double ResolveTopologyScalar<TResult>(
  139:             INeighborSequenceOperator topology,
  140:             INeighborScalarOperator<TResult> scalar,
  141:             Func<TResult, double> conversion)
  142:         {
  143:             if (topology == null)
  144:             {
  145:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
  146:                     nameof(topology));
  147:             }
  148: 
  149:             if (scalar == null)
  150:             {
  151:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
  152:                     nameof(scalar));
  153:             }
  154: 
  155:             if (conversion == null)
  156:             {
  157:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
  158:                     nameof(conversion));
  159:             }
  160: 
  161:             var relationships =
  162:                 ApplyNeighborOperator(
  163:                     topology);
  164: 
  165:             var result =
  166:                 scalar.Apply(
  167:                     this,
  168:                     relationships);
  169: 
  170:             var value =
  171:                 conversion(
  172:                     result);
  173: 
  174:             if (double.IsNaN(value) ||
  175:                 double.IsInfinity(value))
  176:             {
  177:                 throw new ArithmeticException(
  178:                     "Topology scalar must be finite.");
  179:             }
  180: 
  181:             return value;
  182:         }
  183: 
  184:         protected double ComposeEmission(
  185:             double emission,
  186:             double topology,
  187:             IEmissionComposition composition)
  188:         {
  189:             if (composition == null)
  190:             {
  191:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
  192:                     nameof(composition));
  193:             }
  194: 
  195:             return composition.Compose(
  196:                 emission,
  197:                 topology);
  198:         }
  199: 
  200:         /// <summary>
  201:         /// Resolves one consumer-owned emission through the
  202:         /// emitter's current topology and supplied composition
  203:         /// policy.
  204:         ///
  205:         /// This is the Gate 3 scalar-resolution boundary.
  206:         /// </summary>
  207:         protected bool TryResolveEmission<TResult>(
  208:             string propertyName,
  209:             INeighborSequenceOperator topology,
  210:             INeighborScalarOperator<TResult> topologyScalar,
  211:             Func<TResult, double> conversion,
  212:             IEmissionComposition composition,
  213:             out double value)
  214:         {
  215:             value =
  216:                 0.0;
  217: 
  218:             if (topology == null)
  219:             {
  220:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
  221:                     nameof(topology));
  222:             }
  223: 
  224:             if (topologyScalar == null)
  225:             {
  226:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
  227:                     nameof(topologyScalar));
  228:             }
  229: 
  230:             if (conversion == null)
  231:             {
  232:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
  233:                     nameof(conversion));
  234:             }
  235: 
  236:             if (composition == null)
  237:             {
  238:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
  239:                     nameof(composition));
  240:             }
  241: 
  242:             if (!TryEmit(
  243:                     propertyName,
  244:                     out var emission))
  245:             {
  246:                 return false;
  247:             }
  248: 
  249:             var resolvedTopology =
  250:                 ResolveTopologyScalar(
  251:                     topology,
  252:                     topologyScalar,
  253:                     conversion);
  254: 
  255:             value =
  256:                 ComposeEmission(
  257:                     emission,
  258:                     resolvedTopology,
  259:                     composition);
  260: 
  261:             return true;
  262:         }
  263: 
  264:         /// <summary>
  265:         /// Resolves one consumer-owned emission and packages
  266:         /// the certified scalar result into an immutable
  267:         /// resolved-emission carrier.
  268:         ///
  269:         /// This operation adds no new emission mathematics.
  270:         /// It preserves the Gate 3 result together with the
  271:         /// exact source emitter and consumer-owned emission
  272:         /// identity.
  273:         /// </summary>
  274:         protected bool TryResolveEmissionResult<TResult>(
  275:             string emissionName,
  276:             INeighborSequenceOperator topology,
  277:             INeighborScalarOperator<TResult> topologyScalar,
  278:             Func<TResult, double> conversion,
  279:             IEmissionComposition composition,
  280:             out IResolvedEmission? result)
  281:         {
  282:             result =
  283:                 null;
  284: 
  285:             if (!TryResolveEmission(
  286:                     emissionName,
  287:                     topology,
  288:                     topologyScalar,
  289:                     conversion,
  290:                     composition,
  291:                     out var value))
  292:             {
  293:                 return false;
  294:             }
  295: 
  296:             result =
  297:                 new ResolvedEmission(
  298:                     this,
  299:                     emissionName,
  300:                     value);
  301: 
  302:             return true;
  303:         }
  304:     }
  305: }

############################################################
FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Emission\NormalizedEmissionVector.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    4: 
    5: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Emission
    6: {
    7:     /// <summary>
    8:     /// Immutable normalized representation of one resolved
    9:     /// emission vector.
   10:     ///
   11:     /// Dimensions, ordering, exact resolved-emission
   12:     /// references, and resolved magnitudes are preserved.
   13:     /// </summary>
   14:     public sealed class NormalizedEmissionVector :
   15:         INormalizedEmissionVector
   16:     {
   17:         private const double NormalizationTolerance =
   18:             1e-12;
   19: 
   20:         private readonly IReadOnlyList<INormalizedEmission>
   21:             _emissions;
   22: 
   23:         public NormalizedEmissionVector(
   24:             IResolvedEmissionVector source,
   25:             IReadOnlyList<INormalizedEmission> emissions)
   26:         {
   27:             Source =
   28:                 source ??
   29:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   30:                     nameof(source));
   31: 
   32:             if (emissions == null)
   33:             {
   34:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   35:                     nameof(emissions));
   36:             }
   37: 
   38:             if (emissions.Count !=
   39:                 source.Dimension)
   40:             {
   41:                 throw new ArgumentException(
   42:                     "Normalized-vector dimension must match " +
   43:                     "the resolved-vector dimension.",
   44:                     nameof(emissions));
   45:             }
   46: 
   47:             var snapshot =
   48:                 new INormalizedEmission[
   49:                     emissions.Count];
   50: 
   51:             var total =
   52:                 0.0;
   53: 
   54:             for (var index = 0;
   55:                  index < emissions.Count;
   56:                  index++)
   57:             {
   58:                 var component =
   59:                     emissions[index] ??
   60:                     throw new ArgumentException(
   61:                         "A normalized vector cannot contain " +
   62:                         "a null component.",
   63:                         nameof(emissions));
   64: 
   65:                 if (!ReferenceEquals(
   66:                         source.Emissions[index],
   67:                         component.Emission))
   68:                 {
   69:                     throw new ArgumentException(
   70:                         "Normalization must preserve exact " +
   71:                         "emission references and ordering.",
   72:                         nameof(emissions));
   73:                 }
   74: 
   75:                 if (component.ResolvedValue !=
   76:                     source.Emissions[index].Value)
   77:                 {
   78:                     throw new ArgumentException(
   79:                         "Normalization must preserve exact " +
   80:                         "resolved magnitudes.",
   81:                         nameof(emissions));
   82:                 }
   83: 
   84:                 var normalizedValue =
   85:                     component.NormalizedValue;
   86: 
   87:                 if (double.IsNaN(normalizedValue) ||
   88:                     double.IsInfinity(normalizedValue) ||
   89:                     normalizedValue < 0.0)
   90:                 {
   91:                     throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
   92:                         nameof(emissions),
   93:                         normalizedValue,
   94:                         "Normalized values must be finite " +
   95:                         "and non-negative.");
   96:                 }
   97: 
   98:                 snapshot[index] =
   99:                     component;
  100: 
  101:                 total +=
  102:                     normalizedValue;
  103: 
  104:                 if (double.IsNaN(total) ||
  105:                     double.IsInfinity(total))
  106:                 {
  107:                     throw new ArithmeticException(
  108:                         "Normalized-vector accumulation " +
  109:                         "produced a non-finite total.");
  110:                 }
  111:             }
  112: 
  113:             if (Math.Abs(
  114:                     total -
  115:                     1.0) >
  116:                 NormalizationTolerance)
  117:             {
  118:                 throw new ArgumentException(
  119:                     "The normalized emission-vector total " +
  120:                     "must equal one.",
  121:                     nameof(emissions));
  122:             }
  123: 
  124:             _emissions =
  125:                 Array.AsReadOnly(
  126:                     snapshot);
  127: 
  128:             NormalizedTotal =
  129:                 total;
  130:         }
  131: 
  132:         public IResolvedEmissionVector Source { get; }
  133: 
  134:         public IReadOnlyList<INormalizedEmission> Emissions =>
  135:             _emissions;
  136: 
  137:         public int Dimension =>
  138:             _emissions.Count;
  139: 
  140:         public double NormalizedTotal { get; }
  141:     }
  142: }

    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    4: 
    5: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Emission
    6: {
    7:     /// <summary>
    8:     /// Immutable result of propagating one normalized
    9:     /// emission vector through one exact Neighbor
   10:     /// relationship.
   11:     ///
   12:     /// Complete resolved and normalized provenance remains
   13:     /// available through Source.
   14:     ///
   15:     /// PropagationDistance preserves the relationship distance
   16:     /// used for the complete vector operation.
   17:     /// </summary>
   18:     public sealed class PropagatedEmissionVector :
   19:         IPropagatedEmissionVector
   20:     {
   21:         private readonly IReadOnlyList<IPropagatedEmission>
   22:             _emissions;
   23: 
   24:         public PropagatedEmissionVector(
   25:             INormalizedEmissionVector source,
   26:             INeighborRelationship relationship,
   27:             IReadOnlyList<IPropagatedEmission> emissions)
   28:         {
   29:             Source =
   30:                 source ??
   31:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   32:                     nameof(source));
   33: 
   34:             Relationship =
   35:                 relationship ??
   36:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   37:                     nameof(relationship));
   38: 
   39:             ValidateNonNegativeFinite(
   40:                 relationship.Distance,
   41:                 nameof(relationship));
   42: 
   43:             PropagationDistance =
   44:                 relationship.Distance;
   45: 
   46:             if (emissions == null)
   47:             {
   48:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   49:                     nameof(emissions));
   50:             }
   51: 
   52:             if (emissions.Count !=
   53:                 source.Dimension)
   54:             {
   55:                 throw new ArgumentException(
   56:                     "Propagated-vector dimension must match " +
   57:                     "the normalized-vector dimension.",
   58:                     nameof(emissions));
   59:             }
   60: 
   61:             var snapshot =
   62:                 new IPropagatedEmission[
   63:                     emissions.Count];
   64: 
   65:             var total =
   66:                 0.0;
   67: 
   68:             for (var index = 0;
   69:                  index < emissions.Count;
   70:                  index++)
   71:             {
   72:                 var component =
   73:                     emissions[index] ??
   74:                     throw new ArgumentException(
   75:                         "A propagated vector cannot contain " +
   76:                         "a null component.",
   77:                         nameof(emissions));
   78: 
   79:                 var normalized =
   80:                     source.Emissions[index];
   81: 
   82:                 if (!ReferenceEquals(
   83:                         normalized.Emission,
   84:                         component.Emission))
   85:                 {
   86:                     throw new ArgumentException(
   87:                         "Propagation must preserve exact " +
   88:                         "emission references and ordering.",
   89:                         nameof(emissions));
   90:                 }
   91: 
   92:                 if (!ReferenceEquals(
   93:                         relationship,
   94:                         component.Relationship))
   95:                 {
   96:                     throw new ArgumentException(
   97:                         "Every propagated component must " +
   98:                         "preserve the vector relationship.",
   99:                         nameof(emissions));
  100:                 }
  101: 
  102:                 if (component.PropagationDistance !=
  103:                     PropagationDistance)
  104:                 {
  105:                     throw new ArgumentException(
  106:                         "Every propagated component must " +
  107:                         "preserve the vector propagation " +
  108:                         "distance.",
  109:                         nameof(emissions));
  110:                 }
  111: 
  112:                 if (component.ResolvedValue !=
  113:                     normalized.ResolvedValue)
  114:                 {
  115:                     throw new ArgumentException(
  116:                         "Propagation must preserve exact " +
  117:                         "resolved magnitudes.",
  118:                         nameof(emissions));
  119:                 }
  120: 
  121:                 if (!component.NormalizedValue.HasValue ||
  122:                     component.NormalizedValue.Value !=
  123:                     normalized.NormalizedValue)
  124:                 {
  125:                     throw new ArgumentException(
  126:                         "Propagation must preserve exact " +
  127:                         "normalized magnitudes.",
  128:                         nameof(emissions));
  129:                 }
  130: 
  131:                 ValidateNonNegativeFinite(
  132:                     component.Value,
  133:                     nameof(emissions));
  134: 
  135:                 snapshot[index] =
  136:                     component;
  137: 
  138:                 total +=
  139:                     component.Value;
  140: 
  141:                 if (double.IsNaN(total) ||
  142:                     double.IsInfinity(total))
  143:                 {
  144:                     throw new ArithmeticException(
  145:                         "Propagated-vector accumulation " +
  146:                         "produced a non-finite total.");
  147:                 }
  148:             }
  149: 
  150:             _emissions =
  151:                 Array.AsReadOnly(
  152:                     snapshot);
  153: 
  154:             ReceivedTotal =
  155:                 total;
  156:         }
  157: 
  158:         public INormalizedEmissionVector Source { get; }
  159: 
  160:         public INeighborRelationship Relationship { get; }
  161: 
  162:         public double PropagationDistance { get; }
  163: 
  164:         public IReadOnlyList<IPropagatedEmission> Emissions =>
  165:             _emissions;
  166: 
  167:         public int Dimension =>
  168:             _emissions.Count;
  169: 
  170:         public double ReceivedTotal { get; }
  171: 
  172:         private static void ValidateNonNegativeFinite(
  173:             double value,
  174:             string parameterName)
  175:         {
  176:             if (double.IsNaN(value) ||
  177:                 double.IsInfinity(value) ||
  178:                 value < 0.0)
  179:             {
  180:                 throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
  181:                     parameterName,
  182:                     value,
  183:                     "A propagated vector value must be " +
  184:                     "finite and non-negative.");
  185:             }
  186:         }
  187:     }
  188: }

   45:         }

   99: 
  100:             ResolvedValue =
  101:                 emission.Value;
  102:

  107:                 value;
  108:         }

FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Emission\ProportionalEmissionNormalization.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    4: 
    5: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Emission
    6: {
    7:     /// <summary>
    8:     /// Normalizes one resolved-emission vector by
    9:     /// proportional contribution.
   10:     ///
   11:     /// Resolved magnitudes remain unchanged. Each normalized
   12:     /// component receives its proportional share of the
   13:     /// resolved-vector total.
   14:     /// </summary>
   15:     public sealed class ProportionalEmissionNormalization :
   16:         IEmissionNormalizationPolicy
   17:     {
   18:         public INormalizedEmissionVector Normalize(
   19:             IResolvedEmissionVector vector)
   20:         {
   21:             if (vector == null)
   22:             {
   23:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   24:                     nameof(vector));
   25:             }
   26: 
   27:             if (vector.ResolvedTotal <= 0.0)
   28:             {
   29:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
   30:                     "An emission vector must contain a " +
   31:                     "positive total before normalization.");
   32:             }
   33: 
   34:             var normalized =
   35:                 new List<INormalizedEmission>(
   36:                     vector.Dimension);
   37: 
   38:             for (var index = 0;
   39:                  index < vector.Dimension;
   40:                  index++)
   41:             {
   42:                 var emission =
   43:                     vector.Emissions[index];
   44: 
   45:                 normalized.Add(
   46:                     new NormalizedEmission(
   47:                         emission,
   48:                         emission.Value /
   49:                         vector.ResolvedTotal));
   50:             }
   51: 
   52:             return new NormalizedEmissionVector(
   53:                 vector,
   54:                 normalized);
   55:         }
   56:     }
   57: }

FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Emission\ResolvedEmissionVector.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    4: 
    5: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Emission
    6: {
    7:     /// <summary>
    8:     /// Immutable ordered carrier for an arbitrary
    9:     /// N-dimensional set of resolved emissions.
   10:     ///
   11:     /// Every component belongs to the same exact source
   12:     /// emitter.
   13:     ///
   14:     /// Every emission name must be unique within the vector.
   15:     ///
   16:     /// The vector owns no normalization, propagation,
   17:     /// eligibility, or receiver behavior.
   18:     /// </summary>
   19:     public sealed class ResolvedEmissionVector :
   20:         IResolvedEmissionVector
   21:     {
   22:         private readonly IReadOnlyList<IResolvedEmission>
   23:             _emissions;
   24: 
   25:         public ResolvedEmissionVector(
   26:             IReadOnlyList<IResolvedEmission> emissions)
   27:         {
   28:             if (emissions == null)
   29:             {
   30:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   31:                     nameof(emissions));
   32:             }
   33: 
   34:             if (emissions.Count == 0)
   35:             {
   36:                 throw new ArgumentException(
   37:                     "An emission vector cannot be empty.",
   38:                     nameof(emissions));
   39:             }
   40: 
   41:             var first =
   42:                 emissions[0] ??
   43:                 throw new ArgumentException(
   44:                     "An emission vector cannot contain " +
   45:                     "a null emission.",
   46:                     nameof(emissions));
   47: 
   48:             Source =
   49:                 first.Source;
   50: 
   51:             var names =
   52:                 new HashSet<string>(
   53:                     StringComparer.Ordinal);
   54: 
   55:             var snapshot =
   56:                 new IResolvedEmission[
   57:                     emissions.Count];
   58: 
   59:             var total =
   60:                 0.0;
   61: 
   62:             for (var index = 0;
   63:                  index < emissions.Count;
   64:                  index++)
   65:             {
   66:                 var emission =
   67:                     emissions[index] ??
   68:                     throw new ArgumentException(
   69:                         "An emission vector cannot contain " +
   70:                         "a null emission.",
   71:                         nameof(emissions));
   72: 
   73:                 if (!ReferenceEquals(
   74:                         Source,
   75:                         emission.Source))
   76:                 {
   77:                     throw new ArgumentException(
   78:                         "Every emission in a vector must " +
   79:                         "preserve the same exact source emitter.",
   80:                         nameof(emissions));
   81:                 }
   82: 
   83:                 if (!names.Add(
   84:                         emission.Name))
   85:                 {
   86:                     throw new ArgumentException(
   87:                         "An emission vector cannot contain " +
   88:                         "duplicate emission names.",
   89:                         nameof(emissions));
   90:                 }
   91: 
   92:                 if (double.IsNaN(
   93:                         emission.Value) ||
   94:                     double.IsInfinity(
   95:                         emission.Value) ||
   96:                     emission.Value < 0.0)
   97:                 {
   98:                     throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
   99:                         nameof(emissions),
  100:                         emission.Value,
  101:                         "Emission vectors require finite, " +
  102:                         "non-negative resolved magnitudes.");
  103:                 }
  104: 
  105:                 snapshot[index] =
  106:                     emission;
  107: 
  108:                 total +=
  109:                     emission.Value;
  110: 
  111:                 if (double.IsNaN(total) ||
  112:                     double.IsInfinity(total))
  113:                 {
  114:                     throw new ArithmeticException(
  115:                         "Resolved-vector accumulation produced " +
  116:                         "a non-finite total.");
  117:                 }
  118:             }
  119: 
  120:             _emissions =
  121:                 Array.AsReadOnly(
  122:                     snapshot);
  123: 
  124:             ResolvedTotal =
  125:                 total;
  126:         }
  127: 
  128:         public IEmitter Source { get; }
  129: 
  130:         public IReadOnlyList<IResolvedEmission> Emissions =>
  131:             _emissions;
  132: 
  133:         public int Dimension =>
  134:             _emissions.Count;
  135: 
  136:         public double ResolvedTotal { get; }
  137:     }
  138: }
