    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using System.Threading;
    4: using System.Threading.Tasks;
    5: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    6: using WildsEngine.Core.Pooling;
    7: using WildsEngine.Core.Processing.Coordinator;
    8: using WildsEngine.Core.Processing.Processor;
    9: using WildsEngine.Core.Processing.Registry;
   10: using WildsEngine.Core.Units;
   11: 
   12: namespace WildsEngine.Core
   13: {
   14:     /// <summary>
   15:     /// Composition root for one isolated Wilds runtime instance.
   16:     ///
   17:     /// Wilds accepts complete requests as Pulses, owns their
   18:     /// internal WorkUnits, resolves them into Moments, and
   19:     /// records those Moments in its Timeline and Epoch.
   20:     /// </summary>
   21:     public sealed class WildsEngine :
   22:         IDisposable
   23:     {
   24:         private readonly IComponent _component;
   25: 
   26:         private readonly DefaultInstructionsRegistry
   27:             _instructionRegistry;
   28: 
   29:         private readonly DefaultTasksRegistry
   30:             _tasksRegistry;
   31: 
   32:         private readonly ObjectPool<ITaskProcessor>
   33:             _taskProcessors;
   34: 
   35:         private readonly ObjectPool<IInstructionsProcessor>
   36:             _instructionsProcessors;
   37: 
   38:         private readonly Timeline _timeline;
   39:         private readonly Epoch _epoch;
   40: 
   41:         private int _disposed;
   42: 
   43:         public WildsEngine(
   44:             IComponent component,
   45:             WildsEngineOptions options)
   46:         {
   47:             _component =
   48:                 component ??
   49:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   50:                     nameof(component));
   51: 
   52:             if (options == null)
   53:             {
   54:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   55:                     nameof(options));
   56:             }
   57: 
   58:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
   59:                     options.Layer))
   60:             {
   61:                 throw new ArgumentException(
   62:                     "The engine requires a layer.",
   63:                     nameof(options));
   64:             }
   65: 
   66:             Layer =
   67:                 options.Layer.Trim();
   68: 
   69:             _instructionRegistry =
   70:                 new DefaultInstructionsRegistry(
   71:                     _component,
   72:                     $"{Layer}.instruction-registry");
   73: 
   74:             _tasksRegistry =
   75:                 new DefaultTasksRegistry(
   76:                     _component,
   77:                     $"{Layer}.task-registry");
   78: 
   79:             _taskProcessors =
   80:                 new ObjectPool<ITaskProcessor>(
   81:                     factory: () =>
   82:                         new TaskProcessor(
   83:                             _component,
   84:                             $"{Layer}.task-processor",
   85:                             _tasksRegistry),
   86:                     maximumRetained:
   87:                         options.RetainedTaskProcessors,
   88:                     maximumConcurrent:
   89:                         options.ConcurrentTaskProcessors);
   90: 
   91:             _instructionsProcessors =
   92:                 new ObjectPool<IInstructionsProcessor>(
   93:                     factory: () =>
   94:                         new InstructionsProcessor(
   95:                             _component,
   96:                             $"{Layer}.instructions-processor",
   97:                             _instructionRegistry,
   98:                             _taskProcessors),
   99:                     maximumRetained:
  100:                         options.RetainedInstructionsProcessors,
  101:                     maximumConcurrent:
  102:                         options.ConcurrentInstructionsProcessors);
  103: 
  104:             _timeline =
  105:                 new Timeline();
  106: 
  107:             _epoch =
  108:                 new Epoch();
  109: 
  110:             if (!_epoch.AddTimeline(
  111:                     _timeline))
  112:             {
  113:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  114:                     "The engine could not initialize " +
  115:                     "its primary Timeline.");
  116:             }
  117:         }
  118: 
  119:         public string Layer { get; }
  120: 
  121:         public IComponent Component =>
  122:             _component;
  123: 
  124:         public bool IsInitialized { get; private set; }
  125: 
  126:         public IObjectPool<IInstructionsProcessor>
  127:             Instructions =>
  128:                 _instructionsProcessors;
  129: 
  130:         /// <summary>
  131:         /// Contains the ordered Moment history produced by
  132:         /// this engine instance.
  133:         /// </summary>
  134:         public ITimeline Timeline =>
  135:             _timeline;
  136: 
  137:         /// <summary>
  138:         /// Contains the Timeline history owned by this
  139:         /// engine instance.
  140:         /// </summary>
  141:         public IEpoch Epoch =>
  142:             _epoch;
  143: 
  144:         public bool Initialize()
  145:         {
  146:             ThrowIfDisposed();
  147: 
  148:             if (IsInitialized)
  149:                 return false;
  150: 
  151:             _instructionRegistry.Initialize();
  152:             _tasksRegistry.Initialize();
  153: 
  154:             IsInitialized =
  155:                 true;
  156: 
  157:             return true;
  158:         }
  159: 
  160:         /// <summary>
  161:         /// Executes one complete consumer request through the
  162:         /// certified single-WorkUnit Pulse lifecycle.
  163:         ///
  164:         /// Wilds creates and correlates the Pulse and WorkUnit,
  165:         /// owns their lifecycle transitions, finalizes the
  166:         /// terminal Moment, and records that Moment in the
  167:         /// engine Timeline.
  168:         ///
  169:         /// The supplied operation represents internal work
  170:         /// performed by Wilds or an integration adapter.
  171:         /// </summary>
  172:         public async ValueTask<IMoment> ExecuteAsync(
  173:             object? request,
  174:             Func<
  175:                 object?,
  176:                 CancellationToken,
  177:                 ValueTask<object?>> operation,
  178:             CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
  179:         {
  180:             ThrowIfDisposed();
  181:             ThrowIfNotInitialized();
  182: 
  183:             if (operation == null)
  184:             {
  185:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
  186:                     nameof(operation));
  187:             }
  188: 
  189:             var pulse =
  190:                 new Pulse(
  191:                     request);
  192: 
  193:             var work =
  194:                 new WorkUnit(
  195:                     pulse.Id,
  196:                     request);
  197: 
  198:             var coordinator =
  199:                 new PulseCoordinator(
  200:                     pulse);
  201: 
  202:             BeginPulse(
  203:                 pulse,
  204:                 work,
  205:                 coordinator);
  206: 
  207:             object? result;
  208: 
  209:             try
  210:             {
  211:                 cancellationToken
  212:                     .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
  213: 
  214:                 result =
  215:                     await operation(
  216:                             request,
  217:                             cancellationToken)
  218:                         .ConfigureAwait(false);
  219: 
  220:                 cancellationToken
  221:                     .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
  222: 
  223:                 if (!work.TryComplete(
  224:                         result))
  225:                 {
  226:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  227:                         "The WorkUnit could not complete.");
  228:                 }
  229:             }
  230:             catch (OperationCanceledException)
  231:             {
  232:                 if (!work.IsTerminal &&
  233:                     !work.TryCancel())
  234:                 {
  235:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  236:                         "The WorkUnit could not be cancelled.");
  237:                 }
  238: 
  239:                 var cancelledMoment =
  240:                     FinalizePulse(
  241:                         coordinator,
  242:                         null);
  243: 
  244:                 RecordMoment(
  245:                     cancelledMoment);
  246: 
  247:                 return cancelledMoment;
  248:             }
  249:             catch (Exception exception)
  250:             {
  251:                 if (!work.IsTerminal &&
  252:                     !work.TryFail(
  253:                         exception))
  254:                 {
  255:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  256:                         "The WorkUnit could not record failure.",
  257:                         exception);
  258:                 }
  259: 
  260:                 var failedMoment =
  261:                     FinalizePulse(
  262:                         coordinator,
  263:                         null);
  264: 
  265:                 RecordMoment(
  266:                     failedMoment);
  267: 
  268:                 return failedMoment;
  269:             }
  270: 
  271:             var completedMoment =
  272:                 FinalizePulse(
  273:                     coordinator,
  274:                     result);
  275: 
  276:             RecordMoment(
  277:                 completedMoment);
  278: 
  279:             return completedMoment;
  280:         }
  281: 
  282:         /// <summary>
  283:         /// Executes one complete consumer request as multiple
  284:         /// required internal pieces of work.
  285:         ///
  286:         /// Wilds creates and owns the Pulse, every required
  287:         /// WorkUnit, coordination, terminal outcome, Moment,
  288:         /// and temporal history.
  289:         ///
  290:         /// The result selector explicitly chooses the one
  291:         /// authoritative Pulse result after every required
  292:         /// operation has produced its subordinate result.
  293:         /// </summary>
  294:         public async ValueTask<IMoment> ExecuteAsync(
  295:             object? request,
  296:             IReadOnlyList<
  297:                 Func<
  298:                     object?,
  299:                     CancellationToken,
  300:                     ValueTask<object?>>> operations,
  301:             Func<
  302:                 IReadOnlyList<object?>,
  303:                 object?> resultSelector,
  304:             CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
  305:         {
  306:             ThrowIfDisposed();
  307:             ThrowIfNotInitialized();
  308: 
  309:             if (operations == null)
  310:             {
  311:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
  312:                     nameof(operations));
  313:             }
  314: 
  315:             if (operations.Count == 0)
  316:             {
  317:                 throw new ArgumentException(
  318:                     "At least one operation is required.",
  319:                     nameof(operations));
  320:             }
  321: 
  322:             if (resultSelector == null)
  323:             {
  324:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
  325:                     nameof(resultSelector));
  326:             }
  327: 
  328:             for (var index = 0;
  329:                  index < operations.Count;
  330:                  index++)
  331:             {
  332:                 if (operations[index] == null)
  333:                 {
  334:                     throw new ArgumentException(
  335:                         "Every operation must be non-null.",
  336:                         nameof(operations));
  337:                 }
  338:             }
  339: 
  340:             var pulse =
  341:                 new Pulse(
  342:                     request);
  343: 
  344:             var coordinator =
  345:                 new PulseCoordinator(
  346:                     pulse);
  347: 
  348:             var workUnits =
  349:                 new WorkUnit[operations.Count];
  350: 
  351:             var results =
  352:                 new object?[operations.Count];
  353: 
  354:             BeginDecomposedPulse(
  355:                 pulse,
  356:                 workUnits,
  357:                 coordinator,
  358:                 request);
  359: 
  360:             for (var index = 0;
  361:                  index < operations.Count;
  362:                  index++)
  363:             {
  364:                 var work =
  365:                     workUnits[index];
  366: 
  367:                 try
  368:                 {
  369:                     cancellationToken
  370:                         .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
  371: 
  372:                     if (!work.TryBeginProcessing())
  373:                     {
  374:                         throw new InvalidOperationException(
  375:                             "The WorkUnit could not begin processing.");
  376:                     }
  377: 
  378:                     var result =
  379:                         await operations[index](
  380:                                 request,
  381:                                 cancellationToken)
  382:                             .ConfigureAwait(false);
  383: 
  384:                     cancellationToken
  385:                         .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
  386: 
  387:                     results[index] =
  388:                         result;
  389: 
  390:                     /*
  391:                      * The final WorkUnit remains Processing
  392:                      * until the authoritative Pulselected.
  393:                      *
  394:                      * Earlier WorkUnits may complete immediately
  395:                      * because their results are subordinate.
  396:                      */
  397:                     if (index <
  398:                         operations.Count - 1)
  399:                     {
  400:                         if (!work.TryComplete(
  401:                                 result))
  402:                         {
  403:                             throw new InvalidOperationException(
  404:                                 "The WorkUnit could not complete.");
  405:                         }
  406:                     }
  407:                 }
  408:                 catch (OperationCanceledException)
  409:                 {
  410:                     if (!work.IsTerminal &&
  411:                         !work.TryCancel())
  412:                     {
  413:                         throw new InvalidOperationException(
  414:                             "The active WorkUnit could not be cancelled.");
  415:                     }
  416: 
  417:                     CancelRemainingWork(
  418:                         workUnits,
  419:                         index + 1);
  420: 
  421:                     var cancelledMoment =
  422:                         FinalizePulse(
  423:                             coordinator,
  424:                             null);
  425: 
  426:                     RecordMoment(
  427:                         cancelledMoment);
  428: 
  429:                     return cancelledMoment;
  430:                 }
  431:                 catch (Exception exception)
  432:                 {
  433:                     if (!work.IsTerminal &&
  434:                         !work.TryFail(
  435:                             exception))
  436:                     {
  437:                         throw new InvalidOperationException(
  438:                             "The active WorkUnit could not record failure.",
  439:                             exception);
  440:                     }
  441: 
  442:                     CancelRemainingWork(
  443:                         workUnits,
  444:                         index + 1);
  445: 
  446:                     var failedMoment =
  447:                         FinalizePulse(
  448:                             coordinator,
  449:                             null);
  450: 
  451:                     RecordMoment(
  452:                         failedMoment);
  453: 
  454:                     return failedMoment;
  455:                 }
  456:             }
  457: 
  458:             var finalWork =
  459:                 workUnits[
  460:                     workUnits.Length - 1];
  461: 
  462:             object? finalResult;
  463: 
  464:             try
  465:             {
  466:                 cancellationToken
  467:                     .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
  468: 
  469:                 finalResult =
  470:                     resultSelector(
  471:                         results);
  472: 
  473:                 cancellationToken
  474:                     .ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
  475: 
  476:                 if (!finalWork.TryComplete(
  477:                         results[
  478:                             results.Length - 1]))
  479:                 {
  480:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  481:                         "The final WorkUnit could not complete.");
  482:                 }
  483:             }
  484:             catch (OperationCanceledException)
  485:             {
  486:                 if (!finalWork.IsTerminal &&
  487:                     !finalWork.TryCancel())
  488:                 {
  489:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  490:                         "The final WorkUnit could not be cancelled.");
  491:                 }
  492: 
  493:                 var cancelledMoment =
  494:                     FinalizePulse(
  495:                         coordinator,
  496:                         null);
  497: 
  498:                 RecordMoment(
  499:                     cancelledMoment);
  500: 
  501:                 return cancelledMoment;
  502:             }
  503:             catch (Exception exception)
  504:             {
  505:                 if (!finalWork.IsTerminal &&
  506:                     !finalWork.TryFail(
  507:                         exception))
  508:                 {
  509:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  510:                         "The final WorkUnit could not record failure.",
  511:                         exception);
  512:                 }
  513: 
  514:                 var failedMoment =
  515:                     FinalizePulse(
  516:                         coordinator,
  517:                         null);
  518: 
  519:                 RecordMoment(
  520:                     failedMoment);
  521: 
  522:                 return failedMoment;
  523:             }
  524: 
  525:             var completedMoment =
  526:                 FinalizePulse(
  527:                     coordinator,
  528:                     finalResult);
  529: 
  530:             RecordMoment(
  531:                 completedMoment);
  532: 
  533:             return completedMoment;
  534:         }
  535: 
  536:         /// <summary>
  537:         /// Preserves the existing certified instruction
  538:         /// processor lease boundary.
  539:         /// </summary>
  540:         public async ValueTask<TResult>
  541:             ExecuteInstructionAsync<TResult>(
  542:                 Func<
  543:                     IInstructionsProcessor,
  544:                     CancellationToken,
  545:                     ValueTask<TResult>> operation,
  546:                 CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
  547:         {
  548:             ThrowIfDisposed();
  549:             ThrowIfNotInitialized();
  550: 
  551:             if (operation == null)
  552:             {
  553:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
  554:                     nameof(operation));
  555:             }
  556: 
  557:             using (var lease =
  558:                 await _instructionsProcessors
  559:                     .RentAsync(
  560:                         cancellationToken)
  561:                     .ConfigureAwait(false))
  562:             {
  563:                 return await operation(
  564:                         lease.Instance,
  565:                         cancellationToken)
  566:                     .ConfigureAwait(false);
  567:             }
  568:         }
  569: 
  570:         public bool Shutdown()
  571:         {
  572:             ThrowIfDisposed();
  573: 
  574:             if (!IsInitialized)
  575:                 return false;
  576: 
  577:             _tasksRegistry.Shutdown();
  578:             _instructionRegistry.Shutdown();
  579: 
  580:             IsInitialized =
  581:                 false;
  582: 
  583:             return true;
  584:         }
  585: 
  586:         public void Dispose()
  587:         {
  588:             if (Interlocked.Exchange(
  589:                     ref _disposed,
  590:                     1) != 0)
  591:             {
  592:                 return;
  593:             }
  594: 
  595:             if (IsInitialized)
  596:             {
  597:                 _tasksRegistry.Shutdown();
  598:                 _instructionRegistry.Shutdown();
  599: 
  600:                 IsInitialized =
  601:                     false;
  602:             }
  603: 
  604:             _instructionsProcessors.Dispose();
  605:             _taskProcessors.Dispose();
  606:         }
  607: 
  608:         private static void BeginPulse(
  609:             Pulse pulse,
  610:             WorkUnit work,
  611:             IPulseCoordinator coordinator)
  612:         {
  613:             if (!pulse.TryBeginDecomposition())
  614:             {
  615:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  616:                     "The Pulse could not begin decomposition.");
  617:             }
  618: 
  619:             if (!coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  620:                     work))
  621:             {
  622:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  623:                     "The WorkUnit could not be correlated " +
  624:                     "with its Pulse.");
  625:             }
  626: 
  627:             if (!work.TryMarkPending())
  628:             {
  629:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  630:                     "The WorkUnit could not become pending.");
  631:             }
  632: 
  633:             if (!pulse.TryMarkPending())
  634:             {
  635:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  636:                     "The Pulse could not become pending.");
  637:             }
  638: 
  639:             if (!pulse.TryMarkReady())
  640:             {
  641:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  642:                     "The Pulse could not become ready.");
  643:             }
  644: 
  645:             if (!pulse.TryBeginProcessing())
  646:             {
  647:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  648:                     "The Pulse could not begin processing.");
  649:             }
  650: 
  651:             if (!work.TryBeginProcessing())
  652:             {
  653:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  654:                     "The WorkUnit could not begin processing.");
  655:             }
  656:         }
  657: 
  658:         private static void BeginDecomposedPulse(
  659:             Pulse pulse,
  660:             WorkUnit[] workUnits,
  661:             IPulseCoordinator coordinator,
  662:             object? request)
  663:         {
  664:             if (!pulse.TryBeginDecomposition())
  665:             {
  666:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  667:                     "The Pulse could not begin decomposition.");
  668:             }
  669: 
  670:             for (var index = 0;
  671:                  index < workUnits.Length;
  672:                  index++)
  673:             {
  674:                 var work =
  675:                     new WorkUnit(
  676:                         pulse.Id,
  677:                         request);
  678: 
  679:                 workUnits[index] =
  680:                     work;
  681: 
  682:                 if (!coordinator.AddWorkUnit(
  683:                         work))
  684:                 {
  685:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  686:                         "A WorkUnit could not be correlated " +
  687:                         "with its Pulse.");
  688:                 }
  689: 
  690:                 if (!work.TryMarkPending())
  691:                 {
  692:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  693:                         "A WorkUnit could not become pending.");
  694:                 }
  695:             }
  696: 
  697:             if (!pulse.TryMarkPending())
  698:             {
  699:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  700:                     "The Pulse could not become pending.");
  701:             }
  702: 
  703:             if (!pulse.TryMarkReady())
  704:             {
  705:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  706:                     "The Pulse could not become ready.");
  707:             }
  708: 
  709:             if (!pulse.TryBeginProcessing())
  710:             {
  711:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  712:                     "The Pulse could not begin processing.");
  713:             }
  714:         }
  715: 
  716:         private static void CancelRemainingWork(
  717:             WorkUnit[] workUnits,
  718:             int startIndex)
  719:         {
  720:             for (var index = startIndex;
  721:                  index < workUnits.Length;
  722:                  index++)
  723:             {
  724:                 var work =
  725:                     workUnits[index];
  726: 
  727:                 if (work.IsTerminal)
  728:                 {
  729:                     continue;
  730:                 }
  731: 
  732:                 if (!work.TryCancel())
  733:                 {
  734:                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
  735:                         "A remaining WorkUnit could not be cancelled.");
  736:                 }
  737:             }
  738:         }
  739: 
  740:         private static IMoment FinalizePulse(
  741:             IPulseCoordinator coordinator,
  742:             object? result)
  743:         {
  744:             if (!coordinator.CanFinalize)
  745:             {
  746:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  747:                     "The Pulse cannot finalize while required " +
  748:                     "WorkUnits remain unresolved.");
  749:             }
  750: 
  751:             if (!coordinator.TryFinalize(
  752:                     result,
  753:                     out var moment))
  754:             {
  755:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  756:                     "The Pulse coordinator could not create " +
  757:                     "a terminal Moment.");
  758:             }
  759: 
  760:             return moment ??
  761:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  762:                     "Pulse finalization returned no Moment.");
  763:         }
  764: 
  765:         private void RecordMoment(
  766:             IMoment moment)
  767:         {
  768:             if (!_timeline.AddMoment(
  769:                     moment))
  770:             {
  771:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  772:                     "The terminal Moment could not be " +
  773:                     "recorded in the engine Timeline.");
  774:             }
  775:         }
  776: 
  777:         private void ThrowIfNotInitialized()
  778:         {
  779:             if (!IsInitialized)
  780:             {
  781:                 throw new InvalidOperationException(
  782:                     "The WildsEngine must be initialized " +
  783:                     "before processing requests.");
  784:             }
  785:         }
  786: 
  787:         private void ThrowIfDisposed()
  788:         {
  789:             if (Volatile.Read(
  790:                     ref _disposed) != 0)
  791:             {
  792:                 throw new ObjectDisposedException(
  793:                     nameof(WildsEngine));
  794:             }
  795:         }
  796:     }
  797: }

FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Neighbors\Operators\Base\NeighborComparerBase.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    3: 
    4: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Neighbors.Operators
    5: {
    6:     /// <summary>
    7:     /// Supplies validation and deterministic tie handling for
    8:     /// Neighbor relationship comparers.
    9:     /// </summary>
   10:     public abstract class NeighborComparerBase :
   11:         INeighborComparer
   12:     {
   13:         public int Compare(
   14:             IBaseObject subject,
   15:             INeighborRelationship left,
   16:             INeighborRelationship right)
   17:         {
   18:             if (subject == null)
   19:             {
   20:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   21:                     nameof(subject));
   22:             }
   23: 
   24:             if (left == null)
   25:             {
   26:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   27:                     nameof(left));
   28:             }
   29: 
   30:             if (right == null)
   31:             {
   32:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   33:                     nameof(right));
   34:             }
   35: 
   36:             var compared =
   37:                 CompareCore(
   38:                     subject,
   39:                     left,
   40:                     right);
   41: 
   42:             if (compared != 0)
   43:             {
   44:                 return compared;
   45:             }
   46: 
   47:             compared = string.Compare(
   48:                 left.Membership,
   49:                 right.Membership,
   50:                 StringComparison.Ordinal);
   51: 
   52:             if (compared != 0)
   53:             {
   54:                 return compared;
   55:             }
   56: 
   57:             return left.Neighbor.Id.CompareTo(
   58:                 right.Neighbor.Id);
   59:         }
   60: 
   61:         protected abstract int CompareCore(
   62:             IBaseObject subject,
   63:             INeighborRelationship left,
   64:             INeighborRelationship right);
   65:     }
   66: }

FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Neighbors\Operators\Base\NeighborCompositeOperatorBase.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    4: 
    5: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Neighbors.Operators
    6: {
    7:     /// <summary>
    8:     /// Applies a deterministic sequence of Neighbor sequence
    9:     /// operators. Each stage receives the prior stage snapshot.
   10:     /// </summary>
   11:     public abstract class NeighborCompositeOperatorBase :
   12:         NeighborSequenceOperatorBase
   13:     {
   14:         private readonly IReadOnlyList<INeighborSequenceOperator>
   15:             _operators;
   16: 
   17:         protected NeighborCompositeOperatorBase(
   18:             IReadOnlyList<INeighborSequenceOperator> operators)
   19:         {
   20:             if (operators == null)
   21:             {
   22:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   23:                     nameof(operators));
   24:             }
   25: 
   26:             var snapshot =
   27:                 new INeighborSequenceOperator[operators.Count];
   28: 
   29:             for (var index = 0;
   30:                  index < operators.Count;
   31:                  index++)
   32:             {
   33:                 snapshot[index] =
   34:                     operators[index] ??
   35:                     throw new ArgumentException(
   36:                         "Neighbor operator pipelines cannot contain null stages.",
   37:                         nameof(operators));
   38:             }
   39: 
   40:             _operators = snapshot;
   41:         }
   42: 
   43:         protected sealed override
   44:             IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> ApplyCore(
   45:                 IBaseObject subject,
   46:                 IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> relationships)
   47:         {
   48:             var current =
   49:                 relationships;
   50: 
   51:             for (var index = 0;
   52:                  index < _operators.Count;
   53:                  index++)
   54:             {
   55:                 current =
   56:                     _operators[index].Apply(
   57:                         subject,
   58:                         current);
   59:             }
   60: 
   61:             return current;
   62:         }
   63:     }
   64: }

############################################################
FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Neighbors\Operators\Base\NeighborFilterOperatorBase.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    4: 
    5: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Neighbors.Operators
    6: {
    7:     /// <summary>
    8:     /// Filters a relationship snapshot through one reusable
    9:     /// predicate while preserving source order.
   10:     /// </summary>
   11:     public abstract class NeighborFilterOperatorBase :
   12:         NeighborSequenceOperatorBase
   13:     {
   14:         private readonly INeighborPredicate _predicate;
   15: 
   16:         protected NeighborFilterOperatorBase(
   17:             INeighborPredicate predicate)
   18:         {
   19:             _predicate =
   20:                 predicate ??
   21:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   22:                     nameof(predicate));
   23:         }
   24: 
   25:         protected sealed override
   26:             IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> ApplyCore(
   27:                 IBaseObject subject,
   28:                 IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> relationships)
   29:         {
   30:             var result =
   31:                 new List<INeighborRelationship>();
   32: 
   33:             for (var index = 0;
   34:                  index < relationships.Count;
   35:                  index++)
   36:             {
   37:                 var relationship =
   38:                     relationships[index];
   39: 
   40:                 if (_predicate.Includes(
   41:                         subject,
   42:                         relationship))
   43:                 {
   44:                     result.Add(
   45:                         relationship);
   46:                 }
   47:             }
   48: 
   49:             return Snapshot(
   50:                 result);
   51:         }
   52:     }
   53: }

FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Neighbors\Operators\Base\NeighborGroupingOperatorBase.cs
############################################################
    1: using System.Collections.Generic;
    2: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    3: 
    4: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Neighbors.Operators
    5: {
    6:     /// <summary>
    7:     /// Base class for operators that group relationships under
    8:     /// deterministic string keys.
    9:     /// </summary>
   10:     public abstract class NeighborGroupingOperatorBase :
   11:         NeighborOperatorBase<
   12:             IReadOnlyDictionary<
   13:                 string,
   14:                 IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship>>>,
   15:         INeighborGroupingOperator
   16:     {
   17:         protected static IReadOnlyDictionary<
   18:             string,
   19:             IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship>> Freeze(
   20:                 Dictionary<
   21:                     string,
   22:                     List<INeighborRelationship>> groups)
   23:         {
   24:             var frozen =
   25:                 new Dictionary<
   26:                     string,
   27:                     IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship>>(
   28:                         groups.Count,
   29:                         System.StringComparer.Ordinal);
   30: 
   31:             foreach (var pair in groups)
   32:             {
   33:                 frozen.Add(
   34:                     pair.Key,
   35:                     pair.Value.ToArray());
   36:             }
   37: 
   38:             return frozen;
   39:         }
   40:     }
   41: }

FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Neighbors\Operators\Base\NeighborOperatorBase.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    4: 
    5: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Neighbors.Operators
    6: {
    7:     /// <summary>
    8:     /// Supplies argument validation and a stable execution
    9:     /// boundary for Neighbor operators.
   10:     /// </summary>
   11:     public abstract class NeighborOperatorBase<TResult> :
   12:         INeighborOperator<TResult>
   13:     {
   14:         public TResult Apply(
   15:             IBaseObject subject,
   16:             IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> relationships)
   17:         {
   18:             if (subject == null)
   19:             {
   20:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   21:                     nameof(subject));
   22:             }
   23: 
   24:             if (relationships == null)
   25:             {
   26:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   27:                     nameof(relationships));
   28:             }
   29: 
   30:             return ApplyCore(
   31:                 subject,
   32:                 relationships);
   33:         }
   34: 
   35:         protected abstract TResult ApplyCore(
   36:             IBaseObject subject,
   37:             IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> relationships);
   38:     }
   39: }

FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Neighbors\Operators\Base\NeighborOrderOperatorBase.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    4: 
    5: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Neighbors.Operators
    6: {
    7:     /// <summary>
    8:     /// Orders a copied relationship snapshot through a reusable
    9:     /// comparer and never mutates the source sequence.
   10:     /// </summary>
   11:     public abstract class NeighborOrderOperatorBase :
   12:         NeighborSequenceOperatorBase
   13:     {
   14:         private readonly INeighborComparer _comparer;
   15: 
   16:         protected NeighborOrderOperatorBase(
   17:             INeighborComparer comparer)
   18:         {
   19:             _comparer =
   20:                 comparer ??
   21:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   22:                     nameof(comparer));
   23:         }
   24: 
   25:         protected sealed override
   26:             IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> ApplyCore(
   27:                 IBaseObject subject,
   28:                 IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> relationships)
   29:         {
   30:             var result =
   31:                 new List<INeighborRelationship>(
   32:                     relationships.Count);
   33: 
   34:             for (var index = 0;
   35:                  index < relationships.Count;
   36:                  index++)
   37:             {
   38:                 result.Add(
   39:                     relationships[index]);
   40:             }
   41: 
   42:             result.Sort(
   43:                 (left, right) =>
   44:                     _comparer.Compare(
   45:                         subject,
   46:                         left,
   47:                         right));
   48: 
   49:             return Snapshot(
   50:                 result);
   51:         }
   52:     }
   53: }

FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Neighbors\Operators\Base\NeighborSamplerBase.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    4: 
    5: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Neighbors.Operators
    6: {
    7:     /// <summary>
    8:     /// Base class for bounded, snapshot-safe Neighbor sampling.
    9:     /// </summary>
   10:     public abstract class NeighborSamplerBase :
   11:         NeighborSequenceOperatorBase,
   12:         INeighborSampler
   13:     {
   14:         protected NeighborSamplerBase(
   15:             int count)
   16:         {
   17:             if (count < 0)
   18:             {
   19:                 throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
   20:                     nameof(count),
   21:                     count,
   22:                     "Neighbor sample count cannot be negative.");
   23:             }
   24: 
   25:             Count = count;
   26:         }
   27: 
   28:         public int Count { get; }
   29: 
   30:         protected sealed override
   31:             IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> ApplyCore(
   32:                 IBaseObject subject,
   33:                 IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> relationships)
   34:         {
   35:             if (Count == 0 ||
   36:                 relationships.Count == 0)
   37:             {
   38:                 return Empty();
   39:             }
   40: 
   41:             var boundedCount =
   42:                 Math.Min(
   43:                     Count,
   44:                     relationships.Count);
   45: 
   46:             return SampleCore(
   47:                 subject,
   48:                 relationships,
   49:                 boundedCount);
   50:         }
   51: 
   52:         protected abstract IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship>
   53:             SampleCore(
   54:                 IBaseObject subject,
   55:                 IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> relationships,
   56:                 int count);
   57:     }
   58: }

############################################################
FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Neighbors\Operators\DeterministicNeighborSample.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    4: 
    5: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Neighbors.Operators
    6: {
    7:     public sealed class DeterministicNeighborSample : NeighborSamplerBase
    8:     {
    9:         public DeterministicNeighborSample(int count, int seed) : base(count) => Seed = seed;
   10:         public int Seed { get; }
   11: 
   12:         protected override IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> SampleCore(IBaseObject subject, IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> relationships, int count)
   13:         {
   14:             var copy = new List<INeighborRelationship>(relationships.Count);
   15:             for (var i = 0; i < relationships.Count; i++) copy.Add(relationships[i]);
   16:             var random = new Random(Seed);
   17:             for (var i = copy.Count - 1; i > 0; i--)
   18:             {
   19:                 var j = random.Next(i + 1);
   20:                 var temp = copy[i]; copy[i] = copy[j]; copy[j] = temp;
   21:             }
   22:             if (copy.Count > count) copy.RemoveRange(count, copy.Count - count);
   23:             return copy.ToArray();
   24:         }
   25:     }
   26: }

   22:     }
   23: }

############################################################
FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Neighbors\Operators\FarthestNeighbor.cs
############################################################
    1: using System.Collections.Generic;
    2: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    3: 
    4: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Neighbors.Operators
    5: {
    6:     public sealed class FarthestNeighbor : NeighborOperatorBase<INeighborRelationship?>, INeighborScalarOperator<INeighborRelationship?>
    7:     {
    8:         protected override INeighborRelationship? ApplyCore(IBaseObject subject, IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> relationships)
    9:         {
   10:             INeighborRelationship? best = null;
   11:             var bestDistance = double.MinValue;
   12:             for (var i = 0; i < relationships.Count; i++)
   13:             {
   14:                 var r = relationships[i];
   15:                 if (best == null || r.Distance > bestDistance ||
   16:                     (r.Distance == bestDistance && r.Neighbor.Id.CompareTo(best.Neighbor.Id) < 0))
   17:                 {
   18:                     best = r; bestDistance = r.Distance;
   19:                 }
   20:             }
   21:             return best;
   22:         }
   23:     }
   24: }

############################################################
FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Neighbors\Operators\NeighborDistanceBandGroups.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using System.Globalization;
    4: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    5: using WildsEngine.Core.Topology;
    6: 
    7: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Neighbors.Operators
    8: {
    9:     public sealed class NeighborDistanceBandGroups : NeighborGroupingOperatorBase
   10:     {
   11:         public NeighborDistanceBandGroups(double bandSize)
   12:         {
   13:             BandSize = NeighborDistance.Validate(bandSize, nameof(bandSize));
   14:             if (BandSize == 0d) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(bandSize), "Distance band size must be greater than zero.");
   15:         }
   16:         public double BandSize { get; }
   17: 
   18:         protected override IReadOnlyDictionary<string, IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship>> ApplyCore(IBaseObject subject, IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> relationships)
   19:         {
   20:             var groups = new Dictionary<string, List<INeighborRelationship>>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
   21:             for (var i = 0; i < relationships.Count; i++)
   22:             {
   23:                 var r = relationships[i];
   24:                 var band = Math.Floor(r.Distance / BandSize);
   25:                 var min = band * BandSize;
   26:                 var max = min + BandSize;
   27:                 var key = min.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture) + ".." + max.ToString("R", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
   28:                 List<INeighborRelationship> group;
   29:                 if (!groups.TryGetValue(key, out group!)) { group = new List<INeighborRelationship>(); groups.Add(key, group); }
   30:                 group.Add(r);
   31:             }
   32:             return Freeze(groups);
   33:         }
   34:     }
   35: }

FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Neighbors\Operators\NeighborDistanceDescendingComparer.cs
############################################################
    1: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    2:

############################################################
FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Neighbors\Operators\NeighborMembershipGroups.cs
############################################################
    1: using System.Collections.Generic;
    2: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    3: 
    4: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Neighbors.Operators
    5: {
    6:     public sealed class NeighborMembershipGroups : NeighborGroupingOperatorBase
    7:     {
    8:         protected override IReadOnlyDictionary<string, IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship>> ApplyCore(IBaseObject subject, IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> relationships)
    9:         {
   10:             var groups = new Dictionary<string, List<INeighborRelationship>>(System.StringComparer.Ordinal);
   11:             for (var i = 0; i < relationships.Count; i++)
   12:             {
   13:                 var r = relationships[i];
   14:                 List<INeighborRelationship> group;
   15:                 if (!groups.TryGetValue(r.Membership, out group!))
   16:                 {
   17:                     group = new List<INeighborRelationship>();
   18:                     groups.Add(r.Membership, group);
   19:                 }
   20:                 group.Add(r);
   21:             }
   22:             return Freeze(groups);
   23:         }
   24:     }
   25: }

############################################################
FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Neighbors\Operators\RandomNeighborSample.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    4: 
    5: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Neighbors.Operators
    6: {
    7:     public sealed class RandomNeighborSample : NeighborSamplerBase
    8:     {
    9:         public RandomNeighborSample(int count) : base(count) { }
   10: 
   11:         protected override IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> SampleCore(IBaseObject subject, IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> relationships, int count)
   12:         {
   13:             var copy = new List<INeighborRelationship>(relationships.Count);
   14:             for (var i = 0; i < relationships.Count; i++) copy.Add(relationships[i]);
   15:             var random = new Random();
   16:             for (var i = copy.Count - 1; i > 0; i--)
   17:             {
   18:                 var j = random.Next(i + 1);
   19:                 var temp = copy[i]; copy[i] = copy[j]; copy[j] = temp;
   20:             }
   21:             if (copy.Count > count) copy.RemoveRange(count, copy.Count - count);
   22:             return copy.ToArray();
   23:         }
   24:     }
   25: }

############################################################
FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Neighbors\Propagation\ExponentialDistancePropagation.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions.Neighbors.Propagation;
    4: 
    5: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Neighbors.Propagation
    6: {
    7:     public sealed class ExponentialDistancePropagation :
    8:         INeighborPropagation
    9:     {
   10:         private readonly double _decay;
   11: 
   12:         public ExponentialDistancePropagation(
   13:             double decay)
   14:         {
   15:             ValidateNonNegativeFinite(
   16:                 decay,
   17:                 nameof(decay));
   18: 
   19:             _decay =
   20:                 decay;
   21:         }
   22: 
   23:         public double Propagate(
   24:             double intensity,
   25:             INeighborRelationship relationship)
   26:         {
   27:             if (relationship == null)
   28:             {
   29:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   30:                     nameof(relationship));
   31:             }
   32: 
   33:             ValidateNonNegativeFinite(
   34:                 intensity,
   35:                 nameof(intensity));
   36: 
   37:             var distance =
   38:                 relationship.Distance;
   39: 
   40:             ValidateNonNegativeFinite(
   41:                 distance,
   42:                 nameof(relationship));
   43: 
   44:             var exponent =
   45:                 -_decay *
   46:                 distance;
   47: 
   48:             /*
   49:              * Very large finite decay and distance values can
   50:              * overflow their product to negative infinity.
   51:              *
   52:              * For non-negative decay and distance, that limit
   53:              * legitimately represents complete attenuation:
   54:              *
   55:              *     Exp(-Infinity) = 0
   56:              *
   57:              * NaN remains invalid and must never pass through.
   58:              */
   59:             if (double.IsNaN(
   60:                     exponent))
   61:             {
   62:                 throw new ArithmeticException(
   63:                     "Propagation produced an invalid exponent.");
   64:             }
   65: 
   66:             var attenuation =
   67:                 Math.Exp(
   68:                     exponent);
   69: 
   70:             if (double.IsNaN(
   71:                     attenuation) ||
   72:                 double.IsInfinity(
   73:                     attenuation))
   74:             {
   75:                 throw new ArithmeticException(
   76:                     "Propagation produced non-finite attenuation.");
   77:             }
   78: 
   79:             var propagated =
   80:                 intensity *
   81:                 attenuation;
   82: 
   83:             if (double.IsNaN(
   84:                     propagated) ||
   85:                 double.IsInfinity(
   86:                     propagated))
   87:             {
   88:                 throw new ArithmeticException(
   89:                     "Propagation produced a non-finite result.");
   90:             }
   91: 
   92:             return propagated;
   93:         }
   94: 
   95:         private static void ValidateNonNegativeFinite(
   96:             double value,
   97:             string parameterName)
   98:         {
   99:             if (double.IsNaN(
  100:                     value) ||
  101:                 double.IsInfinity(
  102:                     value) ||
  103:                 value < 0.0)
  104:             {
  105:                 throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(
  106:                     parameterName);
  107:             }
  108:         }
  109:     }
  110: }

FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Objects\BaseObject.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    4: 
    5: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Objects
    6: {
    7:     public abstract class BaseObject :
    8:         IBaseObject
    9:     {
   10:         private readonly NeighborCollection _neighbors;
   11: 
   12:         protected BaseObject(
   13:             string layer)
   14:             : this(
   15:                 Guid.NewGuid(),
   16:                 layer)
   17:         {
   18:         }
   19: 
   20:         protected BaseObject(
   21:             Guid id,
   22:             string layer)
   23:         {
   24:             if (id == Guid.Empty)
   25:             {
   26:                 throw new ArgumentException(
   27:                     "Wilds objects require a non-empty GUID.",
   28:                     nameof(id));
   29:             }
   30: 
   31:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(layer))
   32:             {
   33:                 throw new ArgumentException(
   34:                     "Wilds objects require a layer.",
   35:                     nameof(layer));
   36:             }
   37: 
   38:             Id = id;
   39: 
   40:             Slug =
   41:                 BuildSlug(
   42:                     id,
   43:                     layer);
   44: 
   45:             _neighbors =
   46:                 new NeighborCollection(
   47:                     this);
   48:         }
   49: 
   50:         public Guid Id { get; }
   51: 
   52:         public string Slug { get; private set; }
   53: 
   54:         public INeighborCollection Neighbors =>
   55:             _neighbors;
   56: 
   57:         public abstract IComponent Component { get; }
   58: 
   59:         // Component shortcuts.
   60:         // These intentionally do NOT belong to IBaseObject.
   61: 
   62:         public virtual IState State =>
   63:             Component.State;
   64: 
   65:         public virtual ISignal Signal =>
   66:             Component.Signal;
   67: 
   68:         public virtual IDictionary<string, object?> Metadata =>
   69:             Component.Metadata;
   70: 
   71:         public string AppendSlug(
   72:             string value)
   73:         {
   74:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))
   75:             {
   76:                 return Slug;
   77:             }
   78: 
   79:             var segment =
   80:                 value
   81:                     .Trim()
   82:                     .Trim('.');
   83: 
   84:             if (segment.Length == 0)
   85:             {
   86:                 return Slug;
   87:             }
   88: 
   89:             Slug =
   90:                 $"{Slug}.{segment}";
   91: 
   92:             return Slug;
   93:         }
   94: 
   95:         public TResult ApplyNeighborOperator<TResult>(
   96:             INeighborOperator<TResult> neighborOperator)
   97:         {
   98:             if (neighborOperator == null)
   99:             {
  100:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
  101:                     nameof(neighborOperator));
  102:             }
  103: 
  104:             return neighborOperator.Apply(
  105:                 this,
  106:                 _neighbors.Relationships);
  107:         }
  108: 
  109:         private static string BuildSlug(
  110:             Guid id,
  111:             string layer)
  112:         {
  113:             var raw =
  114:                 id.ToString(
  115:                     "N");
  116: 
  117:             var first =
  118:                 raw.Substring(
  119:                     0,
  120:                     3);
  121: 
  122:             var last =
  123:                 raw.Substring(
  124:                     raw.Length - 3,
  125:                     3);
  126: 
  127:             return
  128:                 $"{first}{last}-{layer.Trim()}";
  129:         }
  130:     }
  131: }

FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Objects\NeighborCollection.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Generic;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    4: using WildsEngine.Core.Topology;
    5: 
    6: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Objects
    7: {
    8:     /// <summary>
    9:     /// Owns the directional Neighbor relationships belonging
   10:     /// to one Wilds object.
   11:     ///
   12:     /// Relationship identity is defined by:
   13:     ///
   14:     ///     Neighbor.Id + Membership
   15:     ///
   16:     /// Distance describes relationship state and may therefore
   17:     /// change without changing relationship identity.
   18:     /// </summary>
   19:     public sealed class NeighborCollection :
   20:         INeighborCollection
   21:     {
   22:         private readonly IBaseObject _owner;
   23: 
   24:         private readonly object _sync =
   25:             new object();
   26: 
   27:         private readonly List<INeighborRelationship> _relationships =
   28:             new List<INeighborRelationship>();
   29: 
   30:         public NeighborCollection(
   31:             IBaseObject owner)
   32:         {
   33:             _owner =
   34:                 owner ??
   35:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   36:                     nameof(owner));
   37:         }
   38: 
   39:         public int Count
   40:         {
   41:             get
   42:             {
   43:                 lock (_sync)
   44:                 {
   45:                     return _relationships.Count;
   46:                 }
   47:             }
   48:         }
   49: 
   50:         public IReadOnlyList<INeighborRelationship> Relationships
   51:         {
   52:             get
   53:             {
   54:                 lock (_sync)
   55:                 {
   56:                     return _relationships.ToArray();
   57:                 }
   58:             }
   59:         }
   60: 
   61:         public bool Add(
   62:             IBaseObject neighbor,
   63:             string membership,
   64:             double distance)
   65:         {
   66:             if (neighbor == null)
   67:             {
   68:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   69:                     nameof(neighbor));
   70:             }
   71: 
   72:             var normalizedMembership =
   73:                 ValidateMembership(
   74:                     membership);
   75: 
   76:             NeighborDistance.Validate(
   77:                 distance,
   78:                 nameof(distance));
   79: 
   80:             if (neighbor.Id == _owner.Id)
   81:             {
   82:                 return false;
   83:             }
   84: 
   85:             lock (_sync)
   86:             {
   87:                 if (FindIndex(
   88:                         neighbor.Id,
   89:                         normalizedMembership) >= 0)
   90:                 {
   91:                     return false;
   92:                 }
   93: 
   94:                 _relationships.Add(
   95:                     new NeighborRelationship(
   96:                         neighbor,
   97:                         normalizedMembership,
   98:                         distance));
   99: 
  100:                 return true;
  101:             }
  102:         }
  103: 
  104:         public bool Contains(
  105:             Guid neighborId,
  106:             string membership)
  107:         {
  108:             if (neighborId == Guid.Empty)
  109:             {
  110:                 return false;
  111:             }
  112: 
  113:             var normalizedMembership =
  114:                 ValidateMembership(
  115:                     membership);
  116: 
  117:             lock (_sync)
  118:             {
  119:                 return FindIndex(
  120:                            neighborId,
  121:                            normalizedMembership) >= 0;
  122:             }
  123:         }
  124: 
  125:         public bool TryGet(
  126:             Guid neighborId,
  127:             string membership,
  128:             out INeighborRelationship? relationship)
  129:         {
  130:             relationship = null;
  131: 
  132:             if (neighborId == Guid.Empty)
  133:             {
  134:                 return false;
  135:             }
  136: 
  137:             var normalizedMembership =
  138:                 ValidateMembership(
  139:                     membership);
  140: 
  141:             lock (_sync)
  142:             {
  143:                 var index =
  144:                     FindIndex(
  145:                         neighborId,
  146:                         normalizedMembership);
  147: 
  148:                 if (index < 0)
  149:                 {
  150:                     return false;
  151:                 }
  152: 
  153:                 relationship =
  154:                     _relationships[index];
  155: 
  156:                 return true;
  157:             }
  158:         }
  159: 
  160:         public bool SetDistance(
  161:             Guid neighborId,
  162:             string membership,
  163:             double distance)
  164:         {
  165:             if (neighborId == Guid.Empty)
  166:             {
  167:                 return false;
  168:             }
  169: 
  170:             var normalizedMembership =
  171:                 ValidateMembership(
  172:                     membership);
  173: 
  174:             NeighborDistance.Validate(
  175:                 distance,
  176:                 nameof(distance));
  177: 
  178:             lock (_sync)
  179:             {
  180:                 var index =
  181:                     FindIndex(
  182:                         neighborId,
  183:                         normalizedMembership);
  184: 
  185:                 if (index < 0)
  186:                 {
  187:                     return false;
  188:                 }
  189: 
  190:                 var existing =
  191:                     _relationships[index];
  192: 
  193:                 if (existing.Distance == distance)
  194:                 {
  195:                     return false;
  196:                 }
  197: 
  198:                 _relationships[index] =
  199:                     new NeighborRelationship(
  200:                         existing.Neighbor,
  201:                         existing.Membership,
  202:                         distance);
  203: 
  204:                 return true;
  205:             }
  206:         }
  207: 
  208:         public bool UpdateDistance(
  209:             Guid neighborId,
  210:             string membership,
  211:             Func<double, double> update)
  212:         {
  213:             if (neighborId == Guid.Empty)
  214:             {
  215:                 return false;
  216:             }
  217: 
  218:             if (update == null)
  219:             {
  220:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
  221:                     nameof(update));
  222:             }
  223: 
  224:             var normalizedMembership =
  225:                 ValidateMembership(
  226:                     membership);
  227: 
  228:             lock (_sync)
  229:             {
  230:                 var index =
  231:                     FindIndex(
  232:                         neighborId,
  233:                         normalizedMembership);
  234: 
  235:                 if (index < 0)
  236:                 {
  237:                     return false;
  238:                 }
  239: 
  240:                 var existing =
  241:                     _relationships[index];
  242: 
  243:                 var updatedDistance =
  244:                     update(
  245:                         existing.Distance);
  246: 
  247:                 NeighborDistance.Validate(
  248:                     updatedDistance,
  249:                     nameof(updatedDistance));
  250: 
  251:                 if (existing.Distance ==
  252:                     updatedDistance)
  253:                 {
  254:                     return false;
  255:                 }
  256: 
  257:                 _relationships[index] =
  258:                     new NeighborRelationship(
  259:                         existing.Neighbor,
  260:                         existing.Membership,
  261:                         updatedDistance);
  262: 
  263:                 return true;
  264:             }
  265:         }
  266: 
  267:         public bool Remove(
  268:             Guid neighborId,
  269:             string membership)
  270:         {
  271:             if (neighborId == Guid.Empty)
  272:             {
  273:                 return false;
  274:             }
  275: 
  276:             var normalizedMembership =
  277:                 ValidateMembership(
  278:                     membership);
  279: 
  280:             lock (_sync)
  281:             {
  282:                 var index =
  283:                     FindIndex(
  284:                         neighborId,
  285:                         normalizedMembership);
  286: 
  287:                 if (index < 0)
  288:                 {
  289:                     return false;
  290:                 }
  291: 
  292:                 _relationships.RemoveAt(
  293:                     index);
  294: 
  295:                 return true;
  296:             }
  297:         }
  298: 
  299:         public int Remove(
  300:             Guid neighborId)
  301:         {
  302:             if (neighborId == Guid.Empty)
  303:             {
  304:                 return 0;
  305:             }
  306: 
  307:             lock (_sync)
  308:             {
  309:                 var removed = 0;
  310: 
  311:                 for (var index =
  312:                          _relationships.Count - 1;
  313:                      index >= 0;
  314:                      index--)
  315:                 {
  316:                     if (_relationships[index]
  317:                             .Neighbor
  318:                             .Id != neighborId)
  319:                     {
  320:                         continue;
  321:                     }
  322: 
  323:                     _relationships.RemoveAt(
  324:                         index);
  325: 
  326:                     removed++;
  327:                 }
  328: 
  329:                 return removed;
  330:             }
  331:         }
  332: 
  333:         public void Clear()
  334:         {
  335:             lock (_sync)
  336:             {
  337:                 _relationships.Clear();
  338:             }
  339:         }
  340: 
  341:         private int FindIndex(
  342:             Guid neighborId,
  343:             string membership)
  344:         {
  345:             for (var index = 0;
  346:                  index < _relationships.Count;
  347:                  index++)
  348:             {
  349:                 var relationship =
  350:                     _relationships[index];
  351: 
  352:                 if (relationship.Neighbor.Id !=
  353:                     neighborId)
  354:                 {
  355:                     continue;
  356:                 }
  357: 
  358:                 if (!string.Equals(
  359:                         relationship.Membership,
  360:                         membership,
  361:                         StringComparison.Ordinal))
  362:                 {
  363:                     continue;
  364:                 }
  365: 
  366:                 return index;
  367:             }
  368: 
  369:             return -1;
  370:         }
  371: 
  372:         private static string ValidateMembership(
  373:             string membership)
  374:         {
  375:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
  376:                     membership))
  377:             {
  378:                 throw new ArgumentException(
  379:                     "Neighbor relationships require a membership.",
  380:                     nameof(membership));
  381:             }
  382: 
  383:             return membership.Trim();
  384:         }
  385:     }
  386: }

############################################################
FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Objects\NeighborRelationship.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    3: using WildsEngine.Core.Topology;
    4: 
    5: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Objects
    6: {
    7:     /// <summary>
    8:     /// Immutable description of a directional Neighbor
    9:     /// relationship between Wilds objects.
   10:     ///
   11:     /// Relationship identity is defined by the owning object,
   12:     /// neighboring object, and membership. Distance describes
   13:     /// the current proximity within that relationship and is
   14:     /// not itself relationship identity.
   15:     /// </summary>
   16:     public sealed class NeighborRelationship :
   17:         INeighborRelationship
   18:     {
   19:         public NeighborRelationship(
   20:             IBaseObject neighbor,
   21:             string membership,
   22:             double distance)
   23:         {
   24:             Neighbor =
   25:                 neighbor ??
   26:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   27:                     nameof(neighbor));
   28: 
   29:             Membership =
   30:                 ValidateMembership(
   31:                     membership);
   32: 
   33:             Distance =
   34:                 NeighborDistance.Validate(
   35:                     distance,
   36:                     nameof(distance));
   37:         }
   38: 
   39:         public IBaseObject Neighbor { get; }
   40: 
   41:         public string Membership { get; }
   42: 
   43:         public double Distance { get; }
   44: 
   45:         private static string ValidateMembership(
   46:             string membership)
   47:         {
   48:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
   49:                     membership))
   50:             {
   51:                 throw new ArgumentException(
   52:                     "Neighbor relationships require a membership.",
   53:                     nameof(membership));
   54:             }
   55: 
   56:             return membership.Trim();
   57:         }
   58:     }
   59: }

FILE: WildsEngine.Core\Processing\Base\RegistryBase.cs
############################################################
    1: using System;
    2: using System.Collections.Concurrent;
    3: using System.Collections.Generic;
    4: using System.Linq;
    5: using WildsEngine.Core.Abstractions;
    6: using WildsEngine.Core.Objects;
    7: 
    8: namespace WildsEngine.Core.Processing
    9: {
   10:     public abstract class RegistryBase<T> :
   11:         BaseObject,
   12:         IRegistry<T>
   13:         where T : class
   14:     {
   15:         private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<Guid, T> _items =
   16:             new ConcurrentDictionary<Guid, T>();
   17: 
   18:         private readonly IComponent _component;
   19:         private readonly Func<T, Guid> _identity;
   20: 
   21:         protected RegistryBase(
   22:             IComponent component,
   23:             string layer,
   24:             Func<T, Guid> identity)
   25:             : base(layer)
   26:         {
   27:             _component = component ??
   28:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   29:                     nameof(component));
   30: 
   31:             _identity = identity ??
   32:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   33:                     nameof(identity));
   34:         }
   35: 
   36:         public sealed override IComponent Component =>
   37:             _component;
   38: 
   39:         public int Count =>
   40:             _items.Count;
   41: 
   42:         public IReadOnlyCollection<T> Items =>
   43:             _items.Values.ToArray();
   44: 
   45:         public bool Register(T item)
   46:         {
   47:             if (item == null)
   48:             {
   49:                 throw new ArgumentNullException(
   50:                     nameof(item));
   51:             }
   52: 
   53:             var id =
   54:                 _identity(item);
   55: 
   56:             if (id == Guid.Empty)
   57:                 return false;
   58: 
   59:             return _items.TryAdd(
   60:                 id,
   61:                 item);
   62:         }
   63: 
   64:         public bool Contains(Guid id)
   65:         {
   66:             if (id == Guid.Empty)
   67:                 return false;
   68: 
   69:             return _items.ContainsKey(
   70:                 id);
   71:         }
   72: 
   73:         public T? Get(Guid id)
   74:         {
   75:             if (id == Guid.Empty)
   76:                 return null;
   77: 
   78:             return _items.TryGetValue(
   79:                 id,
   80:                 out var item)
   81:                     ? item
   82:                     : null;
   83:         }
   84: 
   85:         public bool TryGet(
   86:             Guid id,
   87:             out T? item)
   88:         {
   89:             if (id == Guid.Empty)
   90:             {
   91:                 item = null;
   92: 
   93:                 return false;
   94:             }
   95: 
   96:             return _items.TryGetValue(
   97:                 id,
   98:                 out item);
   99:         }
  100: 
  101:         public bool Remove(Guid id)
  102:         {
  103:             if (id == Guid.Empty)
  104:                 return false;
  105: 
  106:             return _items.TryRemove(
  107:                 id,
  108:                 out _);
  109:         }
  110: 
  111:         public void Clear()
  112:         {
  113:             _items.Clear();
  114:         }
  115: 
  116:         public bool IsInitialized { get; private set; }
  117: 
  118:         public bool Initialize()
  119:         {
  120:             if (IsInitialized)
  121:                 return false;
  122: 
  123:             OnInitialize();
  124: 
  125:             IsInitialized = true;
  126: 
  127:             return true;
  128:         }
  129: 
  130:         public bool Shutdown()
  131:         {
  132:             if (!IsInitialized)
  133:                 return false;
  134: 
  135:             OnShutdown();
  136: 
  137:             IsInitialized = false;
  138: 
  139:             return true;
  140:         }
  141: 
  142:         protected abstract void OnInitialize();
  143: 
  144:         protected abstract void OnShutdown();
  145:     }
  146: }
